chapters.title: Chapter 3280 The Wheel Turns! II
paragraphs: As if the words of the Great Beyonder that rang out across the Megalos Beyond all those cycles ago were reverberating right in their ears.
The sentence represented how fast it would take the Instrument to become a Great One.
It seemed that by their standards...it would be akin to the blink of an eye.
Many of them had lived for multiple cycles.
Countless years.
To them, a single year was extremely short.
Some slept for thousands of years in deep slumber.
So now, they fantasized just how quickly the Instrument would take to jump onto the distinction of a Great One.
The eyes of the followers of the Great Beyonder twinkled with unquenchable fervor.
While in the distance, the eyes of the Heretical Morphons became even more stern.
Within the same Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.
|Hmph, he succeeded and became even stronger. I can't continue watching this shit, lead me to this newly discovered Omniverse. X-999, is it?|
The interminable body of Savitar spoke towards the shrouded figure of Nietzsche, the Great Ponderor.

This being nodded with a thoughtful expression as a brilliant obsidian light flowed from him and towards Savitar- a unique set of coordinates being given within the Megalos Ynnere relative where many of Savitar's bodies were in Tainted Omniverses!
With a flicker of weavings, everything was set as, at this moment; Omniverse X-999 became a target of a Great One.
His purpose this time wasn't to even form a Dark Matter Core, but to simply recoup his losses as his purpose...was slaughter!
The Wheel of Existence moved and turned as it wished.
Some could seek it.
Some may not even know of it.
But ultimately, too many weavings were bound by it!
After countless turns. After an unknown number of cycles.
At this moment...
The wheel turned once more.
HUUUM!
Silently.
In a manner that truly very few would even be capable of perceiving and understanding.
But the Wheel turned regardless.
As if ushering in another chapter!
Within the Megalos Beyond.
The stretches of obsidian radiance were simply too vast.
The ends were not discovered even now as even for the truly powerful that had Transcended their Existence- some did not know!
In a corner of the Megalos Beyond that was filled with absolutely nothing...
BOOM!
A singularity bloomed.
An interminably potent singularity that was filled with terrifying concentrations of the Megalos Beyond bloomed.
It was the birth of a Morphon!
And yet this birth...
HUUM!
Caused the surroundings of the Megalos Beyond to shudder as naturally a storm began to form.
The singularity released a heavy pulse of weavings as instantly, all surrounding weavings became more potent.
Richer.

So rich that by the time the massive singularity attained any indiscernible form, the surroundings had become extremely chaotic and rich as...droplets of pure weavings of the Megalos Beyond began to form!
Dew drops.
Rain.
When the rain drops fell on this being, he naturally absorbed all of them into his body as behind him, massive obsidian wings unfurled with glory.
His form...was still not so easily apparent.
But from these wings...a dense number of golden strings appeared.
So dense that they numbered millions, these lines instantly shooting out horizontally towards the Megalos Beyond, downwards towards the Megalos Ynnere, and...
Millions of golden lines shot up.
They shot up unfathomably vast distances as they seemed to be seeking...the Megalos Nihilos.
|OOUUUUU!|
A fearsome cry filled with endless loathing and pain echoed from this entity.
His golden strings became reinforced with all of this loathing, and the moment they found something to bind within the Megalos Beyond- they forcefully bound it!
In a nearby Megalos Pantheon.
A large obsidian deluge of a river snaked across a massive mountain, hundreds of small squid-like Outerversal Morphon swimming within it as they conversed with each other.
|Have you heard? The appearance of the Sign! The Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of!|
|Of course! They say countless connections were formed just when he was born! That for the first time, rain appeared in the megalos Beyond. Rain!|
The squid like Morphons extended their tentacles and talked to each other as...
BOOM!
The space above them split as golden lines rained down.

And no matter if they were on the First Echelon, or Third, or Fourth of Outerversal Physiology- their existence was instantly dazed and then bound as they became the Delegatus of something else entirely.
Far from the Megalos Beyond.
Within the Megalos Ynnere.
Omniverse X-999.
Inside of a space filled with an endless golden sea, a golden haired man in white robes stared out with a determined gaze.
Behind him, his people underwent complex changes of Existence as...they couldn't even discern his figure.
Even if he were to be standing in front of them, they wouldn't be able to see him.
This...was a unique standing and power he held due to an unfathomable connection with his Omniverse.
As the Omniversal Ankyra!
Imperium stared at the endless sea as at this moment...
BOOOM!

His surroundings were instantly eclipsed by terrifying waves of Omniversal Authority- ones with such purity and potency that it seemed like all possible Omniversal Authorities were converging around him.
The weavings of existence in the surroundings instantly exploded with terrifying concentration and potency.
Auras of pure weavings of existence began to form, these auroras quickly forming into miniature rivers before they expanded to form into a multicolored sea!
At the center of all this, Imperium felt his existence stretched out as he began to meld with Existence.
As he became One With Existence!

At the same time, his existence was being compressed and refined into increasingly small particles before they exploded with even more mass and energy- a shocking transformation taking place as by the time it was done, an entirely different class of entity would take the stage.
Far from this location.
Across weavings of Existence and Anti-Existence.
Within the Megalos Nihilos.
In a space of endless white space.
So endlessly white that it would burn one's very existence.
In such a place, a wriggling, wormlike singularity bloomed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3281 The Wheel Turns! III
paragraphs: In an area of endless white!
Within the Megalos Nihilos, a wriggling, worm-like singularity bloomed as with it came a shocking intent.
|Haha...success! Just as they bloomed from a singularity in our space, I should have bloomed akin to a singularity in theirs...but where is this?|
The intent was curious as it wanted to look around.
Before it did anything though...
HUUM!
Its surroundings turned tumultuous as this worm-like entity was shocked.
|Rejection?!|
The voice was filled with maddened fervor as it had had too much to get here.
Too many of its subjugated pieces had fallen to the Worms of Existence for it to gain this chance!
For him to be wiped out just as he arrived?
No way.
His weavings tried to wake and come to fruition to resist, but...
|Huh?|
His existence felt a shocking elevation begin to take place as it wasn't a rejection as he expected.
Weavings of authority he never even imagined existed began to flow into him unceasingly!

In this blank white space, potent white rivers and white seas began to form as their heavy concentrations sank into his figure- its wormy visage getting bigger and bigger as amidst the storm, it even felt like it was being stretched out and melding with this surrounding space.
And all of this seemed just like the beginning as he could feel it.
The complexity of his existence.
The weavings.
They were exponentially being raised in a process he didn't understand or expect since his arrival.
He.
The Great Usurper.
Noah Eckert.
A part of him bloomed in the Megalos Nihilos, and he seemed to have triggered or been swept into a shocking process as his Existence began to soar to new heights!
Within the Megalos Ynnere.
Omniverse X-999.
In the Wheel of Weavings that was enacted by the Commonwealth- the place that held the Gladiators Arena where champions who would become Protectors were sought!
Three Royal Simians with terrifying waves of power as Apogee Autarchs smiled towards 18 figures that stood before them in a large hall shining with gold and white brilliance.
|Some of you are victors, some of you lost. But undoubtedly, your power showed itself to be sufficient enough to become Protectors of the Commonwealth- so rejoice!|
The matches of the Gladiators Arena had ended as the Viceroy and the shocking delegation of entities he was with had long since left.
Not before his image was portrayed over for all eyes watching as he let it be known who everyone should look up to and thank.
Among the 18, the figures of the Eonic Uterra, Sona, Henry, and the Imperium Autarch could be seen as they actually took four spots among the 18!
Among these 18 Entities, most were Apogee Autarchs, with the rest being Accumulation Autarchs.

|Soon enough, all of you will be transferred to the Omniverse of the Protectors to receive your full position after undergoing verification. Protector Osmont went first, but the rest of you will follo-|
|Hush for a moment.|

A voice interrupted the Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protector as shock and incredulity arose in the face of others, even the Eonic Uterra turning towards the Imperium Autarch with widened eyes that wondered what he was doing! He actually interrupted an Apogee Protector that gave them all a heavy sense of danger and was, of course, part of the Commonwealth that they all had to bid their time and work under.
The Protector of the Commonwealth who faced such disrespect changed his gaze right away as it became stern.
The two beside him were the same as they all looked towards Imperium with coldness!
|What did you say?|
They were giving him a chance.
For him to think and say it was a lapse in judgment.
For him to bow his knees and get things back on track.
And yet...
Imperium seemed lost in thought as this body of his emanated silent but unique waves of power.
Without even looking at the Protectors, he repeated himself.
|I was telling you all to be quiet for a second. The buzzing of your annoying voices does not need to hold the same arrogance as it did before.|
BOOM!
The words held no hint of respect or decor as the bodies of the three Apogee Autarchs turned unsightly while they exploded with terrifying waves of power.
And yet.
PA!
Imperium tapped out three times.
And an instant later, the blazing auras of the three Autarchs were instantly recalled as if they never existed.
Their eyes trembled as shockingly, the heavy weavings of over nine Autarchical Omniversal Authorities wrapped around them.

Not their influence. Not their weavings. But it felt the very grasp of existence itself that these Omniversal Authorities held wrapped around their Sources of Existence and forcefully bound them down!
Imperium began to walk towards them as his eyes were hazy, but an undeniable aura began to leak from him.
|This Omniverse was never yours to discover or play around with. I will now be taking it back.|

Those behind him were utterly shocked as Henry and Sona watched with sharp eyes, while the 14 Entities who had participated in the matches within the Arena and had been members of the Commonwealth this whole time...
BOOM!
They looked at each other before they made moves towards Imperium!
And yet the moment they did so, their bodies instantly came to a halt as it felt like every inch of their power had dried up.
Imperium didn't even look back at them as it felt like all surrounding weavings of existence were under his control.

He arrived before the three Simian Protectors who looked at him incredulously, not at all believing what was happening right now as in the next moment, Imperium used a finger to tap on their furred foreheads.
And their eyes instantly dimmed and became dazed as foreign weavings of existence perused into them- their power not being able to stop it whatsoever.
|You will tell your forces that everything is proceeding as normal.|
...! As he spoke, golden tendrils of light began to leak as within them, the Autarchical Omniversal Authority of Jugum flowed.
These golden tendrils forcefully opened the mouths of the Three Simian Protectors as Imperium didn't move to kill, only to control.
And Jugum...it was a heavy authority that meant dominance. Subjugation. The capitulation of existence entirely!
Imperium radiated such a profound level of power and majesty as while he did this, nothing was found out by anyone else outside this room!

chapters.title: Chapter 3282 The Wheel Turns! IV
paragraphs: Within moments, droves of golden rivers had flowed into the Apogee Autarchs as moments later, their eyes remained light as they instantly sank to their knees.
|We pay respects to the Great Imperium.|
WAA!
Apogee Autarchs.
Protectors of the Commonwealth!
They kneeled down towards a native of Omniverse X-999 as the ones in this hall watching were filled with shock and horror!

Imperium only paused briefly before he turned around and released 14 more tendrils of golden light that rapidly shot towards the other 14 champions, the only ones left untouched being the Eonic Uterra, Sona, and Henry.
They gazed towards him with caution and alarm as he voiced out.

|You all belong to this Omniverse as I will spare you from domination. But in the coming future, you will have to fight for your home. I will bring all forces of the Commonwealth here under my control, and after that, we will-...!|
The gaze of Imperium flickered from calmness to sternness very quickly.
He gazed out into the far distance as if he could see something nobody else could.
|It seems blessings and catastrophes come hand in hand...|
He spoke cryptically as he felt something approach the bounds of this Omniverse.
A power he had captured glimpses of in the arena when Osmont unveiled the Agent of Anti-Life!
The heavy aura of an Outerversal Morphon was coming towards the Omniverse!
Across the swathes of endless void governed by unbreakable Omniversal Authorities, Omniverse X-999 had bounds where its vast domain ended.
Near the ends of such a vast domain, a terrifying Skull with thousands of limbs behind it neared.
Purple flames burned in its sockets as it stared at the pristine Omniverse below with a devilish gaze.
|Hmph, I've taken a big loss recently, so let this be my gain. Slaughter is much easier than other methods as today, I shall reap some souls for myself...|
The One Who Walks...had made his way over to Omniverse X-999 after following the weavings given by the Great Ponderor.
He didn't know that veiled and a distance away from here, a terrifying entity with an opened Eye of Existence observed everything closely- this being the Great Ponderor himself!
He had been observing Omniverse X-999 this whole time to learn about his enemy- Protector Osmont.
To learn everything about him and reveal which of the Great Ones he was or which one he was connected to.

But...he just came across a shocking conference of Existential authority in his observations, and much of his gaze was then restricted from there as he wasn't able to see everything even with the Eye of Existence!
What was this?
Just what was this odd Omniverse, and what more could be found from it?
Nietzsche observed calmly while veiled as voraciously, Savitar sank down to ravage and plunder.
Many of Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones remained in the Infinite Omniverse within Omniverse X-999.
As his power rose, the weavings he could uncover increased more and more, and what he could see extended out exponentially.
What the Infinite Omniverse itself could see expanded tremendously!

As another part of him devoured and assimilated Hearthraes in the Higher Weavings of Existence, he fully attained the state of One With Existence as he was currently sensing the elevated form of power one could gain with it.
But not too far back...
|An unfathomable change has occurred within the Omniverse around us.|
Both he and the Infinite Omniverse sensed it.
The Omniversal Authorities went wild.
They became firmer and filled with even grander waves of power as when Noah, The Weaver, placed his gaze out there...
"The Imperium Autarch?"
He tracked down the source to a single man as he then viewed his actions through the eyes of Henry and Sona.

But not even a minute after this, his gaze shot up across layers of weavings of Existence as it flickered with brilliance and surprise- sensing the vile aura of someone he just helped in destroying one of the bodies of not too long ago!
It was Savitar!
"Interesting..."
A smile crossed Noah's lips.
He had made too many gains and, even at this moment, was continuing to make gains.
His Infinite Omniverse was the same as he simply needed time to digest all of them and then observe his new level of power.
At this moment, he couldn't be grouped as an Autarchical Existence any longer at the Existential Dominium Realm.
But he also didn't fit in the Omniversal Stage as he didn't forge a Fabled Omniverse!
But his power...
As someone who had Transcended their existence, and now as his counterpart Ozymandias attained even grander waves of power as well as two Transcendent Megalos Abilities...
It was going to be even harder to quantify him.
This was because at this very moment, he was already doing something utterly balanced breaking.
Ozymandias was a part of him that he shared an unbreakable connection with, but he was himself within the Megalos Beyond.

His body in the Megalos Ynnere was also himself as at this moment, within the sea of existence inside his body seated on the multicolored throne...he was pulling upon countless tendrils of Outerversal Authority and the particles of Dark Matter still flowing from the connection with Ozymandias.
The heavy flow of the stellar obsidian radiance still flowing from the Megalos Beyond and into the Infinite Omniverse through Ozymandias.
He pulled upon all of it as in the sea of his complex existence...the rune of AMARANTOS was nearly formed completely.
Yes.
The Transcendent Megalos Ability that the Great Beyonder sculpted in the Megalos Beyond would also appear in the Megalos Ynnere!
With his existence split in half but connected in an unfathomable way across two Megalos, Noah actually brought forth this shocking boon.
His existence inherited this Ability as Ozymandias, and passing this Inheritance to another part of his existence was seamless!
So even as the terrifying aura of a Great One approached Omniverse X-999, he wasn't too worried.
First, there was the change of Imperium to observe and understand- with this being the first barrier for the coming Outerversal Morphon.
And then, there was himself. HUUM!
The radiant rune of AMARANTOS finished forming.
After this, the rune of DEFY would soon start thereafter.

But first...seas of golden obsidian radiance from the Dream Aletheian Haven rolled and surged into the newly formed rune of AMARANTOS, ecstatic brilliance unfolding as in the next moment...Noah let out a devilish smile.
"Dream."

But in the coming future, you will have to fight for your home.
I will bring all forces of the Commonwealth here under my control, and after that, we will-...!|
The gaze of Imperium flickered from calmness to sternness very quickly.
He gazed out into the far distance as if he could see something nobody else could.
|It seems blessings and catastrophes come hand in hand...|
He spoke cryptically as he felt something approach the bounds of this Omniverse.
A power he had captured glimpses of in the arena when Osmont unveiled the Agent of Anti-Life!
The heavy aura of an Outerversal Morphon was coming towards the Omniverse!
Across the swathes of endless void governed by unbreakable Omniversal Authorities, Omniverse X-999 had bounds where its vast domain ended.
Near the ends of such a vast domain, a terrifying Skull with thousands of limbs behind it neared.
Purple flames burned in its sockets as it stared at the pristine Omniverse below with a devilish gaze.
|Hmph, I've taken a big loss recently, so let this be my gain.
Slaughter is much easier than other methods as today, I shall reap some souls for myself...|
The One Who Walks...had made his way over to Omniverse X-999 after following the weavings given by the Great Ponderor.
He didn't know that veiled and a distance away from here, a terrifying entity with an opened Eye of Existence observed everything closely- this being the Great Ponderor himself!
He had been observing Omniverse X-999 this whole time to learn about his enemy- Protector Osmont.
To learn everything about him and reveal which of the Great Ones he was or which one he was connected to.

But...he just came across a shocking conference of Existential authority in his observations, and much of his gaze was then restricted from there as he wasn't able to see everything even with the Eye of Existence!
What was this?
Just what was this odd Omniverse, and what more could be found from it?
Nietzsche observed calmly while veiled as voraciously, Savitar sank down to ravage and plunder.
Many of Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones remained in the Infinite Omniverse within Omniverse X-999.
As his power rose, the weavings he could uncover increased more and more, and what he could see extended out exponentially.
What the Infinite Omniverse itself could see expanded tremendously!

As another part of him devoured and assimilated Hearthraes in the Higher Weavings of Existence, he fully attained the state of One With Existence as he was currently sensing the elevated form of power one could gain with it.
But not too far back...
|An unfathomable change has occurred within the Omniverse around us.|
Both he and the Infinite Omniverse sensed it.
The Omniversal Authorities went wild.
They became firmer and filled with even grander waves of power as when Noah, The Weaver, placed his gaze out there...
"The Imperium Autarch?"
He tracked down the source to a single man as he then viewed his actions through the eyes of Henry and Sona.

But not even a minute after this, his gaze shot up across layers of weavings of Existence as it flickered with brilliance and surprise- sensing the vile aura of someone he just helped in destroying one of the bodies of not too long ago!
It was Savitar!
"Interesting..."
A smile crossed Noah's lips.
He had made too many gains and, even at this moment, was continuing to make gains.
His Infinite Omniverse was the same as he simply needed time to digest all of them and then observe his new level of power.
At this moment, he couldn't be grouped as an Autarchical Existence any longer at the Existential Dominium Realm.
But he also didn't fit in the Omniversal Stage as he didn't forge a Fabled Omniverse!
But his power...
As someone who had Transcended their existence, and now as his counterpart Ozymandias attained even grander waves of power as well as two Transcendent Megalos Abilities...
It was going to be even harder to quantify him.
This was because at this very moment, he was already doing something utterly balanced breaking.
Ozymandias was a part of him that he shared an unbreakable connection with, but he was himself within the Megalos Beyond.

His body in the Megalos Ynnere was also himself as at this moment, within the sea of existence inside his body seated on the multicolored throne...he was pulling upon countless tendrils of Outerversal Authority and the particles of Dark Matter still flowing from the connection with Ozymandias.
The heavy flow of the stellar obsidian radiance still flowing from the Megalos Beyond and into the Infinite Omniverse through Ozymandias.
He pulled upon all of it as in the sea of his complex existence...the rune of AMARANTOS was nearly formed completely.
Yes.
The Transcendent Megalos Ability that the Great Beyonder sculpted in the Megalos Beyond would also appear in the Megalos Ynnere!
With his existence split in half but connected in an unfathomable way across two Megalos, Noah actually brought forth this shocking boon.
His existence inherited this Ability as Ozymandias, and passing this Inheritance to another part of his existence was seamless!
So even as the terrifying aura of a Great One approached Omniverse X-999, he wasn't too worried.
First, there was the change of Imperium to observe and understand- with this being the first barrier for the coming Outerversal Morphon.
And then, there was himself.
HUUM!
The radiant rune of AMARANTOS finished forming.
After this, the rune of DEFY would soon start thereafter.

But first...seas of golden obsidian radiance from the Dream Aletheian Haven rolled and surged into the newly formed rune of AMARANTOS, ecstatic brilliance unfolding as in the next moment...Noah let out a devilish smile.
"Dream."

chapters.title: Chapter 3283 The Wheel Turns! V
paragraphs: Something that had only ever appeared in the Megalos Beyond.
Something that the Great Beyonder put in place for the Outerversal Morphons to overcome the complexity of their existence to reach higher and higher stages!
At this moment, it truly landed in the hands of someone from another place entirely.
At this time, Noah's visage of the throne closed his eyes as he fell into a long dream.
As if he had been asleep for far too long.
When he woke up, he found himself in the middle of a bloody battlefield.
Around him, all kinds of sounds blared as rivers of crimson gold blood flowed freely on the shattered domain of existence he was on.

Far above, stellar auroras of multicolored light converged as battles were still erupting out, his eyes that belonged to a Paracosm Stage Entity observing Protectors of the Commonwealth facing off against horrific Worms filled with obsidian radiance.
As they fought, they radiated chants that seemed to give them power- illusory wheels appearing around them with terrifying brilliance as they stopped the advancement of the Worms of Existence!
|The purity of existence is what keeps the Wheel turning! O natives of Omniverse X-1038, make sure your existence is pure and seeking a single thing!|
Omniverse X-1038.
A number exceeding X-999.
This Dream...was shockingly a dream of a time that had not even come yet.
It was terrific to come across as Noah felt his body that held a mess of a Conceptual System of Existence filled with a myriad of concepts.
Death. Regality. Destruction. Water. Chaos...
There were many concepts making up this body of a Paracosm soldier.
But after hearing the words of the Protectors above, he wanted to see this conjecture of purity he had heard before that kept the wheel turning.
So he looked at the mess of concepts inside of him...and destroyed them all entirely as from their remnants...
'Quintessence.'
WAA!
His soul remembered Quintessence clearly.
He had lived it. He had forged it.
Like a lost seed, it quickly began to bloom as in the future, he would only focus on Quintessence for all his weavings of existence.
The Purity of existence kept the Wheel turning.
He would put this to a test as within Omniverse X-1038, life moved on.
A year passed, and the Paracosm body he occupied became an Autarch. He was adorned with the distinction of the Quintessential Autarch!

The Protectors of the Commonwealth guarded this Omniverse as he found that at a certain point in the past, changes had occurred that allowed Omniverses to be discovered rapidly by the Commonwealth as their reach only became stronger.
They pushed back the Worms of Existence within this Omniverse, but they seemed unkillable as they always came back and ravaged this Omniverse and many more.
Their numbers propagated much more rapidly than before, and their power was even grander!
The Omniverse he was in turned into one of constant wars and death as in such a state, hundreds of years began to pass.

The distinction of an Apogee Autarch was attained rather quickly as in these hundreds of years, Quintessence was solely focused on to the extent that its complexity...even became capable of affecting the Worms of Existence that tore apart this Omniverse!

In all these years, he was finally able to join the ranks of Protectors as the first thing he sought to do was to track down Omniverse X-999. Would it have himself? Or did he not exist in this Dream entirely? The day he became a Protector, he expressed curiosity towards the older Protectors of the Commonwealth stationed here about expanding his knowledge and visiting other Omniverses, expressing curiosity about X-999 especially!
The Simian Protector looked at him with a sharp gaze at such words before he replied.
|Omniverse X-999...is an anomaly that is still unsolved by the Commonwealth. It has disappeared within the Megalos Ynnere as even now, it is nowhere to be found.|
Shocking words.
Ones that acted akin to a trigger as at this point, the Quintessential Protector felt his mind become hazy.
He almost felt like he was slumbering, and yet at the same time he was awake...but somewhere else.
His gaze became divided.
This dream still continued, but he felt a part of himself opening his eyes within another Dream entirely.
A dream still continued, but answer one started!
This was...was in the Megalos Beyond.
A star shaped Outerversal Morphon opened its single eye as around him, the auras of terrifying Morphons pulsed heavily.
Among them, multiple intents echoed out.
|Is it true? That the Great Beyonder has constructed an unbeatable Crucible on our Pantheon?|
The words instantly caused Noah's single eye to shine brilliantly as he awoke fully.
Another Dream.
And in this Dream, it seemed to be countless cycles ago...before the Great Beyonder had disappeared!
Memories flooded into his mind.
He was Outerversal Morphon Starbright, a native of the Megalos Pantheon of Xerxes.

The groups of Outerversal Morphons he was with were entities who frequently moved with him within this Pantheon, and they were currently in the Undersun Sanctuary that was akin to a citadel ten times the size of an Existential Domain.
Massive obsidian structures and statues filled this place as currently, it was abuzz with the news and weavings of the strongest Outerversal Morphon.
The unfathomable Great Beyonder!

|The Crucible...apparently our Pantheon is not the first. In the Pantheon of Umbra, the Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was built- nobody knows anything about it as any who have tried it have failed.|
|Oh? And the Crucible here?|
The voices and intents rose with deep power and curiosity as a single answer came.
|The Crucible of the Sword of Megalos...|
Noah's weavings buzzed as he came across the mention of a third Crucible.
All of it was mixed with unknown mysteries as the being responsible for it all...was present in his current Dream!
Who...was the Great Beyonder?
A dreamer questioned as he delved fully into another unfathomable Dream. —
Present time, outside of the Dream a certain Emperor traversed in.
Within the Megalos Beyond, in a Megalos Pantheon.

Within a large obsidian deluge of a river that snaked across a massive mountain, hundreds of small squid like Outerversal Morphon trembled as they gazed up to look at an amalgamation of black flames above them.
They trembled not just because of the power he radiated, but also because this was the being who had forcefully bound them as Delegatus not too long ago!

chapters.title: Chapter 3284 The Wheel Turns! VI
paragraphs: He had bound them not long ago.
And now, he appeared above them in a terrifying manner.

They couldn't entirely make out his form apart from long spanning obsidian wings that seemed to be melding into the Megalos Beyond itself, and when he stopped above them...they shockingly observed dew drops to begin gathering in the surroundings before moments later, rain began to fall.
Rain!
Seeing this, they were utterly stupefied.
Rain?
Was this not the Sign of the Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of? Something occurring all the way in the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra?
What...was this in front of them?
In the next moment, a deep intent that seemed that of a child and an adult rang out at the same time.
|You all were saying there is a Sign? An Instrument that someone spoke of?|
The voice caused them to shudder.
Down to the very depths of their existence, they felt like the intent of this voice alone could do far too many things as they were stupefied.
Seeing their stunned state, this being clouded by stellar obsidian mist instantly flickered out with a few hundred black tentacles for all small morphons here.
|Let me see your memories.|
WUU!
A calm swirling of Outerversal Authority.
And within moments, the squid like Morphons were dazed while all parts of their existence were ready, the tentacles that bound them getting tighter as the one responsible radiated a shocking intent!
|Connections at birth? Rain? The Instrument of the Great Beyonder...is that not me?|
The voice seemed amused and curious at the same time.
Filled with curiosity...and yet immense waves of loathing at the same time.
But the loathing was very subtle.
As if it could barely be felt, akin to being pushed extremely far down the depths of its existence!
|Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias...quite the Pretender, aren't you?|
Someone was out there pretending to be him.
Pretending to be in a position of power and standing that he did not deserve.
No matter.
He was just born.
He needed to find himself.
His purpose.
Was it truly as the memories of these Morphons stated?
Something already deemed and set in stone by the Great Beyonder?
|The Great Beyonder...who are you to dictate what comes and what will be?|
The question was filled with interminable curiosity.
And this...was the first direction that this newly born entity followed. It wanted to understand more of the Great Beyonder as it turned towards the depths of this Pantheon it had appeared in.
It would learn. It would grow. And in the future, it will meet this Ozymandias.
But before them...
BOOM!
Above its body, millions of golden lines gushed out again and spread out across the Megalos to bind onto more Delegatus.
Whether they wanted to or not!
In the Megalos Nihilos.
In a region filled with white blackness, a few hundred massive worms with crystalline black scales and sharp white wings crossed through space rapidly.
Hundreds of jagged teeth could be seen clattering on mouths placed on different areas of their bodies, no eyes present on these Entities.
Yet their intent and weavings were filled with Anti-Matter!
|The signal is close. Get into the Genesis Formation and prepare for battle if need be.|
|Yes.|
|Affirmative.|
Voices rose and fell after the first one as the massive bodies of worms radiated complex weavings that would make Foundation Autarchs tremble.
They weaved across the white space as thin black lines emerged from each of them and connected to each other, their positions constantly shifting and moving as within moments...
BOOM!
Their bodies faded away as a titanic illusory form of a Nine Horned Winged Worm of Existence emerged.
A rare entity lost countless cycles ago and only mentioned by Great entities within the Megalos Nihilos.

Its form emerged as hundreds of Worms of Existence formed a unique formation, the aura it radiated instantly shooting past Foundation, Accumulation, and Apogee Autarchical levels of power as it very quickly settled at the Omniversal Stage!
Its speed also blazed as it tore across space to cautiously appear where they all felt the signal.
And there, a distance away, they could see roaring waves of auroras and seas of Anti-Matter.
Deeply white with a tinge of gray, and at the center of it all...a black and white worm with feathery wings stretched out gloriously.

Nine blazing eyes that shone like singularities currently opened and closed as if they were acclimating and looking around curiously, these eyes locking onto the newly arriving formation of the Nine Horned Winged Worm of Existence as the moment they did so...
BZZT!
The massive formation shuddered as the worms within were shocked by the aura of regality and domination radiated from the eyes of this being.
It caused their very weavings to feel subservient- as if it stemmed from the very depths of their existence!
A single glance from it caused the Nine Horned Winged Worm of Existence to bow its head as its intent echoed out.
|We see the brilliance of the Great Worm and bow our existences.|
Their intent echoed out with clarity.

Opposite them, the feathery Winged worm with nine eyes blinked as it sought to understand already complex weavings of existence flooding into it, and seeing this new reality, Eckert could not help but utter out silently.
'What the fuck is going on, huh?'
Too many changes were occurring all at once.
But seeing the subservient cluster of Worms of Existence in the distance...
HUUM!
Strands of white tendrils of light erupted from his new body as they were filled with potent waves of Anti-Matter.

They went to latch towards the faint Worms that made up the massive formation as, at the very least, he would subjugate them as he further understood where he was currently at and what these complex weavings of existence he received truly meant!
Subtle changes bloomed.
Not just within Megalos Beyond, but within Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Nihilos as well.
The Wheel had taken a turn, whether many entities knew it or not.
As for what all the changes would bring? Nobody could say for sure!
But at this moment, there was a single man that was dreaming.
Dreaming of the Megalos Beyond, and Dreaming of the Megalos Ynnere!

chapters.title: Chapter 3285 Odd I
paragraphs: The Dreams were unique.
The Dreams were long.
The proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was low as Noah knew it wouldn't allow him to spend too many years within a Dream.

Going by the Dreams of Ozymandias, a range of 2,000 to 3,000 years was the maximum currently, and he had to ensure that he didn't expose himself to any Great Ones or entities of similar power as they would know he was a Dreamer.
An oddity that, similar to the last Dream of Ozymandias, he would be killed and the Dream would come to an end!
So even though he appeared at a time when the Great Beyonder was active, he only collected information about this entity while preparing to obtain the biggest possible gain from this Dream.
The Transcendent Megalos Ability, the Sword of the Megalos!
He didn't have his Infinite Mana, his Infinite Omniverse, or his Atlas of Existence, but he could still bring a semblance of what made him outstanding into these dreams.
He could take his power to be a level above others as gradually, the weavings of these Dreams became clear.
He felt like he was walking across past records if the Dream was in the past, and if the dream was of the future, he felt like he was walking across a possible future.
A fragment of the weavings of Existence.

Because in the Dream of the Megalos Ynnere where he had risen to be a Protector of the Commonwealth while he relied on Quintessence alone, over two thousand years passed as he elevated himself in power and battled Outerversal Morphons and Worms of Existence who seemed to be invading with even greater fervor.
2,000 years into the future.
This was what entirely convinced him that this Dream was a jump into a possible weavings of Existence- a mere fragment that didn't take into account many things.
Because how long had he been active since the blue planet faced an apocalypse? A mere few years!
And look at the level of power he had reached.

Would 2,000 years truly pass thereafter where nothing about himself could be heard? Where those of the Megalos Beyond, Megalos Ynnere, and Megalos Nihilos still fought as the Three Body Problem continued to remain unsolved?

In all these years, he heard nothing of the weavings of Noah Osmont as he treated this Dream as a mere fragment of existence to further increase his strength and obtain as much information as he could for what possibilities there were.
3,000 years passed within the Dream.
And on that mark...the terrific voice of the Viceroy of the Commonwealth echoed out across the bases of the Protectors.

|For too long, we have remained passive in defending against our enemies. We shall remain passive no longer. On this day, we have managed to create stable channels that cross from our lands into theirs as we shall bring this war to them!|
A grandiose declaration.
And within days, the forces of the Commonwealth were gathered within recovered Tainted Omniverses that swirled with heavy weavings of Dark Matter Cores.

In front of these Cores, rivers of Dark Matter were being siphoned off as a massive obsidian gateway was formed, with the group of Protectors that Noah belonged to contributing to the campaign against the Outerversal Morphons!
|Fantastic, aren't they?|
Beside him, an Omniversal Protector of the Commonwealth standing shoulder to shoulder with him spoke while gazing at the massive obsidian gates.

|Apparently, the core forces of the Commonwealth have long since transcended their weavings of Existence, and subtle changes have been occurring over these past thousand years that they took advantage of to seamlessly create stable channels across the Megalos. We...may merely be pawns in this war as those above us consider these incursions an expansion of the complexity of existence. Haha...pawns!|

The Omniversal Protector had a smile while they spoke of this as within moments, Legions of the Commonwealth spearheaded by Omniversal Stage Entities crossed through the massive gateway within a Tainted Omniverse.
And there were many recovered Tainted Omniverses where such gates were forged as the forces of the Commonwealth made their way into the Megalos Beyond!
It was a terrific achievement.
The clashing weavings of Matter and Dark Matter could distinctly be felt by Noah as they traversed across immeasurable distances, and in a short period of time...
BOOM!
They made their entry into the Megalos Beyond.

Alongside their entry, titanic golden wheels rose above them and spun with austere glows of power, the stellar obsidian radiance of the Megalos Beyond being pushed back as their group...shockingly appeared above a Pantheon.
At the forefront, Royal Existential Omniversal Simians with terrifying waves of power led these armies with ferocity as below them, booming cries of Outerversal Morphons echoed out.
Monstrosities arose.
Eldritch armies assembled as the forces of the Commonwealth arrived to wage war right before a Pantheon, and an existence breaking battle unfolded!
As Noah and the other Protectors clashed, a unique weaving of existence unfolded.
Noah stared towards an opposing Outerversal Morphon a distance away from him as it was a massive star shaped Morphon with a single eye.
...! It was himself...in his other dream.
The dream whose goal was a Transcendent Megalos Ability that was actually more than halfway achieved!
The moment their eyes met...
HUUUM!
An undeniable pull shut everything down as, after an excess of 3,000 years, the dream came to an end.
Noah felt like he was coming out of an extremely long sleep, his eyes opening to observe an endlessly vast obsidian space.
Within this space, only two singularities shone brightly.
|Due to the low proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, the Dream has been brought to an end after an excess number of years and an intersection of Dreams occurred.|
|Your proficiency in the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos has been elevated to the Second Echelon, with your Proficiency at 1%.|
|Based on this, the weavings of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos you can obtain are somewhat limited.|
|All memories of the Dreams are retained.|
Memories of the past, and memories of the possible future.
All of it buzzed in Noah's mind as a choice had to be made!

chapters.title: Chapter 3286 Odd II
paragraphs: |The Weavings of a single Dream can be retrieved fully, and half the weavings of another Dream can be retrieved.|
|The Two Dreams of the Megalos capable of being chosen are as follows|

[The Quintessential Protector- Conceptual System of Existence Echelon 5. The formation of a Quintessential Fabled Omniverse. Musings of the Ordinance of Quintessence. Omniversal Armaments- Armor of the Commonwealth, Spear of the Commonwealth, Omniversal Voyager II]
[Outerversal Morphon Starbright- Outerversal Physiology Echelon V, Megalos Regnum Echelon V. 458,550,020 Pure Delegatus Channels. Half of the Sword of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability.] ...!
Two dazzling singularities.
Noah only glanced at them for a moment before the choice was made.
[The full weavings of the Quintessential Protector have been retrieved]

[From the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, the following weavings will be granted: Conceptual System of Existence Echelon 5. The formation of a Quintessential Fabled Omniverse. Musings of the Ordinance of Quintessence. Omniversal Armaments- Armor of the Commonwealth, Spear of the Commonwealth, Omniversal Voyager II] [Half of the weavings of Outerversal Morphon Starbright have been retrieved.]
[From the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, the following weaving will be granted: 200,000,000 Pure Delegatus Channels. Half of the Sword of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability.]
[Part of the Dream of Outerversal Morphon Starbright has been forever lost.] He was asleep for an instant.
He dreamed for an instant!
Noah opened his eyes on the multicolored throne as after this passage of an instant, his power was about to jump tremendously once more.
He looked at his fair hands that held vibrant bands pulsing with the grandeur of Transcendence of Existence as if he was returning back to his old self.
A dream of over three thousand years was very real, but within a second, Noah was able to isolate those long memories and break them down as he returned to himself right after.
This was the true reality.
He wouldn't need hundreds or thousands of years to make progress here as in this passing of an instant, he made tremendous gains!
Above his, the weavings of existence themselves seemed to have been violated as the colorless radiance of Quintessence gushed down from a pulsing rune of AMARANTOS.
Not just this, but three Omniversal Armaments were spat out as one was a multicolored armor, a golden Spear, and a miniaturized Vessel that could traverse across the Omniverses of the Megalos Beyond!
But the most astounding thing was Quintessence.
The single, pure concept he had focused on for three thousand years as by doing this...he even gained musings of the Ordinance of Quintessence!
Ordinance.
Dictum.
Decree!
It was the stage after one grasped the Eye of Existence, where they could have a truly and unequivocally extreme weaving of existence that was termed the Ordinance of Existence.
A state where one took all the complexity of their existence and reduced it all to a single thing.
Noah attained mere musings of this possibility even though he had only just arrived at the first State of Existence.
"Mmm, come..."
He beckoned to the terrifying weavings of Quintessence as his First Mundi of Power began to seethe.
Within the boons he retrieved was also an elevation of this System of Existence, and a Fabled Omniverse.
He could effectively leave the shackles of an Autarchical Existence- of someone in the Existential Dominium Realm, and step into the Omniversal Realm!
But...
'I never belonged to any of these Realms to begin with...'
His thoughts were filled with unbound Tyranny as he began to process the weavings of a Fabled Omniverse.
His path was not a simple one where he would forge a Fabled Omniverse like all others and be considered an Omniversal Entity.
This would merely be a part of him.
Even during the dream of a few thousand years, he already theorized and planned for many things.
His First Mundi of Power could take on the weavings of a Fabled Omniverse as he already had a grandiose plan of possibilities for the other Mundis that made his Atlas of Existence!
Within the Outerversal Descent System of Existence, he wanted to enact a Fabled Pantheon.

Within the System of Existence of Kuklos, of Ingeniare, and all others to follow, he wanted them to have something unique and of their own as when all Nine Mundis of Power were filled...what would the product be?
This was something for him to design and look forward to. |Quintessence is becoming undisputed within your Conceptual System of Existence.|

Around him, the obsidian rune of AMARANTOS flashed as rivers of colorless brilliance surged out and covered everything. |Quintessence seeks to break down countless records and make them part of the Quintessential Fabled Omniverse within the First Mundi of Power.|
|Quintessence seeks to compress countless records into a single Quintessential Quark, and from this Quark, bloom the Quintessential Fabled Omniverse.|
The methods of the Commonwealth.

They took all their records and weavings of existence after they became complex enough, compressed it all into a Quark, and then used the compression and explosion of power to bloom a Fabled Omniverse from a single Quark.
Countless quarks erupt from a single one, and this formed the basis of the Fabled Omniverse.
But...unlike the Dream, Noah's System of Existence did not just contain Quintessence.
HUUM!
His Atlas of Existence began to tremble.
|Infinity denies being broken down and assimilated.|
|The Protagonist denies being broken down and assimilated.|
|Entropy denies being broken down and assimilated.|
|Tyranny denies being broken down and assimilated.|
A myriad of other concepts arose in defiance at this moment.
Inside the first Mundi of Power, Quintessence was akin to a massive colorless sun that exceeded all other concepts in size and standing at this moment.
Around it, a blue star representing infinity shone brightly.
A golden star representing the Protagonist released hues of radiance.
There were many other dazzling stars as all of them were either ten or twenty times less in size and stature, but they still glowed brightly in defiance.
Quintessence gazed at their blatant rebellion calmly as if it so chose...it could unleash a cleansing.
BOOM!
The moment this thought even arose, the first Mundi of Power pulsed as seated on the multicolored throne, Noah's body had a massive crack bloom on his chest and extended upward!
He looked at this calmly before he voiced out in a deep tone right after.
|Wrap it up.|
A single command.
And within the First Mundi of Power, the massive star that was Quintessence stopped gazing at all the others and began to spin by itself.
Countless records converged as their main component...was not Quarks alone.
There were Leptons there. There were Psioneutrino Particles there.
Matter. Dark Matter.
The Commonwealth had one methodology for forming a Fabled Omniverse.
The Omniversal Archontes Engineer was now enacting another!

chapters.title: Chapter 3287 Odd III
paragraphs: Everything was contained within the First Mundi of Power.
Quintessence took the boons of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos and began compressing a great deal of Noah's weavings of existence in trillions of Quarks, Leptons, and Psioneutrino Particles.
A vast majority of his weavings...compressed into the smallest fundamental Particles of Existence that made him!
Thereafter...
These trillions of Quarks, Leptons, and Psioneutrino Particles began to be forcefully fused into each other.
A convergence of all that terrifying authority.
From trillions to billions. From billions to millions!
HUUM!

The amount of weaving being compressed created a shocking storm of power as they continued to fuse into each other, their mass and density reaching unfathomable levels along with their levels of energy!

When only 1,000 Quarks, Leptons, and Psioneutrino Particles remained, they found it hard to fuse as here, the colorless brilliance of the Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence surged down in waves.
A thousand became 500.
500 became 250!

It seemed to become extremely hard to continue as three separate clouds covered by the grandeur of Quintessence had powerful particles being stabilized while they smashed into each other, but they still needed a spark.
Something to drive everything home.
And...
BOOM!
Seas of deeply blue brilliance surged from the depths of Noah's existence.
Endless waves of extremely pure mana.
A form of energy purest in nature as it further stabilized every single particle, its endless influx causing all of them to instantly fuse into each other until...
A single radiant Quark.
A blazing Lepton.
An iridescent Psioneutrino.
They seemed to contain endless waves of records and brilliance at this moment, and these three particles...acted as the base for something utterly grandiose.
Quintessence bound them all heavily when they were trillions.
Now converged into single particles, Quintessence was ever tighter around them as these three singularities began to spin.
Spin and spin!

They spun and pulled each other with a terrifying force that was possible of even ripping apart tens of Apogee Autarchs, and all of such force buzzed within Noah's existence as eventually...these spinning singularities were moving so fast that it seemed like only a single orb of light was present.
|The Quintus Core of Existence has been successfully formed.|
|The Basis of the Quintessential Fabled Omniverse has been stabilized.|
From the Core.
An explosion bloomed out- an explosion so regal and contained as from it, a circular Omniverse shining with dazzling colorless and golden waves of light emerged.
|The First Fabled Omniverse within the Conceptual System of Existence is blooming.|
The first.
It was an indication that there would be more.
Today, it was Quintessence that took the first step!
Within the first Mundi of Power, the Protagonist did not just sit still while observing this process.
Because from the eruption of this Quintessential Fabled Omniverse, all of Noah's weavings became much more complex and potent as the Protagonist grabbed onto this complexity!
Paradox grabbed onto this increasing complexity.
Cheats grabbed onto this elevation of Existence!

Infinity, Uncertainty, Relativity...every single concept jumped on the train that Quintessence led as if they were small, tiny stars before, they began to enlarge and shine brilliantly within the First Mundi of Power.
Seated on the multicolored throne, Noah's existence, which was already being exponentially raised by the constant devouring of Hearthraes in the Expanse, proceeded to have another jump in complexity!
Around his body that simmered with radiance, the illusion of a colorless gold Omniverse flashed for the first time.
It was a glorious result due to a single Dream.
As this unfolded, the rune of an obsidian SWORD formed within his existence near AMARANTOS and DEFY, another Transcendent Megalos Ability being inherited even though it was only half.
This whole time, the Omniversal Archontes Engineer took everything in and quantified exactly what it all meant and translated to in terms of his power!
Because as a result of what was occurring in his First Mundi of Power, the Value of his Atlas of Existence rose tremendously.

Because of the continued added weavings relating to the Megalos Beyond, and the millions of pure Channels gained from the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos that were taken by Ozymandias...his System of Existence of Outerversal Descent also rose tremendously!
It was a rapid advancement that needed at least a few seconds to be digested.
But were there even these seconds to spare?
Outerversal Morphon.
It was a unique distinction, and one that was made even more unique when one attained the distinction of a Great One.
A Great One.
Even among such beings...Savitar felt like he didn't truly belong.
His Empire was not as great as others.
His reach was not as extensive.
Even his State of Existence...he felt like he was infinitely close to attaining the Eye of Existence, and yet he never grasped it even now.
The most recent failure only made his faults more glaring as at this moment...he just wanted to let loose.
To release untold destruction as within him- within his Outerversal Physiology that held a burning skeletal heart within his Skull, it craved destruction.
It craved death and decimation to the extent that he had once lost himself in a state of frenzy and decimated an entire Omniverse!
This spoke more to the loose control of the Complexity of his Existence, but he wanted to be in that free state once more.
|Recoup my losses and turn everything within into Existence Reapers...and just let loose for the first time in a while.|
As he stared at the distant and yet massive outline of an Omniverse, he was akin to a speck of dust in size.
But even with this difference in size, he knew he could decimate such a vast space freely!
And so...
He walked.
He turned into a streak of black light that sought to break past the thick boundary of Omniversal Authorities that governed this Omniverse and enjoy the life forms within it!
|Kakaka! Let it begin!|
His cacklings echoed out as...
BOOM!

It seemed to become extremely hard to continue as three separate clouds covered by the grandeur of Quintessence had powerful particles being stabilized while they smashed into each other, but they still needed a spark.
Something to drive everything home.
And...
BOOM!
Seas of deeply blue brilliance surged from the depths of Noah's existence.
Endless waves of extremely pure mana.
A form of energy purest in nature as it further stabilized every single particle, its endless influx causing all of them to instantly fuse into each other until...
A single radiant Quark.
A blazing Lepton.
An iridescent Psioneutrino.
They seemed to contain endless waves of records and brilliance at this moment, and these three particles...acted as the base for something utterly grandiose.
Quintessence bound them all heavily when they were trillions.
Now converged into single particles, Quintessence was ever tighter around them as these three singularities began to spin.
Spin and spin!

They spun and pulled each other with a terrifying force that was possible of even ripping apart tens of Apogee Autarchs, and all of such force buzzed within Noah's existence as eventually...these spinning singularities were moving so fast that it seemed like only a single orb of light was present.
|The Quintus Core of Existence has been successfully formed.|
|The Basis of the Quintessential Fabled Omniverse has been stabilized.|
From the Core.
An explosion bloomed out- an explosion so regal and contained as from it, a circular Omniverse shining with dazzling colorless and golden waves of light emerged.
|The First Fabled Omniverse within the Conceptual System of Existence is blooming.|
The first.
It was an indication that there would be more.
Today, it was Quintessence that took the first step!
Within the first Mundi of Power, the Protagonist did not just sit still while observing this process.
Because from the eruption of this Quintessential Fabled Omniverse, all of Noah's weavings became much more complex and potent as the Protagonist grabbed onto this complexity!
Paradox grabbed onto this increasing complexity.
Cheats grabbed onto this elevation of Existence!

Infinity, Uncertainty, Relativity...every single concept jumped on the train that Quintessence led as if they were small, tiny stars before, they began to enlarge and shine brilliantly within the First Mundi of Power.
Seated on the multicolored throne, Noah's existence, which was already being exponentially raised by the constant devouring of Hearthraes in the Expanse, proceeded to have another jump in complexity!
Around his body that simmered with radiance, the illusion of a colorless gold Omniverse flashed for the first time.
It was a glorious result due to a single Dream.
As this unfolded, the rune of an obsidian SWORD formed within his existence near AMARANTOS and DEFY, another Transcendent Megalos Ability being inherited even though it was only half.
This whole time, the Omniversal Archontes Engineer took everything in and quantified exactly what it all meant and translated to in terms of his power!
Because as a result of what was occurring in his First Mundi of Power, the Value of his Atlas of Existence rose tremendously.

Because of the continued added weavings relating to the Megalos Beyond, and the millions of pure Channels gained from the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos that were taken by Ozymandias...his System of Existence of Outerversal Descent also rose tremendously!
It was a rapid advancement that needed at least a few seconds to be digested.
But were there even these seconds to spare?
Outerversal Morphon.
It was a unique distinction, and one that was made even more unique when one attained the distinction of a Great One.
A Great One.
Even among such beings...Savitar felt like he didn't truly belong.
His Empire was not as great as others.
His reach was not as extensive.
Even his State of Existence...he felt like he was infinitely close to attaining the Eye of Existence, and yet he never grasped it even now.
The most recent failure only made his faults more glaring as at this moment...he just wanted to let loose.
To release untold destruction as within him- within his Outerversal Physiology that held a burning skeletal heart within his Skull, it craved destruction.
It craved death and decimation to the extent that he had once lost himself in a state of frenzy and decimated an entire Omniverse!
This spoke more to the loose control of the Complexity of his Existence, but he wanted to be in that free state once more.
|Recoup my losses and turn everything within into Existence Reapers...and just let loose for the first time in a while.|
As he stared at the distant and yet massive outline of an Omniverse, he was akin to a speck of dust in size.
But even with this difference in size, he knew he could decimate such a vast space freely!
And so...
He walked.
He turned into a streak of black light that sought to break past the thick boundary of Omniversal Authorities that governed this Omniverse and enjoy the life forms within it!
|Kakaka!
Let it begin!|
His cacklings echoed out as...
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3288 Odd IV
paragraphs: His massive flaming skull smashed head first into the thick boundary of Omniversal Authorities as...he was actually pushed back while the boundary trembled.
|What?|
He stared at the boundary in amazement as he had never come across this.
He had taken over a dozen Omniverses himself as he remembered how it felt every time he entered it.
Whether it was through pure power like now, or whether he had a Delegatus within that he sacrificed to begin his Descent.
They could never stop his entry like this!
He looked at the Omniverse with burning purple flames as he wondered with a hint of expectations.
|An Exalted Omniverse?!|
His flames instantly rose higher.
Exalted.
Every now and then, unique Omniverses would be discovered that held terrifying resistance or resonance to the Dark Matter of the Megalos Beyond.
Even the inhabitants of the Commonwealth themselves had no way of finding out whether an Omniverse was Exalted or not unless they utilized Outerversal Authority!

But whenever an Outerversal Morphon discovered such an Omniverse, they came to find that the successful induction of a Dark Matter Core within such an Omniverse would create a terrifying Quintus Dark Matter Core!

A core that was many times more valuable that with it, they could absorb terrifyingly pure levels of Dark Matter that would aid one in elevating the Echelons of their Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum past the 7th and 8th Echelons.
Exalted Omniverses were rare.
The weavings of Omniversal Authorities that bound them were extremely complex!
Some of the more powerful Great Ones were lucky enough to find such an Omniverse as their power only became more cemented thereafter.
|Haha...is it time for I, Savitar, to actually make tremendous gains?|
His flames burned brightly as in his joy, the only thing preventing full euphoria was the fact that the Great Ponderor knew about the location of this Omniverse.

And he stated blatantly that once Savitar began his slaughter, Protectors of the Commonwealth would be drawn here as this was what the Great Ponderor wanted- a diversion so that he could attain something else!
He had to change plans.
He couldn't just rampage.
|Find the Protectors, bind them, and prevent any communications. If I can successfully shift the location of this Omniverse from its anchor within the Megalos Ynnere...then it will all be mine.|
His weavings burned brightly.
He approached the boundary filled with complex Omniversal Authorities, not smashing into it this time as the many limbs behind him grabbed onto it as if they were claws.
After thousands of limbs sank in, he thrust his skull forward as his body began to meld with Existence itself!
One With Existence.
It covered his whole body as after a brief clash and struggle...
HUUM!
The boundary vibrated as his body seamlessly passed through.
A Great One delved into an Exalted Omniverse.
A distance away, a cloud of black darkness was watching this in a stupor while cursing.
|It was an Exalted Omniverse? And I fucking shared it's coordinates? This...this...!|
The Great Ponderor simmered in a low rage before he calmed himself.
He couldn't have known unless he tried to enter himself and extend his reach.
He calmly brooded before moments later, he decided on a course of action.
At the center of the mist, a massive Eye of Existence was kept active as the weavings of Protector Osmont sought to be discovered and read much more.
This Morphon veiled as a Protector was actually hiding in an Exalted Omniverse? And he didn't make it his?
It caused him to be even more cautious of this being.
Unless he absolutely understood him and his weaknesses, he would not make a move!
So for now...he would observe how the threat of Savitar would be dealt with. From there, he could alter his plans!
Inside Omniverse X-999.
A golden haired man was surrounded by seas of multicolored Omniversal Authorities as he opened his eyes.
They shone like luminous suns that further brightened the golden sea around him, and he looked towards his Exarchs and the forces of the Imperium he had raised to the current stage as he sighed.
|You all have come far, but are nowhere close to being capable of handling a threat like this.|
A threat.

He sensed it the moment it tried to gain entry, and after it successfully gained entry as through the countless intricate weavings of the Omniverse that he was bound to, he could even track the location of the Outsider that had appeared!
An Outsider.
His aura was retracted as he waded through the Omniverse silently, not even leaking out a semblance of his aura as he seemed to be looking for something.
Its deathly skull radiated waves of black light as it seemed to be looking for directions before it began going in a straight line toward a certain place.
Where the forces of the Commonwealth were clustered since they discovered this Omniverse!
Imperium observed such a scene with complex weavings emerging and falling within him as sensing the power of this being, he questioned being capable of expelling him at his current state.
He had only just begun to familiarize himself with his new power.
There was still much he didn't know!
But for the sake of this Omniverse...
WAP!
His main body disappeared.
Just like when he made the heavy choice with another Outsider, the Lumen Emperor...he would make the same choice today.
All to protect this Omniverse he was in!
The Omniversal Ankyra silently moved.
In another region within this Omniverse, Noah remained within the bounds of the Infinite Omniverse that was akin to a grain of sand compared to its vastness.
He sensed the heavy presence of Dark Matter- of the Outerversal Morphon seeking to hide its aura while it moved as to him...there was no way it could hide!

The sensitivity to Dark Matter for the Infinite Omniverse was currently at an all-time high while it assimilated a Dark Matter Core and continued to expand its breadth and complexity with the authority of the Megalos Beyond itself.
And himself...a grandiose colorless gold Omniverse swirled magnificently as his existence currently emanated terrifying waves of power.
Power so suffocating that any Apogee Autarch may be forced to fall on their knees!

chapters.title: Chapter 3289 Unlucky! I
paragraphs: He sat on the throne filled with countless multicolored threads that extended into the Infinite Omniverse.
He laid back languidly as around him, three Omniversal Armaments swirled like galaxies around a colorless gold Omniverse that twinkled with radiance!
The Armor of the Commonwealth, the Spear of the Commonwealth, and the Omniversal Voyager II to traverse across the Megalos Ynnere.

Multicolored radiance shone from each of them as these boons of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos were all things that Noah finished analyzing while he kept tabs on the rapidly moving signature of an Outerversal Morphon he recognized!
"Savitar..."
Noah had a smile on his face as he tapped the throne he sat on.
The eyes of the Weaver saw across countless threads as very quickly, a few possibilities arose.
For this same Great One to appear in his Omniverse, it was naturally connected to the Half Tainted Omniverse he raided with the Equestris Protectors.
There, he had aided in the destruction of the body of Savitar, but there was another hidden Entity who also helped in this- the backer behind Protector Lucretia!
Noah had stolen from whatever boons this being planned to get from one of Savitar's bodies perishing as he had gotten under its gaze and now...
"You've even backtracked to the home of Protector Osmont..."
Noah stroked his chin as he thought languidly.
It should be something easy with Protector Lucretia as his Delegatus, but for thus being to not even come forward himself and to instead send Savitar, the same Morphon he plotted against...
"You are a schemer," Noah spoke confidently as he rose from his throne.
An Outerversal Morphon within Omniverse X-999.
An Outerversal Morphon likely outside of it observing everything.
In front of him, space distorted as another version of him appeared before his main body.
It was the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence.
Standing stupendously in the Fifth Phase of Ascendancy, Quintessence outshone all others as colorless gold robes draped over him.
Bands of stellar radiance covered his skin underneath, and his hair sparkled with the astral light of an unfathomable omniverse.
A Quintessential Fabled Omniverse!
Born from Matter and Dark Matter.

Occupying vast stretches of space within the First Mundi of Power, this Fabled Omniverse made Quintessence paramount at this moment as if Noah faced the Worms of Existence again, he wouldn't even need the Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence to be capable of wounding them!
Noah looked at himself as the prompts he ignored came down all at once.
|The Quintessential Fabled Omniverse has been forged within your Existence as you have escaped the bounds of the Existential Dominium Realm.|
|You have touched upon the established ranking of the Omniversal Realm that cannot truly distinguish your complexity.|
|The demarcation of power within the Omniversal Stage is being studied and analyzed.|

|The role of Quintessence has been greatly expanded, and its effects on the weavings of existence are currently stipulated to be capable of altering the quality of the highest forms and most complex weavings of existence.|
Within him, all other concepts couldn't say a single thing at this moment as Quintessence truly took center stage!
But this was only part of Noah's achievements.

|The Transcendent Megalos Ability, the Sword of the Megalos(Half), has been fully analyzed. With the Rune of this Transcendent Megalos Ability as the key, one can release an output of 150% of their Complexity of Existence, and the surrounding weavings of existence covering the size of half an Omniverse will naturally be drawn into this attack. If one has attained the state of One With Existence, 90% of the cost of this ability will be paid for by the surrounding weavings of existence. If one has attained the state of Ordinance of Existence, the output of the released attack could be increased by a range of 100% to 1,000,000% depending on the type of Ordinance.|

|The Transcendent Megalos Ability, the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos(Half), has been fully analyzed. With the Rune of this Transcendent Megalos Ability as the key, one can constantly change the quality of their Physiology to resist and even eventually nullify weaker weavings of Existence. Items, constructs, naturally occurring treasures of Existence, and certain unique authorities are required in order to build up the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos. The First Echelon that can be successfully cultivated is the Bastion of Existence, with the Second Echelon- Existence Defying, only available in the full inheritance of this Transcendent Megalos Ability.|
In addition to a shocking elevation of Quintessence, there were of course, the two Transcendent Megalos Abilities apart from the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos Beyond.
These two Abilities seemed to be just as terrifying as the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos Beyond, and Noah put them into account when he looked at himself and his level of power at this moment.
[Atlas of Existence Echelon 2 (1,333,855/100,000,000)]---[Laborer]---[Administrator]
[Conceptual System of Existence Echelon 5 (19,930,375/100,000,000)]---[Dominium Organs]---[Omniversal Control]---[Omniversal Mantle]---[Fabled Omniverse]
[Outerversal Descent System of Existence Echelon 3 (3,754,448/5,000,000)]---[Outerversal Siphoning]
His existence was elevating rapidly and steadily.
As his main body looked at his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence, he nodded while urging the rune of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos to begin churning.
"Let's go test this power against another body of Savitar. This time, it won't be a team battle..."
His eyes were bright as his Clone of Quintessence disappeared.
And before his eyes...

|The Transcendent Megalos Ability, Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos, seeks a source of authority, Items, constructs, or any naturally occurring treasures of Existence that can be broken down to cultivate the first Echelon, the Bastion of Existence.|
The rune spun hungrily while asking for something.

And Noah didn't answer it yet as, in the next moment, a crimson gold light flashed from his chest and formed into the visage of a dazzling bejeweled young woman whose entire existence shone with resplendence.
Thousands of multicolored golden lines formed an almost see-through dress, tens of thousands of jewels covering the gaps as everything about her screamed richness and majesty!
