chapters.title: Chapter 3290 Unlucky! II
paragraphs: Potent weavings of colorless Quintessence wrapped around her as the complexity of her existence did not seem normal.
Her crimson hair vibrated with an astral light as the moment she appeared, Ruination reached out towards the Sword of the Commonwealth, the Armor of the Commonwealth, and the Omniversal Voyager II.
A crimson-gold light flashed over them as they turned translucent for a brief moment.
After this moment...
HUUM!
Existence distorted.
Opposite these Omniversal Armaments, illusory replicas of them bloomed as they became ever so real with every passing second!
Golden brilliance surged around them as from Ruination, heavy weavings of Loot unfolded.
And in a matter of seconds...
Dazzling replicas of the Omniversal Armaments were forged.
Replicas- and yet after a while, one couldn't notice any difference between the Armaments!
Ruination nodded with a placid gaze as she then turned towards Noah with bright eyes- almost as if seeking affirmation.
Noah patted her head with a smile as he directed the target of the spinning rune in his existence to the newly duplicated Armaments.
WUU!

Like a millstone, the rune of DEFY released terrifying waves that actually began to break down the multicolored Sword of the Commonwealth and Armor of the Commonwealth- along with the round vessel as if they were nothing.
An ability that grew from being fed Loot.
It would undoubtedly reach terrifying levels of power soon enough as while this occurred, Noah cast his gaze away from himself and towards the distant Omniverse.
Behind him, Invictus Maximus buzzed with astral radiance as they occasionally seemed to flicker into and out of existence.
What was to come?
What was the cause, and what would be the effect?

He went into a Half Tainted Omniverse with the Equestris Protectors as this led to Savitar. He aided in the death of Savitar and devoured his Delegatus and the Dark Matter Core, and this drew the attention of another terrifying Outerversal Morphon that was plotting behind the scenes. This Morphon was then powerful enough to locate Omniverse X-999 and lead Savitar towards it!
Cause! Effect!

It felt like countless intricate strings that were all moving together, and if Noah could manipulate them enough...he felt like he could control the possible future effects from whatever causation there were.
This...was the aim of Invictus Maximus!
Within Omniverse X-999.
Savitar's massive body crossed as his Outerversal Authority leaked out and caused vibrant reactions with the surrounding Omniverse that caused him to feel giddy.
The sheer concentration of Omniversal Authority within this Omniverse was nuts as he had been in other Omniverses that the Commonwealth held control in!
He had some weak Delegatus in some as he knew of the Existential Terraforming the Commonwealth commonly performed.
But this didn't answer why the surrounding weavings of this Omniverse seemed so reactive to Outerversal Authority.
This reactivity told him that if he could successfully cultivate a Quintus Dark Matter Core within this Omniverse, it might hold surprises that other Great Ones may have not even discovered yet!
But...all of this would be for naught if he couldn't stop the entry of reinforcements from the Commonwealth.
So his first set of actions were those of stealth.
To locate the Protectors stationed here and silently bind them to himself, and only then could he covertly begin his actions
This was his grandiose plan as-
|What does a thing like you want here?|
The massive skull of Savitar came to a halt and looked around coldly.
Far above, the astral space split apart as a Golden haired man filled with ecstatic beauty appeared.
His white robes fluttered with majesty as the very surroundings of the Omniverse seemed to be convergent towards him. Savitar observed the scene coldly, but within his existence, he was shocked.

He had attained the state of One With Existence. His perception of the weavings of existence in any nearby space was much greater than other entities as, at this moment, he could feel as if every single ounce of weaving of this Omniverse were supporting the entity ahead of him!
Such a thing was unfathomable, as he had come across and even killed many Omniversal Ankyras before.
Such beings had a small sense of convergence of Omniversal Authorities, and that was it. Nothing on this scale. Nothing this massive.
And even worse, he could sense this Omniversal Ankyra to have their existence too sublimated with the surroundings as likely, they had also attained the state of One With Existence!
He cursed at such a scene as he questioned... just how unlucky he could be?
His Bodies moving across the Megalos Ynnere ranged with the power of Outerversal Physiology Echelon 5 to Echelon 7.
He left his most powerful Bodies at the Seventh Echelon in his most prized Tainted Omniverses that continued to nourish him and his Main Body in the Megalos Beyond that attained the Eighth Echelon!
The Body here was only at the Fifth Echelon as it was equivalent to an Omniversal Entity who had attained the state of One With Existence or even the Eye of Existence.
'Okay. An Omniversal Ankyra...I can work with. If I find a high degree of confidence in the success of this Exalted Omniverse, I will call over another body or two here if I have to...'
He never wanted to sacrifice too much of his strength for an unknown.
So he would make things clear first!
He looked at the golden-haired Omniversal Ankyra as he was ready to catch this young entity off guard, but before he could make a move...
|Interesting...whatever happened to you, Imperium?|
Another intent bloomed out.

An intent that caused Imperium to constrict his pupils with care as he turned towards another direction where the figure of Noah with colorless gold robes and waves of astral light surrounding him could be seen! n/o/vel/b//in dot c//om
The moment his intent had echoed out, the purple flames within the sockets of Savitar vibrated in disbelief.
That voice.
That intent.
That arrogance and self-confidence as if everything would be as he wanted!

|No fucking way...| Savitar uttered out with rage and incredulity as he turned towards the direction of the Entity who didn't even spare him a glance and seemed to be more interested in the Omniversal Ankyra.
But there he was.
With his devilish eyes simmering with endless brilliance.
With those wings releasing a heart-shaking glare!
Protector Osmont- the same one who had contributed to the death of one of his bodies not too long ago.
He...was he truly so fucking unlucky to run into this demon again so quickly?!

After this moment...
HUUM!
Existence distorted.
Opposite these Omniversal Armaments, illusory replicas of them bloomed as they became ever so real with every passing second!

chapters.title: Chapter 3291 Who is the actual Omniversal Ankyra?! I
paragraphs: That arrogance!
That self-confidence!
Savitar could not forget such a demeanor on anyone, especially if this being had the same exact face.
He arrived and didn't even bat an eye towards Savitar as he instead questioned the Omniversal Ankyra for what happened to him.
Such a demeanor caused the flames within Savitar to burn with even greater ferocity.
If he was here, then surely, the Protectors of the Imperium he sought to quietly control so that nobody interrupted him with his plans of this Exalted Omniverse...would also be altered.
So the teeth in this skull cluttered with coldness as its intent boomed out.
|Peon of the Commonwealth...are Protectors supposed to be scattered around so much like you?|
The words of the buzzing Outerversal Morphon echoed out and drew the attention of everything.
The gaze of the white robed golden haired Imperium frowned as he glanced towards Noah while potent rivers of existence began to surge around him.
|You know this Outsider, Osmont?|
Outsider.
Noah smiled at this term that could apply to him as well, and he nodded.
|The other body of mine that has been inducted as a Protector faced him with the aid of an Omniversal Stage Command Protector. He is....the One Who Walks, Outerversal Morphon Savitar.|
His last sentence had a more ridiculing tone as Savitar could feel the disdain dripping from him!
The thousands of limbs behind his skull began to buzz with obsidian tendrils of Outerversal Authority that caused space to fizzle and decay.
|Outerversal Morphon...| Imperium repeated these words coldly before his right hand rose up threateningly towards this Great One.

|I know not of your intent, but you are not welcome in this Omniverse. From the malice and death emanating from you, you have already been allowed in the bounds of this Omniverse for too long already as you can now perish.|
WAA!
He was more than anyone Omniversal Ankyra at this moment.
He had received something far too profound as he needed time to assimilate it and understand it.
But until then, he would still act to ensure the safety of this Omniverse!
HUUM!
His surroundings pulsed as it felt like all nearby surrounding weavings were resonating.
Instantly, over a dozen Autarchical Omniversal Authorities descended and wrapped around his body before they flowed into his hand like massive multicolored snakes.
He then thrust his hand out and downwards rapidly as in a shockingly short period of time, all surrounding weavings seemed to only be following his decree!
From above, an utterly massive palm formed and crashed down towards Savitar.
It shone with a myriad of colors as it seemed like the hand of the Omniverse itself, everything under it facing a terrifying gravitational constriction that sought to collapse all existence!
Gloriously gold.
Its size actually eclipsed the massive stature of Savitar!
Potent with three weavings of multiple Autarchical Omniversal Authorities!
|Hmph!|

Savitar harrumphed towards the massive hand bearing down as the obsidian light gushed from him and melded with the surrounding existence, dozens of obsidian Pillars of light blooming and spinning around him as his thousands of limbs turned into obsidian spears that thrust into the massive palm.
And....
A blinding explosion of gold and black radiated out.

It was enough to scorch the retinas of even Foundation Autarchs as chaotic weavings of existence bloomed due to this impact, and shattered pieces of a massive hand could be seen strewn about as Savitar's deeply tenebrous Outerversal Authority leaked out madly!
|I'm fucking fed up with all this shit.|
His voice boomed out with cold rage one tentacle after another began to emerge from his back.
Imperium became stern as truly, he wasn't there yet.
He needed time to assimilate the new power he had just gotten and then elevate his level of Existence due to it, with his still not escaping the bounds of the Existential Dominium Realm.
This was why even though he held a terrifying level of control over Omniversal Authorities and even the surrounding Omniverse itself, he wasn't able to deal a serious enough injury to this being!
But what would be done now?
He continued to gather power around him as he didn't let up, but the aura around Savitar only became more maddening.
|One of my bodies gets killed, and now any creature that hasn't even attained the Fifth Echelon of Existence thinks they have the chance to oppose me.|
His purple flames buzzed gloriously with ecstatic power!
Tens of thousands of tentacles began to seethe from behind him.
His power reached an unprecedented peak as his dominating voice continued!
|Let me show you all what it truly means to be a Great On-...!|
|Sword.|
WU!
Savitar's words were forcefully stopped as the core of his existence began to tingle with unfathomable danger.
He turned his will fully towards the entity that had been watching everything with that distant gaze of his.
That gaze that Savitar hated the most- of someone he believed to be below him thinking they were something far above.
A gaze he hated as he had seen such eyes from those distinguished as Great Ones!
How dare this being have the same eyes? Eyes that seemed to hold an Innate regal light of unfathomable glory and honor that others couldn't replicate.
Eyes filled with a sense of endless dignity that Savitar himself never seemed to radiate!
|...of the Megalos.|
This foul being gazed towards him with such eyes as he uttered out...
|Huh?|
Everything came to a halt around Savitar.
He stared into the eyes of this being filled with Dignity as he questioned a single thing.
Did this being just say...Sword of the Megalos?
Sword of the Megalos.
Was that not...a Transcendent Megalos Ability only attainable within the Crucible of the Beyonder, the Crucible of the Sword?
That was the last thought Savitar had before everything around him turned immeasurably sharp.
Far above, a white gold sword of titanic stature began to form!
Its sharpness seemed to permeate all around as it drew in complex weavings of Existence.
Not just here, but across half of this expansive Omniverse X-999.
Every shred of weaving was pulled to give the terrifying sharpness of this Sword!

chapters.title: Chapter 3292 Who is the actual Omniversal Ankyra?! II
paragraphs: An output of 150% of Noah's complexity of existence, in addition to the surrounding weavings of existence covering the size of half an Omniverse.
This made up the single attack of the Sword of the Megalos!
Initiating and releasing it, Noah felt 5% of the reserves of his authorities leave him.
But the results...were utterly astonishing.
What did his complexity mean?
His Quintessential Fabled Omniverse.
Quintessence itself.
His System of Existence of Ingeniare. Of Outerversal Descent. Of the still forming System of Kuklos!
Of his whole Atlas of Existence.
And for added measure, a portion of the complexity of the Infinite Omniverse.
The result was the horror above that seemed like a Sword of Existence that could cut everything!
It was heavy, and it was fast as it swung down and only left behind a line of white gold light.
By the time its brilliance could be followed again, the massive illusory white gold sword was actually behind the massive skull of Savitar.

A clear white line bloomed vertically across Savitar's skull as it instantly split in half, its thousands of limbs and tentacles beginning to furiously burn with white gold flames as in its sockets...
Purple flames blazed with shock and incredulity!
That Sword.
That Sword!
That was the amalgamation of the shocking wonders of the Great Beyonder.

Something the most supreme Morphon of their Megalos Beyond constructed that allowed existence to be weaved under the banner of the user, truly making it the Sword of the Megalos as when striking out- nearly all surrounding weavings of existence struck out with you!
He had seen it on a few renowned Great Ones who managed to halfway clear the Crucible of the Sword.
Why...did this demon have it?!
He had to be-
BOOM!

The limbs and tentacles on him furiously burned away as the terrifying effects of the fast Sword unfolded, his skeletal figure that was bisected also becoming covered with white gold flames as it crackled and was burnt out of existence.
In the distance, Imperium's gaze was a frozen one as he seemed to be questioning the reality before him.
As everything about Savitar dissipated into white gold flames, the illusory white gold sword returned towards Noah's side briefly as he motioned towards it before it disappeared entirely.
Silently as a miniscule singularity was captured in his hands from it that nobody noticed.
As everything about Savitar dissipated into white gold flames, the illusory white gold sword returned towards Noah's side briefly as he motioned towards it before it disappeared entirely.
Silently as a miniscule singularity was captured in his hands from it that nobody noticed.

Under his eyes, millions of pure Delegatus Channels lost their controller as the hidden weavings of the Outerversal Descent System of Existence pulled on them, his eyes going towards Imperium as he nodded with interest.
|You seem to have undergone some great changes in a short period of time...has your status as an Omniversal Ankyra taken a big jump?|
He asked calmly as if he didn't just wave his hands and cause a terrifying Outerversal Morphon who had rebuffed Imperium's attack to perish.
Imperium took in his words as he wondered.
Between the two of them...who was actually the Omniversal Ankyra here?!
A distance away from the location where Imperium was looking towards Noah cautiously as if he were a monster.
Within Cappadocia that was one of the central points of Existential Terraforming.

One of Noah's bodies was seated on a sea of red and blue waters as he sat in this place, observing the silent waves of terraforming as if he were keeping watch to make sure no massive instabilities unfolded.
At this moment, his right hand unfurled to reveal a singularity as the wings behind him veiled everything in this space.

From that singularity, the small trace weavings of none other than Savitar could be seen as Noah released them and even sent in pure waves of existence to nurture it- a small miniature skull with purple flames forming in front of him as they gazed forward with ferociousness!
Noah looked at this trace remnant of Savitar as he shook his head.
"Frankly, I feel bad on your behalf, big guy. Don't you find it odd that I just happened to be in another Omniverse you arrived in? Someone must have sent you here, right?"
His words caused the flames of the One Who Walks to flicker as the miniaturized skull floated back.
|You keep a trace of my will to mock me? For you to have the Sword of the Megalos...What are you? Which Great One are you?|
A flood of questions came.
But Noah shook his head while replying with an expression of pity.
"You are missing the point. I saved a trace of you in order for me to understand my enemy better. My...true enemy, not you."
The flames within Savitar's sockets seethed as Noah continued.
"The one who sent you to this Omniverse. Do you not even know that he was the same one who interfered and cut off half of your weavings that led to your death in the Half Tainted Omniverse?"
BOOM!
A pillar of purple flames arose as Noah watched calmly.
|What are you...?! What!|
The flames were furious but also analyzing everything.

"Mmm, I caught the attention of whoever that being is after your death. He had to have been watching your demise while waiting to reap your hard work. What I find utterly cruel to you is that after causing the death of one of your bodies...he actually went on to use you to gain more information about me by sending you here. Of course, this is all conjecture and I could be wrong, but did someone send you here? I am picturing an enemy who doesn't like to make moves himself. He manipulates others from behind and schemes around a great deal."
|This...! This!| The skull of Savitar was shaking.
|Fuck!|
Expletives followed thereafter as purple flames burned brightly!
|He played me? He fucking played ME?!|
WUU!
The flames rose and fell.
Waves of wrath could be felt raging within Savitar as the miniature skull of his clattered and trembled.
Opposite him, the Omniversal Archontes Engineer smiled as around him, unique weavings of existence swirled.
He had a veiled smile as he looked at the scene before him.
Cause and effect.
He wanted to see how much further he could take and control these weavings of causality as he voiced out.
"Who is this enemy scheming against me? Scheming against you? Who is...our enemy?"

A distance away from the location where Imperium was looking towards Noah cautiously as if he were a monster.
Within Cappadocia that was one of the central points of Existential Terraforming.

One of Noah's bodies was seated on a sea of red and blue waters as he sat in this place, observing the silent waves of terraforming as if he were keeping watch to make sure no massive instabilities unfolded.
At this moment, his right hand unfurled to reveal a singularity as the wings behind him veiled everything in this space.

From that singularity, the small trace weavings of none other than Savitar could be seen as Noah released them and even sent in pure waves of existence to nurture it- a small miniature skull with purple flames forming in front of him as they gazed forward with ferociousness!
Noah looked at this trace remnant of Savitar as he shook his head.
"Frankly, I feel bad on your behalf, big guy.
Don't you find it odd that I just happened to be in another Omniverse you arrived in?
Someone must have sent you here, right?"
His words caused the flames of the One Who Walks to flicker as the miniaturized skull floated back.
|You keep a trace of my will to mock me?
For you to have the Sword of the Megalos...What are you?
Which Great One are you?|
A flood of questions came.
But Noah shook his head while replying with an expression of pity.
"You are missing the point.
I saved a trace of you in order for me to understand my enemy better.
My...true enemy, not you."
The flames within Savitar's sockets seethed as Noah continued.
"The one who sent you to this Omniverse.
Do you not even know that he was the same one who interfered and cut off half of your weavings that led to your death in the Half Tainted Omniverse?"
BOOM!
A pillar of purple flames arose as Noah watched calmly.
|What are you...?!
What!|
The flames were furious but also analyzing everything.
"Mmm, I caught the attention of whoever that being is after your death.
He had to have been watching your demise while waiting to reap your hard work.
What I find utterly cruel to you is that after causing the death of one of your bodies...he actually went on to use you to gain more information about me by sending you here.
Of course, this is all conjecture and I could be wrong, but did someone send you here?
I am picturing an enemy who doesn't like to make moves himself.
He manipulates others from behind and schemes around a great deal."
|This...!
This!| The skull of Savitar was shaking.
|Fuck!|
Expletives followed thereafter as purple flames burned brightly!
|He played me?
He fucking played ME?!|
WUU!
The flames rose and fell.
Waves of wrath could be felt raging within Savitar as the miniature skull of his clattered and trembled.
Opposite him, the Omniversal Archontes Engineer smiled as around him, unique weavings of existence swirled.
He had a veiled smile as he looked at the scene before him.
Cause and effect.
He wanted to see how much further he could take and control these weavings of causality as he voiced out.
"Who is this enemy scheming against me?
Scheming against you?
Who is...our enemy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3293 The enemy of my enemy I
paragraphs: In red and blue waters that stretched out mystically, with the allure of stellar brilliance shining all around.
The Omniversal Archontes Engineer cooly sat on these waters as he talked to a trace will of Savitar, his gaze firm as he continued.
"Since he led you here, you must know a great deal about them. Tell me who he is so his schemes can be put to rest."
Who was the Outerversal Morphon behind Protector Lucretia?
Who had managed to bend a Protector of the Commonwealth, and how many more Protectors were there that were his Delegatus?
Noah observed the buzzing figure of Savitar that was pulsing between wrath and hesitation, this being keeping his intent in without revealing anything else as Noah raised his brows and continued.

"Will you not even reveal him? Are you fearful of him? From his actions, he treats you as a joke. He helps kill one of your bodies one day, and then goes to use and manipulate you the next day as if nothing happened. How low must he think of you? You are a Great One, yes? For a Great One to be treated like a joke-"
|There are ranks to the Great Ones!|
A bellow of wrath and humiliation came through.
The skull of Savitar bobbed and fell on the waters as weavings of wrath and shame circled around him, and he looked spitefully towards Noah while his purple flames burned.
|He manipulated me, and you think you can sit here and speak of what you think to be my weakness to manipulate me too? You will not get anything from me, O Manipulator.|
The One Who Walks was firm.
He reigned in his rage and insecurities as Noah gazed at him calmly.
Then, the hands of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer arose as interminably pure waves of Outerversal Authority began to swirl around him.

"Is my identity what is causing you reservations? We stem from the same source, Savitar. I have waded the Megalos Beyond for too many years for one of my peers to treat me as an outsider. This is something we can discuss between each other Morphon to Morphon, without any reservations."
WAA!
Savitar stared at the extremely pure waves of Outerversal Authority as his purple flames burned brilliantly.
|The Sword of the Megalos...Outerversal Authority...you aren't a mere Delegatus. Who are you?|
His flames flickered subtly.
Noah looked at him and shook his head with a smile as he replied.

"I have not intertwined my weavings with others for too many cycles. I do not know much of you all, and you all have likely not heard of me, or I may have been forgotten entirely. But you can call me..."
Noah's mind churned as he decided on a new distinction for himself.
After a second, he laughed internally while continuing.
"...The Dreamer of the Megalos."
HUUM!
Words held power.
Choices held power.
Distinctions even more so!
|The Dreamer of the Megalos...|
Savitar uttered these words as he looked closely at Noah and the silent waves of pure Outerversal Authority.
"We are of the same breed. So let us discuss the enemy seeking to use us as chess pieces. I have confidence in my own power to strike back against them...I just need the target to be made clear."
His words caused silence to descend as Savitar only stared at him with flickering purple flames.
It was only after a few seconds...
|The Great Ponderor.|
WAA!

|He is a Great One who has managed to survive for far too many cycles. Others have said that he was alive all the way back to when the Great Beyonder still moved across the Megalos. He is a Great One that other Great One steer clear of...Nietzsche!|
Nietzsche!
Noah carved this name into his memory as he nodded, letting out a light sigh.
"The Great Ponderor...I have only heard whispers of him since I woke up. The Great Beyonder though...ah, he was something else."
Cryptic words echoed from him that shocked Savitar as this Morphon looked towards him quizzically.
The way he spoke made it seem as if he had lived in the cycles when the Great Beyonder was active too!
|You...did you know the Great Beyonder? Did you observe his feats?|
He asked cautiously.
And Noah smiled as truly, he had dreamed of the cycle when the Great Beyonder was just constructing Crucibles.
He smiled with a sense of mystery and replied.

"I know a lot, and I still know very little. Recently though, I observed some changes in the Megalos Beyond where a young Morphon overcame the Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos on the Pantheon of Umbra...the so called Instrument, is it?"
WAA!
His words instantly shocked Savitar as his skull moved much closer!
|You...your main body is currently within the Pantheon of Umbra?! The Great Ponderor is there as well! Even one of my bodies is...|
"I am not there..." Noah raised his hand to stop this being who had inexplicably thought of him much differently than before.

"I told you, I am the Dreamer of the Megalos. The amount of information I can obtain is astronomical without ever having to be in that place myself. But it is great to know where one of the bodies of my enemy is. Where else is he in the Megalos Beyond? Which Tainted Omniverses is he feeding from within the Megalos Ynnere?"
Savitar heard his questions clearly as he calmed down.
He seemed to come to a decisive point as his flames flickered firmly.
He was hooked.
Without a shadow of a doubt, he believed Noah to be another terrifying Great One.
After all, he even knew of something as recent and intricate as what was occurring on the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra!

|I...know of at least 9 of the Tainted Omniverses under his control. As for the locations of his bodies across the Megalos Beyond, he is scattered. Nobody knows where his Main Body lies. You...are you sure you are able to go against him? He...he alone is powerful. And he has many, many allies.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3294 The enemy of my enemy II
paragraphs: Was he sure?
Savitar spoke such words with hesitation as at such a tone, Noah's smile actually faded as the gaze he gave towards Savitar was one he had seen too many times before.
A gaze of disappointment. A gaze that was akin to looking at a worm wriggling on the ground!
With such a gaze, the Dreamer of the Megalos spoke as Savitar felt like needles were piercing across his will.

|A Morphon kills you, manipulates you, and lies to your face the next day- showing utter disregard and disrespect to you, and all you have are worries and insecurities against him? Are you truly a Great One? Are you someone I can even work with to oppose this enemy?|
His words were piercing as Savitar's skull trembled!
He knew how he was talked about behind the scenes.
He knew what other Great Ones thought of him!
Even his distinction...the One Who Walks, was taken as a joke by others.
The one who runs away more often than not. The one who is the quickest to retreat in the face of danger.
That...was the One Who Walks. Cycles worth of memories crossed through his mind in the span of an instant as the flames within him burned savagely.
|I am a Great One.|
HUUM!
He said the words to himself, these same words also being a declaration!
His sockets burned with purple flames as he faced Noah's visage without looking away and repeated himself.
|I am...a Great One!|
The flames within this trace of a will burned brightly as when Noah faced them, he nodded while speaking calmly.
"The enemy of my enemy...is a friend. We may have begun on the wrong foot, but we can still ensure that the one plotting against us has an assured downfall."
Two entities stared at each other.
The One Who Walks now held an extremely decisive demeanor as his intent weaved out succinctly.

|At the end of it all, I get to be the one that eats the main body of the Great Ponderor. That defiles him and lets him know who Savitar really is! You can have his Tainted Omniverses. You can have his other bodies. I just...I want his core being to myself.|
His will was resonantly made clear as to this...Noah nodded with a smile.
"Now, it feels like I'm truly talking to a Great One. Come."
He waved his hands behind him and caused a colorless rift to open, his figure walking through it as without hesitation, Savitar's will followed.
A flash of obsidian radiance bloomed as on the other side of this rift...sandy obsidian gold mountains rose and fell with profound turbidity!
It was...a small, carved-out section of the Dream Aletheian Haven that was transformed with the Psioneutrino Particles to be a haven filled with both Matter and Dark Matter.
Arriving here, Savitar felt a shocking tug from the depths of his existence towards the seas of obsidian gold mountains as Noah's voice echoed out.
"Regardless of where we are now, I still acted to destroy one of your bodies...so let me help you reconstruct it. Even better than before...and then we can get started."
As he spoke, he waved his hands to reveal a golden dew drop that caused the surrounding weavings of existence to shudder.
It felt like it was something far, far too heavy to even exist here, and even Noah frowned in the next moment as he felt an indescribable force seeking to pull this dew drop away!
It was something from the Expanse- a Hearthrae!
"Quickly."

He spoke towards the miniature Savitar who shockingly arrived with a blank look of greed and fanaticism towards the appearance of the Hearthrae, his skull opening its jaws to swallow it as if he were passed.
A blinding golden radiance shone as the force that seemed to be stemming from the Expanse, which was pulling back something that belonged in that place, disappeared.
Thereafter, rivers of obsidian gold sandy light rose from the nearby mountains of Dreams as they surged towards the miniature visage of Savitar that rapidly began to expand and grow larger!

It was the first alteration of an entity that wasn't Noah, this test being done with only the authority of a single Aletheian Haven filled with Psioneutrino Particles as what changes could be brought to a natural Morphon who wasn't Noah?
All of this came as after twisting Causality, Noah knew the enemy hiding in the dark.
The Great Ponderor, Nietzsche!
In the mind of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer, countless weavings were already blooming on how he could fuck this morphon up.
Within the stretches of the Megalos Ynnere.
Over 999 Omniverses now stood under the banner of the Commonwealth, even though they knew there could very well be countless others out there.
Within an Exalted Omniverse towering over ten times the size of a normal Omniverse.
Massive golden metallic boundaries surrounded it entirely, a statue of golden Royal Existential Omniversal Simian floating serenely outside the bounds of this Omniverse.
Past this constructed golden boundary and countless layers of intricate structures and Wheels of Weavings.
Towards the center of this Omniverse, there was a titanic golden wheel constantly spinning as a hundred Omniversal Stage Entities were seated on temples around it.
Almost as if...they were guarding something.

And they were terrifying Entities to have as guards as all of them had their existence partly melding and fusing with the surrounding space as at the very least- they had attained the state of One With Existence!
Deeper inside this wheel, towards the very center, there was a round domain the size of a world.
Paradisiacal landscapes of verdant earth and trees filled it to the brim as within such a place...a single disheveled human could be seen.
In a place that was so tightly guarded, the disheveled human- a supposed prisoner, suddenly raised his head and gazed upwards.
It was only a single movement.
But it was one that triggered countless mechanisms as blaring alarm sounds began to echo out right away!
The disheveled man paid no attention to this as he spoke for the first time in eons.
"Has that time come?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3295 An Unfathomable Emergence! I
paragraphs: Has that time come.
A single sentence.
A single glance up.
Yet this was all it took to cause blaring alarms to ring out within this idyllic paradise and across the entire Wheel it was connected to.

Within this idyllic space the size of a small word, there were small twinkling circular orbs that floated around like stars, but each one seemed to hold a terrifying weight that could collapse the surrounding space if another force wasn't holding them up.

The disheveled man waved his hands towards these unfathomably heavy orbs spread out across this idyllic space as they all twinkled before coming to circle around him, forming into a cluster of dazzling orbs.
The disheveled man then took out a worn out looking treasure chest, the orbs circling around him beginning to move into this treasure chest slowly!
As they came, they reduced in size before they disappeared entirely.

If one looked closer towards these orbs, they would shockingly come to notice that they held vibrant Omniversal boundaries, with countless complex weavings of existence buzzing within each one as these were...Omniverses!
Omniverses.
And the ones circling around the disheveled man and going into the worn out treasure chest numbered in the hundreds.
This entity wasn't hurried at all, and he truly paid no attention to the alarms that had rang out.

He didn't even bother to raise his head to see that around the idyllic landscape the size of a world, over a hundred Royal Existential Omniversal Simians at the Omniversal Stage were surrounding him, and another blinding flash of light bloomed as...The Sword of the Commonwealth himself arrived!

The moment he did so, space around him distorted as he fused with the surrounding existence, a massive Eye of Existence opening above him while a golden staff appeared in his hands that he swung down towards the isolated world below.
The staff smashed into an invisible boundary, and not even a decibel of sound was made.
The Sword of the Commonwealth stared threateningly inside this small world as truly, it wasn't a prison in the truest sense.
It was a prison as the being inside had never come out for eons now.
But...the Simians didn't make this prison, nor could they enter it. They had only constructed the tight Wheel of Weavings around it within this Exalted Omniverse!
And no matter what they did over the eons, they have never been able to enter that small, isolated space.

The worn out treasure chest closed calmly as the disheveled man waved his hands and caused it to disappear, his figure slowly straightening up as a clear white robe appeared on him, his hand waving over his head and causing vibrant dark hair to bloom down to his shoulders wildly.

His fair skin glinted with untold brilliance as he gazed up again, ignoring the Omniversal Stage Simians staring at him with wide eyes, some even showing apprehension and shock as his gaze was looking at something extremely far away.
"It is time. As the Omnifather had stated..."
A slight sigh seemed to escape him as in the next moment, he took a step.
A single step.
And his figure entirely disappeared!
Along with hundreds of Omniverses, the white-robed man disappeared under the eyes of the terrifying forces of the Commonwealth.
Stark silence descended in the surroundings as an instant later, beside the Sword of the Commonwealth, and spatial light flashed as another entity appeared.
It was none other than the Shield of the Commonwealth- Eudemus!
His messy dark and white hair seemed out of sorts as he sighed while looking at the empty idyllic world below them that remained untouched.
"Well, this is something I did not anticipate. In all these eons, he stayed still. For him to move now...it seems that shit is about to really hit the fan."
His words were calm and yet filled with a sense of somberness!
He was the only human in the midst of Simians as the Sword of the Commonwealth had his fur tinged with golden light as he gazed towards his direction before speaking out coldly.
"He was a prisoner this whole time, and we simply grew complacent thinking he was broken. He will be found again."
These words caused Eudemus to raise his brows as he shook his head.

"Was he ever truly our prisoner? In all these past eons, nobody was able to get into that small domain, and he now left it just as freely. We haven't been able to lock him down here, nor have we been able to find him in the Expanse. I really think...we should just leave things as is..."
The words were those seeking peace.
In the past, Eudemus had told Noah that he sought a solution to the Three Body Problem- whether this was through peace or Annihilation!
At this time...
"How can things be left as is? After what we did to them. You know this more than anyone else, Eudemus...there can be no peace."
There can be no peace.
Eudemus remained quiet after such words as he thought about the past.
The rise of the Commonwealth was not a seamless one.
The rise of the Commonwealth was a bloody one!
Beneath the rubble of their rise...the force of the prisoner that had just left lay!
But were they truly defeated all the way back then?
With their power, why did they not fight back? This whole time, why had this being not made a move?
And with him moving right now, just what did it say about the coming future?!

There were no answers. Only the stern faces of Protectors gazing at the empty idyllic space with uncertainty. The Sword of the Commonwealth looked around at all the powerful Protectors nearby as he waved his hands towards them.
|You no longer need to stand guard as for now, spread out. If you come across Morphons, Worms, or anything else- spread the word. Anything not belonging to the Commonwealth...eradicate it!|
WAA!
A command was given.
And it was then followed.

sentences.text: Has that time come.
A single sentence.
A single glance up.
Yet this was all it took to cause blaring alarms to ring out within this idyllic paradise and across the entire Wheel it was connected to.

Within this idyllic space the size of a small word, there were small twinkling circular orbs that floated around like stars, but each one seemed to hold a terrifying weight that could collapse the surrounding space if another force wasn't holding them up.

The disheveled man waved his hands towards these unfathomably heavy orbs spread out across this idyllic space as they all twinkled before coming to circle around him, forming into a cluster of dazzling orbs.
The disheveled man then took out a worn out looking treasure chest, the orbs circling around him beginning to move into this treasure chest slowly!
As they came, they reduced in size before they disappeared entirely.

If one looked closer towards these orbs, they would shockingly come to notice that they held vibrant Omniversal boundaries, with countless complex weavings of existence buzzing within each one as these were...Omniverses!
Omniverses.
And the ones circling around the disheveled man and going into the worn out treasure chest numbered in the hundreds.
This entity wasn't hurried at all, and he truly paid no attention to the alarms that had rang out.

He didn't even bother to raise his head to see that around the idyllic landscape the size of a world, over a hundred Royal Existential Omniversal Simians at the Omniversal Stage were surrounding him, and another blinding flash of light bloomed as...The Sword of the Commonwealth himself arrived!

The moment he did so, space around him distorted as he fused with the surrounding existence, a massive Eye of Existence opening above him while a golden staff appeared in his hands that he swung down towards the isolated world below.
The staff smashed into an invisible boundary, and not even a decibel of sound was made.
The Sword of the Commonwealth stared threateningly inside this small world as truly, it wasn't a prison in the truest sense.
It was a prison as the being inside had never come out for eons now.
But...the Simians didn't make this prison, nor could they enter it.
They had only constructed the tight Wheel of Weavings around it within this Exalted Omniverse!
And no matter what they did over the eons, they have never been able to enter that small, isolated space.

The worn out treasure chest closed calmly as the disheveled man waved his hands and caused it to disappear, his figure slowly straightening up as a clear white robe appeared on him, his hand waving over his head and causing vibrant dark hair to bloom down to his shoulders wildly.

His fair skin glinted with untold brilliance as he gazed up again, ignoring the Omniversal Stage Simians staring at him with wide eyes, some even showing apprehension and shock as his gaze was looking at something extremely far away.
"It is time.
As the Omnifather had stated..."
A slight sigh seemed to escape him as in the next moment, he took a step.
A single step.
And his figure entirely disappeared!
Along with hundreds of Omniverses, the white-robed man disappeared under the eyes of the terrifying forces of the Commonwealth.
Stark silence descended in the surroundings as an instant later, beside the Sword of the Commonwealth, and spatial light flashed as another entity appeared.
It was none other than the Shield of the Commonwealth- Eudemus!
His messy dark and white hair seemed out of sorts as he sighed while looking at the empty idyllic world below them that remained untouched.
"Well, this is something I did not anticipate.
In all these eons, he stayed still.
For him to move now...it seems that shit is about to really hit the fan."
His words were calm and yet filled with a sense of somberness!
He was the only human in the midst of Simians as the Sword of the Commonwealth had his fur tinged with golden light as he gazed towards his direction before speaking out coldly.
"He was a prisoner this whole time, and we simply grew complacent thinking he was broken.
He will be found again."
These words caused Eudemus to raise his brows as he shook his head.
"Was he ever truly our prisoner?
In all these past eons, nobody was able to get into that small domain, and he now left it just as freely.
We haven't been able to lock him down here, nor have we been able to find him in the Expanse.
I really think...we should just leave things as is..."
The words were those seeking peace.
In the past, Eudemus had told Noah that he sought a solution to the Three Body Problem- whether this was through peace or Annihilation!
At this time...
"How can things be left as is?
After what we did to them.
You know this more than anyone else, Eudemus...there can be no peace."
There can be no peace.
Eudemus remained quiet after such words as he thought about the past.
The rise of the Commonwealth was not a seamless one.
The rise of the Commonwealth was a bloody one!
Beneath the rubble of their rise...the force of the prisoner that had just left lay!
But were they truly defeated all the way back then?
With their power, why did they not fight back?
This whole time, why had this being not made a move?
And with him moving right now, just what did it say about the coming future?!
There were no answers.
Only the stern faces of Protectors gazing at the empty idyllic space with uncertainty.
The Sword of the Commonwealth looked around at all the powerful Protectors nearby as he waved his hands towards them.
|You no longer need to stand guard as for now, spread out.
If you come across Morphons, Worms, or anything else- spread the word.
Anything not belonging to the Commonwealth...eradicate it!|
WAA!
A command was given.
And it was then followed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3296 An Unfathomable Emergence! II
paragraphs: As terrifying new changes bloomed elsewhere in the Megalos Ynnere, even more unique changes bloomed within the existence of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer.

He stood on a mountain of obsidian gold sandy light as he observed the engineering of an Outerversal Morphon, his body currently adorned in a white lab coat and wide glasses on the bridge of his nose as he got in the spirit of experimentation.

His dark hair radiated a shocking astral luster as his eyes...the complexity of existence they held within their pupils was so intense that even Autarchical Stage Entities at the peak of the Existential Dominium Realm would find it hard to withstand his gaze.

He observed as Savitar's body that was in the form of an obsidian skull gained hues of gold markings on it, its thousands of limbs becoming filled with spikes as from behind, an aurora of obsidian gold wings erupted out!
|GAH! What is this? What resource is this?!|
The voice of Savitar was filled with incredulity as he felt like this body was rebuilt to be even better than its old self.
The speed at which Outerversal Authority coursed through him, the potency, the weight!
Everything seemed to have been elevated as his body seemed to be filled with astonishing weavings of power at his very core.
If he could take these and alter his main body in a similar manner...
His weavings buzzed resplendently as he also recalled that golden dew drop that his existence had madly surged towards.
That was also 50% of the reason why his current changes were so profound.
His sockets were now filled with obsidian gold flames as he looked over Noah's direction silently before...
|Have you...already reached that place?|
That place.
Noah heard such words and smiled sharply as he questioned.
"That place?"

|The truly powerful Great Ones within the Megalos Beyond have reached it. The Ponderer likely has as well. It was even theorized that the Crucibles and other wonders that the Great Beyonder made must have all come from that place. A grander weaving of existence where entities from all the Megalos could arrive to once their existence achieves a certain nirvana!|
His words were filled with fanaticism as if he sought that place with great need.
He looked towards Noah for answers as he just smiled while pushing the spectacles on his face closer to his eyes.
"Maybe. But let's focus on the matter at hand. The Tainted Omniverses where the Great Ponderor has his bodies in...where are they? I shall start there."
He had many means under his banner.
The Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction still being designed and improved- with Dark Matter and Psioneutrino Particles being incorporated to make something utterly disastrous.
He just needed a direction.
Savitar gazed at him with a gaze that seemed to be trying to understand, and he then released weavings that contained bundles of information.
Coordinates across the Megalos Ynnere- relative to where they currently were. Relative to Omniverse X-999 itself!
Noah took it all with expectant eyes as at this time...
HUUM!
His eyes lit up as the depths of his existence began to radiate an extremely heavy light.
'Oh?'
It was the completion of the construction of something that was handed down from the Dream of Ozymandias.
It was the true emergence of a golden wheel in the depths of Noah's existence.
The emergence of Kuklos!
The Wheel!
When seeking the Wheel of Existence, one may find nothing at all.
Others may find something relating to the Wheel, or something not even correlated with the wheel at all.
A prominent ordeal the Commonwealth faced was their people seeking the Wheel of Existence and instead finding one of the more terrifying Outerversal Morphons to plague their lands- the Great Wheel!
When Noah sought out the Wheel of Existence, what would he find?
|The System of Existence of Kuklos has come to fruition as your weavings experience unquantifiable changes.|
When the System of Existence of Kuklos fully formed a dazzling wheel inside Noah...a golden light encompassed his vision entirely to the extent that briefly, he couldn't see a thing.
And when his vision returned...
He saw something else entirely.
An Expanse of the darkness of the void lay all around him.
And within this void, there were many, many speckles of golden light stretched out between vast distances.
When he looked close towards these spicules of light, his vision zoomed in as he focused on one point of light that he felt a particularly unique tug from!
And this point of light...
Was an Omniverse. Omniverse X-999.
His native Omniverse!
This meant...that he was currently looking at his Omniverse and the myriad of other points of light were other Omniverses!
His vision zoomed out.
He felt like he was gazing below as, at this moment, he changed his point of view.
Or tried to.
But he was only able to glance upwards for a brief second as there, endlessly far away...he caught a glimpse.
A glimpse of an unfathomably complex Wheel!
A second of a glimpse.
He then felt countless complex weavings of existence flow over him, his gaze no longer capable of turning upwards as he could only stare down and around the stretches of vastness below him!
|A point of connection has formed between the Fourth Mundi of Power and the Wheel of Existence.|
|An irregularity emerged during this connection as due to factors relating to your existence, boons unique to you were obtained.|
His existence analyzed and broke down everything.
At the same time, he felt Quintessence within his First Mundi of Power shine brightly.
The Protagonist and Cheats followed as his very existence seemed to resonate with the boons he was currently gaining as he was viewing an array of Omniverses scattered out across the Megalos Ynnere!
From above, tendrils of complex golden lines fell onto his weavings as his vision only became more and more clear.
|You have gained the distinction of the Cartographer of Existence.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3297 An Unfathomable Emergence! III
paragraphs: The Cartographer of Existence!
Cartographer.
A word that related to an entity that designed maps and generally drew in countless waves of information and laid it out in a geographical manner.
Such a distinction was given to Noah at this moment as truly, he felt like he was gazing at a portion of an endlessly vast map, with many twinkling lights representing Omniverses strewn about.
His vision was centered around the Omniverse he was currently in, its depth spreading around it as even at this moment, it couldn't see everything.
After a certain distance, he only saw endless darkness without any glimmer of stars as there, his vision could not yet extend to.
|The Region your Cartographer's Vision extends to currently has been defined and designated the distinction of Sector 1.|
|The location of Omniverses and pertinent weavings within Sector 1 of the Megalos Ynnere are being further defined.|
It was unique.
A male generally had a sense of direction and what the distance was between two points, but Noah could barely get a gauge on even distance between Omniverses at this moment.

In a corner of what was deemed Sector 1 of the Megalos Ynnere purely because this was where Noah's native Omniverse currently was and where his current vision was limited to, Noah was also able to hone in on another Omniverse where his body was in.
The Half Tainted Omniverse...and even the Omniverse of the Protectors!
These two were on opposite ends of Sector 1, with Noah currently not being able to judge their distance even though he knew their relative positions.
It was a unique experience as with this, Noah could effectively begin mapping the vastness of the Megalos Ynnere...so long as he continued to extend his vision past his current limitations.
And with such a tool, he could easily traverse from one Omniverse to another without wandering aimlessly!
But he knew this wasn't all.
This was a boon under his new System of Existence of Kuklos.
Brimming with a profound connection to the Wheel of Existence itself, there were still other wonders in store.
|On Omniverses where your weavings are present, the Cartographer's Gateways can be formed, with each one laid down in an Omniverse allowing instantaneous passage to all other connected Omniverses.|
Cartographer's Gateways!
It was a passage from one Omniverse to another.
But even though this weaving seemed dazzling, Noah felt like there was another, even more dazzling weaving in this terrifying new distinction.

|As the Cartographer of Existence, the Existential Displacement of Omniverses or other bodies of existence at a similar level is possible for an extremely high cost that your weavings of Existence will have to bear.|
Existential Displacement.
Now that...seemed like a grandiose capability.
Noah focused on the weavings of such an ability as his vision of Sector 1 of the Megalos Ynnere only became clearer, his intent beginning to test things out right after.
'Begin the formation of the Cartographer's Gateway within Omniverse X-999...and the Half Tainted Omniverse.'
He began to test things out.
At the same time, he blinked- his vision changing from one landscape to another as within an instant, his main body opened its eyes within the depths of the Infinite Omniverse.
Another flash of light echoed from him and disappeared as outside of the Infinite Omniverse, within a section of the red and blue waters of Cappadocia, a golden robed Noah appeared.

His figure seemed ethereal and filled with radiance as in front of him, space began to distort while a colorless rift began to tear apart the surroundings- seeming as if existence itself was being torn!
At the same time.
Within the Fourth Mundi of Power.

A newly formed golden wheel was spinning while radiating pulses of golden light, waves of potent authority being burned by it as around this body of Noah, a colorless gold Quintessential Fabled Omniverse expanded around him to support the terrifying expenditure of the first Cartographer's Gateway!
A door that could lead from one Omniverse to another instantly.
This...was just part of Noah's boons as he added a fourth System of Existence to his Atlas.

He had made tremendous progress in the past days as after the Commonwealth made their entry into this Omniverse, he had since then filled up multiple new Sources of Existence, condensed a Fabled Omniverse and escaped the Existential Dominium Realm, and he even had another part of himself stirring waves within the Megalos Beyond!
His power...had spilled within the Fifth Echelon of Existence.

It was a good measure that seemed equivalent across the board, with the body of Savitar within the Half Tainted Omniverse having been at this stage, and Command Protector Valeria being at the same stage.
But Savitar's main body within the Megalos Beyond was likely on the Seventh Echelon of Existence as his power was a potent one!
But the traversal of this power across the Megalos was difficult as in a different Megalos than the one that you were born in, it seemed like one's power had to be raised again.
The disconnect between Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter was very real.
But even this...Noah was already beginning to merge Matter and Dark Matter to produce shocking effects as he was on his way.
Many more days from now, who knew what ridiculous height he would have reached?
When the rune of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was active again, what level of power would he gain even though this time, a single dream wouldn't last an instant?
The weavings of Invictus Maximus pulsed as even though Noah may not fully know, he could see possible glimpses.
And to arrive at the most pristine ones...causality would be twisted and distorted under his banner!
With an expectant gaze, he watched the formation of the first Cartographer's Gateway.
Within the same Sector 1 of the Megalos Ynnere.

An unknown distance away from where the first Cartographer's Gateway was forming, another one of Noah's bodies floated into the vessel termed the Omniversal Voyager as the eyes of Command Protector Valeria and Protector Lucretia never left him.

The Three Simian Protectors of the Equestris Protectors were looking towards him with scrutiny and disbelief as they saw the scene they just saw of this man before them melding with the surrounding Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3298 An Unfathomable Emergence! IV
paragraphs: One with Existence.
It was a state only the truly powerful Protectors who had forged their Fabled Omniverse attained.
Since their complexity was potent enough, they had more success in resonating with their surrounding existence and having their power explode greatly.
Even Command Protector Valeria had not attained this state yet, no matter how close she may be.
So how did this being...

They all had their doubts, but Command Protector Valeria said nothing as the entrance to the Omniversal Voyager closed, the figure of Noah gazing out of its transparent crystalline membrane into the Half Tainted Omniverse that seemed to be swirling with Unstable Existential Storms.

|The Dark Matter Core was all that was left holding the Omniverse, and once that is destroyed, the Omniverse itself follows. Even if its Omniversal Ankyra were still alive, nothing could be done to prevent its destruction. And if left alone...the poison of Dark Matter would only continue to spread across our lands, eventually affecting other Omniverses. This is just our duty as Protectors.|
Command Protector Valeria stopped a few meters away from Noah as she said this.
Her gaze was one with many questions as Noah smiled while gazing out at the unstable weavings of existence.
Duty. This was a heavy word that was hard to ensure at times.
Not too long ago, Noah had felt the weavings of countless extinguished souls within this very same Omniverse as he had made a point that he may as well eradicate the cause of all this.

This was Savitar, and yet not too long after, even though he killed 2 of Savitar's bodies, he now manipulated this being to first attain his own goals and for information as at this moment...they didn't stand as enemies!
Duty.
It was malleable for many as no being could completely carry it out.
The Commonwealth...what secrets did it have underneath its demeanor of saviors across the Megalos Ynnere?
Noah already knew his own selfishness and gains to protect himself and those he loved was paramount before anything else, and he continued to move with this as the basis of his actions!
HUUUM!
The Omniversal Voyager began to move away as Command Protector Valeria asked him with slight hesitation.
'You said you could help my sister...how do we start?'
Her intent was sent directly to him as with his hand behind his back, Noah replied succinctly.

'The one behind her is an Outerversal Morphon. It is nearly impossible to break the link of an Outerversal Morphon unless you kill the Outerversal Morphon itself. To release your sister, I will take you to kill the Outerversal Morphon behind her.'
His eyes shone with vibrant luminosity.
He had just obtained multiple Tainted Omniverses where the bodies of the Great Ponderor resided.
The question was whether his current power could take out these bodies, but even if it wasn't sufficient...he could always send his Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction!
The Fat Monkey continued to be improved and a next generation weapon was already being designed.
How glorious would it be to wipe out his enemies as the bombardment of missiles and singularities that utterly wiped out existence?
With plots and schemes rising abundantly, the Omniversal Voyager left.
In the unstable remnants of the Half Tainted Omniverse...
RIIIP!
A massive rift arose as a Cartographer's Gateway formed here to complete the first test of instantaneous traversal across the Megalos Ynnere, and also because Noah didn't like to waste anything.
Even though he had already devoured the Dark Matter Core of the Half Tainted Omniverse, there was still the vast Omniverse itself remaining, even if it was breaking down.
This would be the first Omniverse that would be entirely devoured and assimilated into the Infinite Omniverse.
The first...of just how many?
Dazzling colorless radiance bloomed out as the Cartographer's Gateway went towards completion!
In a Sector of the Megalos Ynnere unmapped by the Cartographer.
WAP!
Space distorted as a white robed man whose entire body screamed of age and power appeared.
The space before him flickered as in no time, a worn out treasure chest appeared and flung open as hundreds of miniaturized Omniverses floated out and began to spin around him serenely!
His whole body exuded a shocking glow of power as around him, trillions of multicolored wheels appeared and began to spin crazily.
Trillions.
The radiating glow wrapped around the serenely floating Omniverses- triggering some sort of a reaction and resonance as a moment later...
"What the Omnifather ordained shall be exposed. Let us hope that it is enough..."
HUUM!

Cryptic words echoed out from him as a blinding pillar of white light erupted in this area- this pillar of light extending in all directions rapidly as it quickly grew to be larger than most Omniverses!
It then began to pulse with waves upon waves of light that stretched out far and wide.
They stretched out to Sectors the Cartographer of Existence had yet to map out, and even reached the single Sector that he had mapped out!
When these waves of light smashed into Omniverses they came across...
Profound changes began to bloom.
Within the Omniverse of the Protectors.
Verdant waves of light permeated all around, the wills of Protectors covering all surfaces of this vast Omniverse as in the next second...
HUUM!
A wave of brilliance passed through the Omniverse that aroused many gazes.
And an instant later, towards the center of this Omniverse...
Space fluctuated and tore apart as a square white portal instantly emerged!
|Who!|

Booming wills of Protectors instantly covered it as alarms were raised, with hundreds of Protectors being notified as they began to arrive one by one in the area where the white square portal had emerged.
They circled around it sternly as if they prepared for a great enemy to come out of it.
But...nothing came out.
Within Omniverse X-999.

Noah was observing the completion of the Cartographer's Gateway when suddenly, an unseen wave of brilliance filled with heavy complexity while through, and it was followed with the emergence of a dazzling white square portal!

Since their complexity was potent enough, they had more success in resonating with their surrounding existence and having their power explode greatly.
Even Command Protector Valeria had not attained this state yet, no matter how close she may be.
So how did this being...

Duty.

chapters.title: Chapter 3299 The Weavings of the Omnifather! I
paragraphs: A square portal!
It bloomed instantly the moment the wave of brilliance passed over the Omniverse, and it was near the vast empire of the Imperium itself.
But the sheer presence it radiated was so potent that Noah found himself inexplicably drawn towards it.
HUUM!
His figure flickered across the Omniverse, crossing great distances to instantly appear in front of this fully formed white portal!
It brimmed with complex weavings of existence.
So complex that they didn't seem to belong in these weavings of Existence!
But the moment Noah stood before it...
|Loot feels an unfathomable tug of brilliance.|
|Destiny unfurls with brilliance...|
|Cheats opens its eyes wide at the unknown possibilities that can cause such a reaction.|
His extremities were buzzing.
His Distinctions even moreso!
As the Weaver of Extremity and the Weaver of Existence, nearly every part of him was urging for him to enter this white portal.
The more this urge came, the more careful he was as just what could make something like this appear?
SAA!
Not too far from him, the figure of Imperium appeared with his golden hair waving majestically.
His eyes showed alarm and serendipity as he had many intents flow into him through the many connected Omniversal Authorities as he also felt a shocking pull towards this white portal!
|What is this...how did it bloom? Why?|
Questions that even Noah sought to answer.
But since no answers were available...
"Only one way to find out..." Noah's eyes shone brilliantly as his Clone subtly changed.
It took on the identity of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats, turning into a streak of light that surged straight into the white portal!
Behind him, the gaze of the regal Imperium flickered as golden waves of light surged around him, another body merging from his current one as he also delved into the white portal.
They weren't the only ones.
Across too many Omniverses.
Across the Megalos Ynnere.

All habitable Omniverses with a certain level of complexity within them had a dazzling white portal appear within- each one radiating a gravitating pull that drew in all those with high enough levels of existence!
Within a Tainted Omniverse.

A shrouded visage of the Great Ponderor gazed at a square white portal that had caused an area of white brilliance to spread out around it- the weavings of Dark Matter nearby being disrupted tremendously.
"Bellerophon...."
The Great Ponderor spoke out to one of its more powerful generals.
"Enter, and let us see what it holds in store."
He commanded.
And Bellerophon moved to this command as his figure flashed towards the white portal!
BOOM!
But shockingly, his skeletal figure was flung back with heavy rejection as if he had hit an inviolable wall.
As if the very makeup of the Outerversal Morphon was rejected by this portal!
At such a reality, the veiled gaze of the Great Ponderor turned immensely sharp.
Within another distant unnamed Sector that the Cartographer of Existence had not yet been to.
The entity responsible for initiating this chain of events stared at hundreds of miniaturized Omniverses that were spinning around him.
Within these Omniverses as well, square white portals appeared as...what lay within these Omniverses?
Omniverses untouched by the Commonwealth.
Omniverses that were undoubtedly in existence even before the Commonwealth began its Hegemony.
Just who lay within them?
After passing through the square white portal, Noah felt like his very own existence had undergone a warping to an extremely distant place.
Complex weavings even he couldn't fully grasp circled all around him as the only thing he could confirm...was that he was still within the Megalos Ynnere!
But apart from that, nothing.
BOOM!
A wave of brilliance smashed into him that disrupted even his vision, his figure facing temporary darkness as when he could see again...he was exposed to utterly new fantastical weavings.
He grabbed his head as if he was waking up from a long slumber, his hands splashing on water as he found himself to be on top of a serene body of water.
Water so beautiful and so endlessly blue.
He was rising atop the calm waves of this endless body of water, and when he looked around, he wasn't alone!

A few miles away from him, a titanic entity who was at least twenty times his size also stepped on the cerulean calm waves while looking around him, his body radiating a shockingly heavy pressure of power as he looked humanoid, but his skin pulsed with purple radiance and purple flames of...
"Entropy?"
Noah blinked at the familiarity, but he truly recognized shockingly pure waves of Entropy surrounding this purple being whose entire body seemed wreathed in purple violet flames!
When he gazed at him, this being also gazed back.
HUUM!

And he gazed back with appalling power as above his head that was filled with majestic purple violet flames that made him seem like an ancient titan, a terrifying illusory eye formed that observed everything.
An Eye of Existence!
It seemed to be penetrative everything to observe Noah as moments later...
|Interesting...of which Lineage are you, Little One?|
A deep intent boomed out.
An intent that didn't have any malice within it, simply curiosity.
Noah gazed at this being as the complex weavings he could sense from them...were similar to his.
Those of someone who had arrived in the Expanse.
Those of someone who had transcended their weavings of existence!
|I am of the Lineage of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer. What about you, Big One?|
Noah used the same tone as the regal flames of Entropy around this being surged while he smiled.
|I am part of the Antediluvian Leviathans. I thought you were one of our descendants...the others should be arriving here soon-|
WAP!
Around them, flashes of brilliance began to bloom one after another.
But they came in sequence.
The first one that Noah noticed...was a Royal Existential Omniversal Simian.
An entity with green fur and the similarities of a humanoid monkey- with their bodies cautiously exhibiting a few thousand layers of illusory Fabled Omniverses around him!
Thereafter, Noah noticed another titanic entity appear in another direction.
This one was wreathed in golden flames as she held a striking figure full of curves, with the golden flames around her body radiating nothing else other than...
'Destiny!'

chapters.title: Chapter 3300 The Weavings of the Omnifather! II
paragraphs: Another Antediluvian Leviathan.
This one had their entire body seemingly raging with pure destiny and destiny alone as the level of power they radiated was terrifying!
Thereafter, more and more figures began to appear.
More Simians.
More humanoid Antediluvian Leviathans.
And then others of even grander varieties!
Noah saw the appearance of an entity burning with blue flames- their bodies reminiscent of a mythical phoenix.
In another direction, a long purple serpent with the head of a dragon appeared, clouds forming below it as it emanated Great mystique.
In another area, a humanoid entity with crimson skin and nine horns on his head appeared, devilish brilliance surging around him.
In another area, the bellow of a Whale like entity bloomed as more and more entities of different varieties came one after another!
But as Noah looked at all of them, he came to a single shocking conclusion.
Each one held extremely complex weavings.
Each one should have been an entity who had Transcended their weavings of existence!
He did not doubt that Imperium came into the white portal, and yet he was nowhere near.

He felt like he had arrived in an area filled with shockingly powerful giants, and the surprises only became more prominent as in one direction, he recognized the terrifying weavings of someone he had met before as when he looked over...
The visage of Old Man Eudemus, who was looking around with extreme caution like all others, appeared.
Even he was cautious.
And how could he not be when in the surroundings, there were so many terrifying auras?
Most astonishing of all the auras here though, were those of the entities who were ten or twenty times larger than everyone else here.
The Antediluvian Leviathans.
Each one emanated much more potent waves of power as each one...only held a singular quality that represented them.
Some were wreathed in regal purple violet flames like the one Noah had met first.
Others were wreathed in crimson flames as they pulsed with waves of destruction!
Some...shone with the same color as the blue sea below them as they radiated pure Mana!
When Old Man Eudemus looked and saw these beings, his eyes lit up in shock as if he recognized them, and he was forced to become even more cautious.
Around him, Simians naturally recognized him and gathered.
They were the first arrivals, but it seemed many more would come.
In the midst of all of this contention and caution...
HUUM!
The endlessly empty skies above trembled as an intent formed in gold for all of them to interpret.
[After countless Eons, the Tresorverse of the Omnifather has opened to all those affiliated with Matter.]
The Tresorverse of the Omnifather.
Not a Universe, Hyperverse, or Omniverse- but a Tresorverse!
This intent shone with grandiose golden grandeur in the skies as when it did appear, Noah noticed that on the bodies of the Antediluvian Leviathans, gazing of reverence and respect arose.
They knew of or had prior knowledge regarding this event or this Omnifather.
This was the conclusion Noah arrived at as now the main question was...what exactly did this Tresorverse of the Omnifather hold in store?
In the skies, silent waves radiated yet another intent for any who came here to grasp.

[The Tresorverse of the Omnifather is a Bridge that can take one from where they stand to merely a step away from the Wheel of Existence. Ascend the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, and you shall be prepared.]
Ascend the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, and you shall be prepared?
Prepared for what exactly?
And what tree was this intent speaking of when all around, there was an endless expanse of sea and skies?
As Noah thought of this, he couldn't help but remember the weavings of the entity known as Bob who led him to the Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the gains he had made there.
Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree. Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
What connection lay there, if any?
There were too many questions to try and grasp what was going on, but before any answers could be made clear...
BOOOM!
The skies above cracked and splintered.

Heavy waves of haki and complex vibrations of existence cascaded down from the shattered skies- multicolored radiance shining down as there...across all of these endlessly vast breaking skies...were the roots.
Roots of a tree.

They shone with multicolored radiance as multiple roots stretched out, each one having no end as they stretched out across the breaking sky while the trunk they were connected to ascended upwards to the extent that they couldn't even see its end.
The Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence!

The mere appearance of this tree caused Noah's existence to tremble with greed- a shocking pull extending itself to him as his very being felt like it was screaming for him to jump on the roots of this tree and climb up!
A tree that could take one a step away from the Wheel of Existence.
Something laid out by the Omnifather! But who even was this being?!
|By the grace of the Omnifather...|
In the midst of the shock and stupor of many, the Antediluvian Leviathans exploded with terrifying waves of power as their bodies began to rise towards the shattered skies.
The one who had spoken to Noah initially was surrounded by unfathomably potent tendrils of Entropy as he turned into a lightning bolt that shot up.
These entities knew far more than them as seeing them shoot upwards, all others scrambled as they felt like they would be missing something tremendous if they didn't do so!
Even Noah's weavings of existence were buzzing as he stepped off the blue waters he was on, his figure also shooting up towards the skies amidst this flood of extremely powerful entities!
At the same time.
Within Omniverse X-999.
SAA!
Around the square white portal, waves of mass teleportations echoed out as the figure of Imperium, who seemed to be in a stupor, woke up and turned towards them.
There, he saw another one of Noah's bodies as around him, a few hundred figures followed!
Closest to him were Henry, Barbatos, Adelaide, Sona, and many others.
The figures of Dr. Hall, Lilith, Erickson, and even more renowned entities of the Infinite Omniverse were there!
Without so much as a delay, Noah's bright eyes flung his hand forward as if he were in a hurry.
"Go!"
Imperium did not stop them. He couldn't stop them.
He still seemed to be adapting to a great level of shock as he turned towards Noah's figure while his people surged towards the square white portal.
|Are you in the same place?|
Was he in the same place as Imperium.
Someone who had yet to Transcend their existence.
The answer was no as Noah wondered...where would those who have not transcended their existence be sent?!
This was just one among far too many questions.
The main one that remained in Noah's mind...was who the fuck was the Omnifather?!
