As Noah thought of this, he couldn't help but remember the weavings of the entity known as Bob who led him to the Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the gains he had made there.
Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree.
Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
What connection lay there, if any?
There were too many questions to try and grasp what was going on, but before any answers could be made clear...
BOOOM!
The skies above cracked and splintered.

Heavy waves of haki and complex vibrations of existence cascaded down from the shattered skies- multicolored radiance shining down as there...across all of these endlessly vast breaking skies...were the roots.
Roots of a tree.

They shone with multicolored radiance as multiple roots stretched out, each one having no end as they stretched out across the breaking sky while the trunk they were connected to ascended upwards to the extent that they couldn't even see its end.
The Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence!

The mere appearance of this tree caused Noah's existence to tremble with greed- a shocking pull extending itself to him as his very being felt like it was screaming for him to jump on the roots of this tree and climb up!
A tree that could take one a step away from the Wheel of Existence.
Something laid out by the Omnifather!
But who even was this being?!
|By the grace of the Omnifather...|
In the midst of the shock and stupor of many, the Antediluvian Leviathans exploded with terrifying waves of power as their bodies began to rise towards the shattered skies.
The one who had spoken to Noah initially was surrounded by unfathomably potent tendrils of Entropy as he turned into a lightning bolt that shot up.
These entities knew far more than them as seeing them shoot upwards, all others scrambled as they felt like they would be missing something tremendous if they didn't do so!
Even Noah's weavings of existence were buzzing as he stepped off the blue waters he was on, his figure also shooting up towards the skies amidst this flood of extremely powerful entities!
At the same time.
Within Omniverse X-999.
SAA!
Around the square white portal, waves of mass teleportations echoed out as the figure of Imperium, who seemed to be in a stupor, woke up and turned towards them.
There, he saw another one of Noah's bodies as around him, a few hundred figures followed!
Closest to him were Henry, Barbatos, Adelaide, Sona, and many others.
The figures of Dr.
Hall, Lilith, Erickson, and even more renowned entities of the Infinite Omniverse were there!
Without so much as a delay, Noah's bright eyes flung his hand forward as if he were in a hurry.
"Go!"
Imperium did not stop them.
He couldn't stop them.
He still seemed to be adapting to a great level of shock as he turned towards Noah's figure while his people surged towards the square white portal.
|Are you in the same place?|
Was he in the same place as Imperium.
Someone who had yet to Transcend their existence.
The answer was no as Noah wondered...where would those who have not transcended their existence be sent?!
This was just one among far too many questions.
The main one that remained in Noah's mind...was who the fuck was the Omnifather?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3301 The Weavings of the Omnifather! III
paragraphs: A great deal of questions, and yet no viable answers!
It meant that they had to be unearthed for themselves as Noah went ahead to do just this.
He sent his people into the square white portal as his will lay within all of them.
It coursed through their blood.
At this moment, the Blood of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer burned within his son as whatever Henry could see...so could he!
A distortion of weavings of existence later, his son and others very quickly came to as they opened their eyes.
And all around them... were incandescent, sparkling, cerulean waves of water.
They were underwater entirely, but everything was extremely lit up and clear as these waters did not show an end in sight!

Around them, figures of entities from a variety of races and lineages stood, with Humans, Simians, Antediluvian Leviathans, and Draconic Entities making up the vast majority. All of them ranged within the Existential Dominium Realm...all the way to the Omniversal Realm.
But undoubtedly, nobody within these waters had Transcended their own weavings of existence.
In here, Noah's will located Imperium who was gazing above at dazzling golden words that shone brilliantly above the surrounding waters.
[After countless Eons, the Tresorverse of the Omnifather has opened to all those affiliated with Matter.]

[The Tresorverse of the Omnifather is a Bridge that can take one from where they stand to merely a step away from the Wheel of Existence. Wade across the Tresorverse Primalwater used to nurture the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, and you will gain the capability to ascend the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence itself.]
The words were only slightly different from the ones that appeared within the part of the Tresorverse of the Omnifather that Noah and other powerful entities appeared in.
The Primalwater utilized to nurture the Primaltree of Existence itself!
Just by standing within these waters, Noah could feel the blood within his son and others begin to burn with activity.
Their existence passively began to increase in complexity while their Extremes surged with ever greater intensity.
And in the midst of all of this...
BOOM!
A commotion broke out below as heavy weavings of combat echoed out.

When they looked below, the extremely clear waters showed sparse globules of radiant light that were stretched out across the distant waters, and an Antediluvian Leviathan that was much smaller than those Noah had come across could be seen holding a Royal Existential Omniversal Simian in his hands.

The body of this Antediluvian Leviathan was humanoid and simmering with dazzling tendrils of blue lightning, his very skin crackling with waves of lightning as the shattered golden wheel that had initially attacked him lay broken!
The Omniversal Stage Simian within his hands struggled with terror as never in his life would he have believed that his power- the System of Existence of Kuklos, would fail against mere Lightning.
But this lightning seemed to carry such unfathomable complexity that it even overcame the weavings of his Wheel, and at this moment...
|Spare-|
BOOM!
A clap of thunder and lightning boomed out as the hand of the Antediluvian Leviathan closed fully.

The Fabled Omniverse of the Simian was scorched by trillions of complex lightning bolts that seemed to carry their own omniversal authority- the faint makeup of an illusory omniverse made of pure blue lightning briefly flashing on the Antediluvian Leviathan as he turned his eyes back on the globe of radiant light before him- grasping it and bringing it to his mouth right away!
The globe was devoured entirely as moments later, the power of this Antediluvian Leviathan began to rise up with shocking speed, their existence becoming increasingly complex.
This...
All those who watched this scene instantly looked towards the distant globes within this sea below them with boundless greed, their bodies shooting out in different directions as chaos ensued!
|Move together, and steer clear of others!|
Henry's intent echoed out commandingly as the entities of the Infinite Omniverse moved as a singular group, delving into the waters below as around them, more and more figures were teleported in!
They were among the weakest.
Most of them weren't even at the Autarchical Stage!
And here, they had just seen an Omniversal Stage Entity perish.
In an area of shocking mystery, a mad scramble began as very few actually knew what was happening!
In a Sector unmapped by the Cartographer of Existence.
A white robed man sat calmly as hundreds of Omniverses had stably stopped spinning, and there were floating like dazzling stars around him as his gaze was that of utmost calmness.

"The Omnifather spoke of the methods of the Great Beyonder that were invoked early and allowed the Morphons to advance greatly over the past cycles. Over all these Cycles, the mechanisms he put in space have collected and concentrated great deals of wonder from the Expanse in one place...but will it be enough? Neither the Great Beyonder nor the Omnifather knew what that Entity from the Megalos Nihilos had planned..."
The mechanisms that the Omnifather had put in place for eons!
They had been harvesting and concentrating countless unknown wonders by means that even this entity did not understand.
He only followed the weavings of the Omnifather to trigger everything when the time was ready.
When the Wheel made a certain turn.
As for what results would come from it all...
"Will it be enough?"

With hundreds of Omniverses filled with ancient Antediluvian Leviathans and other Lineages calmly floating around him, this entity turned his head up and gazed at the endless dark waves of the Megalos Ynnere.
His gaze carried ancientness. His gaze carried interminable power and complexity.
His gaze carried longing.
His gaze carried a yearning as he thought of the Omnifather.
Why did he not take me, he wanted to ask.
Why allow things to play out this way?
He had many questions too, but he would follow the Will of the Omnifather regardless.
For he was the Watchman of the Megalos Ynnere.
And his purpose was a heavy, heavy ordeal!

chapters.title: Chapter 3302 The Weavings of the Omnifather! IV
paragraphs: Past the square white portals.
Within the Tresorverse of the Omnifather.

The moment that the terrifying Entities across the myriad of Omniverses shot towards the skies like twinkling stars, they came to land on the roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence as an undeniable force crushed down from above that prevented them from rising any further!
They had to go through the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence itself.

Old Man Eudemus landed on the roots of this massive tree that seemed to be tens of times larger than any Omniverse, the roots alone occupying everything they could see along with the multicolored trunk.
He landed on a golden-colored root, and the moment he did so, he felt unique changes that caused his eyes to shine brightly.
He felt his authority slowly begin to be used up as it felt like...it was being challenged.
As if his weavings of Existence themselves were being challenged constantly, and only if he proved himself and what his weavings stood for could he move forward!
He took a step forward, and his gaze became even more astonished.
He had seen a great number of things within the Expanse over the years, even as many of his bodies within had gotten destroyed by terrifying oddities.
But he had never come across something like this.

|The Roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence challenge your weavings of existence constantly. To keep moving, a constant flow of your weavings have to be released as they are broken down naturally, and then small wisps are returned to you as they actually hold slightly greater waves of complexity! Just walking across the roots of this tree will require a great deal of effort and usage of authority, but this alone will elevate your weavings of existence!|
He passed this intent to the Protectors following behind him who landed one by one.
His other body within the Omniverse of the Protectors outside of this place was also notifying the Sword of the Commonwealth and the Viceroy!

|Conserve your authority as you move. You will likely be knocked out the moment your reserves of authority can no longer keep up, and the natural drain of your weavings of existence will likely increase the higher up you go. Proceed carefully...|
The intent of Old Man Eudemus echoed out in the minds of the Protectors as moments later...
|But sir...look at them...| An Omniversal Stage Simian gritting his teeth while pointing a mile or two away from them where the titanic figure of a verdant Antediluvian Leviathan could be seen.

He was taking steady steps as tendrils of green light emanating nothing but Life flowed from him and into the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, and every time he lifted his foot...even purer waves of verdant light returned to him as by simply walking up steadily, his power seemed to be rising.
His complexity seemed to be increasing!
Old Man Eudemus shook his head at this as he replied.

|Focus on yourselves first. This ordeal only makes it more paramount to have purity of existence. A singular Ordinance to define oneself. Those Entities...we faced them briefly during the founding of the Commonwealth as they are some of the purest existences in terms of weavings they follow. Even what we follow is still outside of us, but they....|
What they followed was outside of them.
The Wheel of Existence.
It was grandiose.
It was unfathomable.
It was a pure source for them to follow as they built up a wheel within their own existence, but in terms of purity...
It could not beat the existence of something that defined and lived by weavings Innate to themselves.

|That one there strictly follows the weavings of Life and nothing else. The complexity of his weavings of Life alone can decimate and overpower your weavings of Kuklos as their whole body has been structured and reforged under Life to the utmost extreme. If he has attained the Third State of Existence...his power would be something even I would have to be careful about contending with. Ah, let us not worry about others who may forge ahead. Focus on controlling the usage of your weavings of existence first. Those who rush ahead and come to realize how more and more weavings will be required from them will be knocked out the quickest. And we don't know if we can even get back on these roots if we are knocked out. This...will be an ordeal to manage one's weavings of existence while elevating their complexity steadily. After all, nobody's weavings are infinite.|
His words were akin to cardinal laws as the Protectors nodded sternly while moving forward.
Within their existence, golden wheels spun as their weavings became slightly more potent with every step, but more of the reserves of their authorities were also fading away!
They would have to adapt to their increasing complexity and even likely rest to recover their authority as they proceeded forward.
But already, their hearts pulsed with joy at the advancement their Weavings of Existence were feeling.
They had to go higher on this Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, and they had to get the wonders on it before others could!
Such feelings abundantly rose in the minds of many as their numbers within this place only increased.
But the roots of the massive tree were far too massive and far too many.
Those who knew each other grouped up, those who didn't spread out to seek their own opportunity.
In another part of the golden colored root that covered most of the skies nearby, and the one most entities got on quickly.

The figure of Noah could be seen standing still on the surface of the massive tree root, his figure leaning down and touching its surface as he found that the Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence could not flow into these roots!
It seemed to seek a singular, pure authority as the one from any of his Systems of Existence flowed down and allowed him to come to a conclusion on a few things.

chapters.title: Chapter 3303 Terrific! I
paragraphs: The conclusions Noah came to were many as they were broken down by his System.
|Authority of a single Source will naturally be drawn out from one's body and into the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.|

|A hundredth of the same authority will be returned into one's body, with its complexity being higher than before as it can naturally aid in the elevation of the complexity of one's existence after it has been assimilated back in.|
|Any movement made while on the Tresorverse Primaltree will drain even more waves of authority, with the higher up one goes increasing the output of the drain.|
|One can actively increase the output of authority being increased at any time, which will increase the respective Elevated Authority that is returned.|
|The purer the released authority, the purer and more potent the returned Elevated Authority.|
|Beginning tests of releasing an output of pure, single concepts by themselves.|
He was releasing the authority of his First System of Existence that contained all of his concepts, and he had even tested out the release of the Authority of Kuklos and Ingeniare!
But the output of a pure, single source seemed to be paramount as at this moment, Noah tried Quintessence.
HUUM!

The output of Quintessence caused vibrant colorless light to sink into the golden surface of the root he was on, and the reaction was even more potent as the returned elevated authority was also purer.
What was returned was even more complex as Noah's Quintessential Fabled Omniverse radiated an even grander luster.
Purer, single sources of authority gave back even more complex boons of existence!
"The purity of existence is what keeps the wheel turning..."
Noah spoke such words as his figure rose up from its kneeling position.
He looked ahead at the massive figures of Antediluvian Leviathans who were painted with a singular light of extremity.
A single definition of their existence!
The purple violet Leviathan had already pulled ahead greatly as everytime his foot arose from the root to step ahead, extremely complex weavings of Entropy returned to him.
The higher one rose, the more their authority would be used, the more complexity of existence they could gain back.
At a certain point, it would likely become very hard to take even a single step as this would require immense reserves of authority.
At the end of the day, everything would come down to how complex and potent one's authority was...and its reserves.
Its reserves.
Since...nobody had limitless reserves of their authority.
As he thought of this, an utterly devilish smile began to form on Noah's face.
Devilish.
Incandescent!
Quintessential!
|Cheats rises with anticipation.|
|Loot burns with anticipation.|
|Protagonist looks towards a certain direction.|
|Relativity looks towards a certain direction.|
|Quintessence looks towards a certain direction.|
They all gazed towards one place.
Towards one weaving!
It was unfathomably blue, and it radiated waves of authority that seemed endless.
All eyes looked towards Mana.
All eyes went towards Infinity.
All eyes went towards Manadynamics.
Dead paths.
Impossible paths to traverse to the ends of- and difficult to even bring to Extremity!
HUUM!
Noah stood on the golden roots and stared at the terrifying entities around and ahead of him.
There were vast stretches of distances, but all of these Entities had likely explored the Expanse far longer than him since they had transcended their weavings of existence many years ago.
Their states of Existence were likely more advanced than his!
Their complexity...was definitely much greater than his.
The Protectors of the Commonwealth fit this bracket, but the Antediluvian Leviathans were even more terrifying.
He had never heard of them before, but the behavior of Old Man Eudemus and other Protectors showed that they knew of them- and they even gazed towards them with scrutiny and tension!
It was another force across these Omniverses- something utterly unfathomable that even the Commonwealth feared.
Most of the entities here were more complex than he was, but he had a single thing that none of them could claim!
Something he had built up since he was absolutely nobody and cemented as a fact truly without a shadow of a doubt.
He had...
"Mana."
He called out lightly.
HUUM!
His feet pulsed as they gushed out seas of Mana.
Between him and the connected golden root below, a glow of serene blue bloomed!
The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity and Manadynamics flowed out ceaselessly as they carried with them the singular weaving of Mana!
At this moment, Noah chose the single, pure aspect of the Infinity of Mana.
One of the purest authorities there could be in existence as this type of authority was interchangeable with all other authorities.
After all, energy was neither created nor destroyed, only transformed into a different form- with this more closely aligning with Manadynamics than Infinity.
And one of the most basal forms of energy was...Mana!
BOOM!

The moment his feet began to unleash waves of mana, all of them were soaked into the golden surface of the root as if it were an endless desert, and thereafter- even more complex tendrils of mana were returned to him.
A shade of blue darker.
Its potency and complexity were a few times greater.
Within the First Mundi of Power, Quintessence was the single largest body as it was many times greater in size, and had even forged its Quintessential Fabled Omniverse.

At this moment, Infinity began to bubble with activity as its conceptual body began to expand rapidly- devouring the more complex weavings of Mana that were being returned as a terrifying process began!
Alongside it, even though it didn't take center focus, Manadynamics still played a truly critical component as it also rose alongside the returned complex weavings of Mana.
Time felt like it was moving in slow motion.

All across this golden root that took nearly all the immediate skies above them and on far away distant roots carrying other colors, powerful entities had already figured out how the weavings of the Roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence worked as they steadily walked upwards.
With every passing second, their bodies emanated slightly more powerful waves of complexity.
If they could have numbers shown above their heads, they would show additions of hundreds and thousands constantly to the values of their Echelons of Existence!
But the one singular reality that remained was that every single one...walked up steadily!

|Authority of a single Source will naturally be drawn out from one's body and into the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.|

|A hundredth of the same authority will be returned into one's body, with its complexity being higher than before as it can naturally aid in the elevation of the complexity of one's existence after it has been assimilated back in.|
|Any movement made while on the Tresorverse Primaltree will drain even more waves of authority, with the higher up one goes increasing the output of the drain.|
|One can actively increase the output of authority being increased at any time, which will increase the respective Elevated Authority that is returned.|
|The purer the released authority, the purer and more potent the returned Elevated Authority.|
|Beginning tests of releasing an output of pure, single concepts by themselves.|
He was releasing the authority of his First System of Existence that contained all of his concepts, and he had even tested out the release of the Authority of Kuklos and Ingeniare!
But the output of a pure, single source seemed to be paramount as at this moment, Noah tried Quintessence.
HUUM!

The output of Quintessence caused vibrant colorless light to sink into the golden surface of the root he was on, and the reaction was even more potent as the returned elevated authority was also purer.
What was returned was even more complex as Noah's Quintessential Fabled Omniverse radiated an even grander luster.
Purer, single sources of authority gave back even more complex boons of existence!
"The purity of existence is what keeps the wheel turning..."
Noah spoke such words as his figure rose up from its kneeling position.
He looked ahead at the massive figures of Antediluvian Leviathans who were painted with a singular light of extremity.
A single definition of their existence!
The purple violet Leviathan had already pulled ahead greatly as everytime his foot arose from the root to step ahead, extremely complex weavings of Entropy returned to him.
The higher one rose, the more their authority would be used, the more complexity of existence they could gain back.
At a certain point, it would likely become very hard to take even a single step as this would require immense reserves of authority.
At the end of the day, everything would come down to how complex and potent one's authority was...and its reserves.
Its reserves.
Since...nobody had limitless reserves of their authority.
As he thought of this, an utterly devilish smile began to form on Noah's face.
Devilish.
Incandescent!
Quintessential!
|Cheats rises with anticipation.|
|Loot burns with anticipation.|
|Protagonist looks towards a certain direction.|
|Relativity looks towards a certain direction.|
|Quintessence looks towards a certain direction.|
They all gazed towards one place.
Towards one weaving!
It was unfathomably blue, and it radiated waves of authority that seemed endless.
All eyes looked towards Mana.
All eyes went towards Infinity.
All eyes went towards Manadynamics.
Dead paths.
Impossible paths to traverse to the ends of- and difficult to even bring to Extremity!
HUUM!
Noah stood on the golden roots and stared at the terrifying entities around and ahead of him.
There were vast stretches of distances, but all of these Entities had likely explored the Expanse far longer than him since they had transcended their weavings of existence many years ago.
Their states of Existence were likely more advanced than his!
Their complexity...was definitely much greater than his.
The Protectors of the Commonwealth fit this bracket, but the Antediluvian Leviathans were even more terrifying.
He had never heard of them before, but the behavior of Old Man Eudemus and other Protectors showed that they knew of them- and they even gazed towards them with scrutiny and tension!
It was another force across these Omniverses- something utterly unfathomable that even the Commonwealth feared.
Most of the entities here were more complex than he was, but he had a single thing that none of them could claim!
Something he had built up since he was absolutely nobody and cemented as a fact truly without a shadow of a doubt.
He had...
"Mana."
He called out lightly.
HUUM!
His feet pulsed as they gushed out seas of Mana.
Between him and the connected golden root below, a glow of serene blue bloomed!
The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity and Manadynamics flowed out ceaselessly as they carried with them the singular weaving of Mana!
At this moment, Noah chose the single, pure aspect of the Infinity of Mana.
One of the purest authorities there could be in existence as this type of authority was interchangeable with all other authorities.
After all, energy was neither created nor destroyed, only transformed into a different form- with this more closely aligning with Manadynamics than Infinity.
And one of the most basal forms of energy was...Mana!
BOOM!

The moment his feet began to unleash waves of mana, all of them were soaked into the golden surface of the root as if it were an endless desert, and thereafter- even more complex tendrils of mana were returned to him.
A shade of blue darker.
Its potency and complexity were a few times greater.
Within the First Mundi of Power, Quintessence was the single largest body as it was many times greater in size, and had even forged its Quintessential Fabled Omniverse.

At this moment, Infinity began to bubble with activity as its conceptual body began to expand rapidly- devouring the more complex weavings of Mana that were being returned as a terrifying process began!
Alongside it, even though it didn't take center focus, Manadynamics still played a truly critical component as it also rose alongside the returned complex weavings of Mana.
Time felt like it was moving in slow motion.

All across this golden root that took nearly all the immediate skies above them and on far away distant roots carrying other colors, powerful entities had already figured out how the weavings of the Roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence worked as they steadily walked upwards.
With every passing second, their bodies emanated slightly more powerful waves of complexity.
If they could have numbers shown above their heads, they would show additions of hundreds and thousands constantly to the values of their Echelons of Existence!
But the one singular reality that remained was that every single one...walked up steadily!

chapters.title: Chapter 3304 Terrific! II
paragraphs: The vast array of entities were walking across the roots steadily.
One man had been still this whole time as at this moment, as waves of endless blue light gushed below his feet, his body got into a sprinting stance as he breathed out.
His eyes flashed with cerulean radiance.
On his back, a pair of wings unfolded as even they began to buzz with gorgeous blue radiance!
On his face, a devilish smile was fully unfolded as this being knew...he was about to fuck a lot of shit up!
Across the roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
Those with terrifying waves of Complexity were faster, their strides longer as they had already pulled far ahead.
At all times, their auras and wills were spread out across the surroundings as they also monitored other Entities around them!
There were too many entities here, each with unknown levels of power.
So far, no clashes of conflict or battles had bloomed, and everyone was watching closely.
They were watching each other and their surroundings even more as they also sought to figure out the mysteries of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
Any oddity would be sensed by those nearby.
And at this moment, an oddity bloomed.
Having been still this whole time, a man whose body now pulsed all around with waves of blue brilliance did not simply take a step forward.
He didn't walk.
He didn't run.
He sprinted!
PAH!
The sound was akin to a clap of thunder that drew in many observant wills that were already looking at the surroundings.
But when they honed in on the source of the sound, they didn't see anything there but a glimmer of blue light!
A light that, when followed, allowed them to finally see a figure sprinting across the surface of a golden root at full speed.
With every step taken, more and more authority would be drained from one's existence.
And the further up they went, the greater concentrations of authority that would be drawn out!
To sprint like this, one would have to brazenly be releasing their authority without any reservation as likely, within a matter of seconds, they would be spent!
It was an alarming scene to see, but these extremely powerful beings weren't dazed by it as some even shook their heads.
They looked towards this entity wrapped by tendrils of blue light as a momentary showoff.

One that in the next few seconds would be entirely drained of their reserves of usable existence as after that...well, at least they would be able to observe what would happen on the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence when one no longer had any weavings of existence to be drained!

One that in the next few seconds would be entirely drained of their reserves of usable existence as after that...well, at least they would be able to observe what would happen on the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence when one no longer had any weavings of existence to be drained!
So many wills still remained observing the sprinting figure that was irresponsibly releasing their authority.
Around his body, due to him unleashing such reckless waves of his weavings, he got back equally more condensed and more complex waves of existence as he accepted them all rapidly.
Pure, compressed, and intricately complex waves of mana returned as for the most part, they flowed back into Infinity.
A large part also flowed into Manadynamics itself as two cerulean bodies expanded rapidly!
In the span of a few seconds...this rapid expansion stopped as it began to be compressed into an infinitely small point.
A point that was filled with countless spinning Quarks, Leptons, and Psioneutrinos!
|Countless records are converging under Infinity.|
|Countless records are converging under Manadynamics.|
It was too quick.
The waves of complexity being returned were too potent and endlessly vast in volume!
They allowed for a terrifyingly rapid process to unfold as in a matter of seconds, countless fundamental particles were condensed into a single point!
And from this single point...
|A Quintus Core of Existence has been successfully formed.|
|The Basis of the Infinity Fabled Omniverse has been stabilized.|
|A Quintus Core of Existence has been successfully formed.|
|The Basis of the Manadynamics Fabled Omniverse has been stabilized.|
From the Cores, an explosive wave of blue erupted out as alongside it, the illusory flames of two circular Fabled Omniverses circled around Noah!
|The Second Fabled Omniverse within the Conceptual System of Existence is blooming.|
|The Third Fabled Omniverse within the Conceptual System of Existence is blooming.|
Simultaneously, two Fabled Omniverses bloomed as the raging waves of mana around Noah became that much more potent!
His sprinting figure looked encased with circular waves of mana as the moment they formed, they sank into the golden floor of the root he was on.
And even more potent waves of Mana were returned in a maddening cycle as while Noah went further up the root where even more reserves of authority were required, he gave it even more.
Instead of his figure slowing down, he actually accelerated!
SAA! Like a flash of cerulean lightning.
He passed Entities who had glorious Eyes of Existence shining above them as they moved upwards rapidly.
He was catching up to the distant shadows of terrifyingly powerful Antediluvian Leviathans!
Those observing and waiting for his eventual slowdown and burnoff had their gazes change finally as their weavings became hurried.
Due to the actions of this being, a number of powerful entities began to radiate even more reserves of their weavings of existence as they took large strides forward!
Unknown secrets lay ahead in this Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
They couldn't fall behind!
Noah's single action caused a change in those nearby as it was akin to a chain reaction.
As more entities began to take faster strides forward, others followed.
As if it were a race as nobody knew what lay ahead, but they wanted to be first!

The one who had spurred this whole action continued forward as his devilish smile only became more pronounced, his flashing figure landing in the eyes of many as on a distant root...an Antediluvian Leviathan turned his head towards him.
This Antediluvian Leviathan was crackling with blue lightning all over his titanic body, his skin also painted with a cerulean hue along with all other parts of his body!
Around him, extremely pure Manna surged with wild abandon.
Manna.
Another variation of the same thing- Mana!
This being's entire existence was based on this as at this moment, its eyes shone brightly while gazing at Noah.
Its mouth opened as it voiced out silently.

And in the next moment, on the root Noah was on, the far ahead figure of the entity wreathed in violet purple flames of Entropy turned around and locked onto Noah's figure that was rapidly approaching his current position!

chapters.title: Chapter 3305 Terrific! III
paragraphs: An entity burning with glorious Entropy.

He had spoken to Noah once before as after being prompted by another Antediluvian Leviathan in the far distance, this being sent his intent towards Noah's figure that was blazing across the golden root and getting ever closer to his current position!
|Why are you in such a hurry with such pure weavings of Existence, young friend? Pace yourself, and you will enjoy the grace of the Omnifather even more.|
The intent was extremely quick.
At this stage of power, entire conversations could take place within the span of an instant as the exchange of thoughts was that quick.
In this span of an instant, Noah's currently burning blue eyes glanced up towards this being and smiled.
|I know nothing of the grace of the Omnifather, so I must struggle and hurry ahead to understand. Are you able to tell me what we can expect ahead?|
The Antediluvian Leviathans!

Entities who seemed to know about the owner of this Tresorverse as they moved with terrifying power and calmness- and a level of fervent light Noah had only seen among Morphons when they spoke of the Great Beyonder.
The entity burning with Entropy chuckled at Noah's words as his strides pulled ever further ahead as he replied.

|I know a little. I reach out to you because the purity of your mana has resonated with a brother of mine a distance from here. He is sentimental of those similar to us in purity as he has asked me to look out for you. Pacing yourself is one such advice as if you are drained and can no longer interact with the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence with your weavings of existence, you will lose all your progress.|
When the constant drain of authority could not be met, one could no longer stand on the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence as they would fall off.
The Antediluvian Leviathan brimming with Entropy said such things as Noah nodded towards this being and smiled.
|Thanks for the heads up, Brother Leviathan. And give my thanks to the other Brother Leviathan as well. Say, what is your name? You can refer to me as Engineer Osmont.|
He was holding this conversation seamlessly without stopping as an instant passed, and...
SAA!
He continued surging forward with what seemed to be incrementally increasing speed and even more output of his weavings of Existence as he never stopped!
Around him, the illusion of two blue Fabled Omniverses bloomed as they looked like two clear cerulean boundaries.
But with the passage of time, these boundaries seemed to gain more and more lines of weavings as they became more intricate.
More complex.
It was the product of the much more complex weavings of authority returning to Noah!
|The Infinity Fabled Omniverse and Manadynamics Fabled Omniverse are growing with exponential complexity.|
This prompt flashed wondrously as Nkah didn't hold back.
He continued forward like a bolt of lightning as by the time that the Antediluvian Leviathans burning with Entropy replied to him...Noah was a few miles away from this titanic entity!
This entity who gazed at Noah inexplicably as he replied.
|I come from the Primal Family of Epimetheus- I am Arguros. Engineer Osmont, I do not think you are stupid, but you do not seem to be heeding my advice even a little.|
Arguros.
His words carried majesty and intrigue as they emanated out.
By the time the words of Arguros finished, Noah had shockingly come to be beside him.
Side by side with the terrifying titan whose strides alone covered tremendous distance, and calm waves of Entropy steadily left him while even more complex ones returned to him!

The scene of Noah being right next to Arguros astonished those who were keeping an eye on him due to his flashy movements, many changing their gazes from ones that were looking at a fool to ones that were looking at another possible powerful contender.
Above Arguros, they could see the illusion of an utterly radiant purple violet Eye of Existence that seemed to be discerning everything and allowing for wondrous interactions of existence.

But above Noah's figure...they didn't see any such thing as it either meant he was someone weak who had not even reached the State of Eye of Existence, or he didn't feel the need to utilize it now even as he wildly let his authority out!
The former possibility didn't make sense, and the latter seemed even more off.
Many kept their gazes on the leading figures of Noah and Arguros as they also expended more of their authority to pull forward faster.
Standing side by side with the giant, Noah felt the glimpses of Entropy closely from this being as he nodded towards him.

|It is not that I am ignoring your words, Brother Arguros, but that I am confident in what I am doing. I am very curious about the Antediluvian Leviathans though. Your connection to the Omnifather...and even who the Omnifather is.|
He effortlessly held the conversation as he kept pace with this leading titan!

Arguros turned his head down towards the figure beside him that looked like a small blue point of light compared to him who was a blinding violet purple sun, his flaming brows rising with even greater intrigue as he opened his mouth and gushed out tendrils of Entropy.

|We existed long before others. We were there to witness the glory of the Omnifather as he collected hundreds of Omniverses and ushered in an era of prosperity. The Antediluvian Leviathans...are composed of four Primal Families that have been secluded since the Omnifather left us. The time for our seclusion to end was when the weavings of the Omnifather began to spin again, and they have. And so, here we are following his weavings once more. For us, traversing this Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence is an honor. Our existence was meant to thrive on it.|
Their existence was meant to thrive on the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3306 Terrific! IV
paragraphs: |Your existence...it is Entropy, is it not? All parts of you are aligned with this?|
Hearing the words of Arguros, Noah asked thoughtfully as he also digested the idea of Antediluvian Leviathans and four Primal Families.
|Entropy...|
Arguros raised his hand and let out a rare smile towards Noah for knowing the identity of his weavings.
His levels of power were unfathomable as he looked like an elder passing down his knowledge to the next generation.
Yet...his strides were getting a little faster as he found that Noah's figure continued to increase in speed!

|I am Entropy. I live and breathe Entropy. My thoughts, records, and very existence are only held together by endless disorder. Only after you leave everything else behind and let the flow of Entropy take over...can you truly understand it.|
His booming voice filled with regality echoed out as Noah's eyes turned into crescent smiles.
|Entropy, huh?|
Brilliance flashed in his eyes.
The pure, blue mana that coursed to make the Manadynamics Fabled Omniverse began to pulse uniquely as soon enough, it began to change color.
|The weavings of the existence of Manadynamics have reached a critical level.|
|Many more possibilities are now inevitabilities.|
The blue mana burned.
Mana could neither be created nor destroyed.
It could only be transformed.
At this moment...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Cheats begins to sound the drums of war.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist says to be ready!|
The purer blue mana began to change.
As if the very fundamental makeup of these endless waves of energy were something else to begin with.
A violet purple hue began to shine below Noah's feet as instead of the endless sea of blue gushing below him...pristine waves of Entropy began to gush out instead.
A seamless transformation.
As if it was always the authority of Entropy to begin with!
BOOM!

Seas of Entropy fervor gushed down from Noah as in the next moment, even more complex waves of Entropy returned to him from the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence as the small body of Entropy within his First Mundi of Power...instantly began to explode in size and complexity!
|Brother Arguros, how does my Entropy compare in terms of purity?|
He seemed to be asking purely out of curiosity.
Besides Noah, Arguros became stern at such a scene as the flames of Entropy around him burned with even greater brilliance.

| The purity of a single Source is critical- and the reason why the Antediluvian Leviathans can be so powerful. We follow the edicts of the Omnifather as he advised one to focus all their weavings on a single Source. Only through this path can one have the straightest shot toward the utmost complexity. But if there are too many sources...the level of complexity required will be forever out of reach as one may find themselves never reaching a certain height of Existence even after eons passed. While following a single pure source, you will attain oneness with Existence faster. Open your Eye of Existence faster...and even have a pathway to establish your Ordinance with more ease.|
Purity.
Purity in the focus of only a single Source of Existence!

Noah smiled at such a reply as his figure was entirely encased in a chaotic violet purple light at this moment, the hues of the blue Fabled Omniverses still remaining as at this moment, he looked like a miniature version of the titan beside him.

|Mana is the ultimate form of energy. The ultimate source of energy. Naturally, it can become other forms and sources of energy. Is this not still pure, Brother Arguros? This Entropy...can be seen as Mana in a different form.|
He radiated an intensity that caused the ancient eyes of Arguros to pulse with an interminable light.
At the same time, within his First Mundi of Power, great changes continued!
|Countless records are converging under Entropy.|
An expanding singularity became condensed rapidly.
So rapid that in a short instant, a Quintus Core of Existence was formed, and from this core...
|The Basis of the Fabled Omniverse of Entropy has been stabilized.|
|The Fourth Fabled Omniverse within the Conceptual System of Existence is blooming.|
First, it was Quintessence.
Infinity and Manadynamics followed as the fourth came out to be Entropy!

And his figure...continued to get ever faster as at this moment, his figure pulled slightly ahead of Arguros who gazed at him while replying to his question regarding the source of mana and its transformation into other forms of authority.

|That is too difficult to do, Engineer Osmont. It is feasible to transform the most fundamental source of existence into other forms, but the cost of this cannot be so easily covered. For anyone to grasp onto such weavings, they would need things that only the greatest among us can attain. Qualities present in beings who moved within the era of the Omnifather...or even in the distant lands of the Megalos Beyond, those who moved with the Great Beyonder.|
A clear rebuttal from the Antediluvian Leviathan.
He stated that a terrifying quality that nobody could easily grasp was a prerequisite to even thinking about successfully doing what Noah proposed.
And yet Noah knew he held this along with much more.
The seas of Mana within him continued to surge out even more as they transformed into Entropy, and a violet-purple outline of Fabled Omniverse bloomed.
With bright eyes, he released a shocking statement as he...pulled ahead of the Antediluvian Leviathan.
|Brother Arguros...what if I have such a profound quality that makes the impossible a reality?|
SAA!
His figure was visibly ahead.
It was a scene that caused alarm in many of those observing as Arguros himself stared sternly at Noah's figure!
He didn't reply as he seemed to be thinking of many things, but ultimately...his body began to leak out a maddening amount of disorder.
He looked at the distance Noah was creating as he pulled ahead, and this Antediluvian Leviathan blinked with ancientness.
As if he could allow a junior of his to pull ahead.
HUUUM!
Swirling violet purple flames gathered as if trillions of singularities pulled upon them.
Above Arguros, a banner manifested and began to burn bright.
It was a banner that held a rune burning with the grandiosity that read...ENTROPY.
It was...an Ordinance of Entropy.
Slightly ahead, Noah felt his weavings of Entropy pulsing in resonance as he was about to turn around to gaze at Arguros, but his gaze couldn't do it all the way.
Because in the next moment...
SAA!
A bolt of violet purple light passed him and forged ahead with unfathomable speed!
Atop this flash, a glorious banner was unfolding- one that nobody could deny!

chapters.title: Chapter 3307 What Lies Ahead! I
paragraphs: Ordinance.
A form of declaration of one's existence.
After establishing that they were One With Existence and opening the Eye of Existence, one had to build up a great deal of complexity until their Ordinance could be formed!
Until it was said loud and clear across all weavings of existence that a singular, pure thing defined that person.
For the Antediluvian Leviathan Arguros, it was Entropy.
The moment that the banner rose above him, his body now longer seemed like anything else other than Entropy as the surrounding weavings of Existence also fell into this state.
The area around him turned violet purple as tendrils of flames spread out where he passed that were forever changed!

Instantly, he took the lead across many of those traversing the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence and pulled ahead- rivers of extremely pure, potent, and complex waves of Entropy being returned to him as his titanic figure became utterly thrumming with power.
In the far distance, one could see the beginning of the huge outline of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence itself as they had been rushing forward for quite some time.
They were powerful entities as all were moving faster than the speed of light at this moment, and yet many were still traversing on one different colored root.
But for Arguros and a few other select entities, they could finally see the ends of the root of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence they were on...and the beginning of the trunk.

In the distance, the commotion between Arguros and Noah had drawn many more eyes as the Simians were drawn over as well, with the perceptive visage of the Shield of the Commonwealth having his pupils constrict at the sight of Noah!
|Osmont?|
The Protector from Omniverse X-999.
A just recently discovered Omniverse as those within it didn't hold much power, but this Protector Osmont was unique as he was able to unravel the weavings of Agents of Anti-Life!

He would have been a good weapon to begin cleansing the decayed roots within the Commonwealth as Old Man Eudemus had already received word that the Equestris Protectors were on their way back to the Omniverse of the Protectors after accomplishing their mission.
But...

His power was at the stage where he had already attained the Eye of Existence? And what quality did he have that was currently causing him to senselessly release his authority and rapidly traverse upwards to be far ahead of most of the powerful entities here?!
'Did I miss something?|
Old Man Eudemus wondered.
But for others, seeing the scene of Arguros and Noah, their hearts only felt like they had to go ever faster or they would lose something as they burned their reserves of authority ever faster!
BOOM!
On the golden surface of the root, Noah stared at the distant figure of Arguros that was pulling away faster and faster as all around him, existence itself had turned into pure storms of Entropy.
|A new form of Entropy has been discovered.|
A prompt rose within his mind as his speed also became even faster because of this change of existence brought about due to Arguros displaying his Ordinance.
|The potency of Entropy in the surrounding field of existence has been increased by an unquantifiable amount.|
|The usage of any other authorities apart from Entropy will find it hard to display even a fraction of their potency.|
Why were those who had reached the Ordinance of Existence so powerful?
Existence itself would undeniably become part of their Ordinance as going against it...was akin to going against existence itself!
Impossible.
But since Noah was already wreathed in Entropy, his figure became even faster while he analyzed the variation of this authority from another.

The extremely pure waves of authority being returned to him were currently being stored across various parts of his existence as apart from the authorities that had already formed their Fabled Omniverses, the others slowly began to increase in the breadth of their complexity.
As parts of Noah rose higher, other parts followed!

In the far distance as he neared the multicolored trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, the intent of Arguros flowed back towards Noah as his booming voice filled with ancientness and wisdom continued.

|Engineer Osmont, if you truly have something special similar to the giants of eons ago that have come and gone, then that is all the better for Megalos Ynnere. But it also means that it is even more critical for you to stick to a single, pure path. This...is strictly because of what comes next as your power elevates.|
WUU!
Around him, only Entropy reigned as the voice of Arguros seemed to be coming right beside him.
And truly...amidst the flaming storms of violet purple flames that seemed like they would never burn out, an illusory figure of Arguros formed as he looked towards Noah sternly!

|One With Existence. Eye of Existence. Ordinance of Existence. Do you not know what comes after that, Engineer Osmont? It would be enough to deter anyone from following anything more than a single, pure, path. The next stages of Existence can distinguish you from others in an unfathomable way, and they are also the stages where powerful entities who have formed their Ordinance...have the highest rate of Mortality.|
The highest rate of mortality for entities who had forged their Ordinance.
What!
An Existence at the Existential Dominium Realm alone could live for billions of years- entire cycles and eons as their existence and records wouldn't yet perish.
And yet...death- a high chance of it at that, occurred in these grander stages of power?
Noah continued shooting across like a bolt of lightning as the illusory construct of Arguros kept pace with him calmly.

|After one declares their Ordinance, they have to then merge with it, and it alone. All of their existence has to be wholly dedicated to it as if there is even a small part of them that holds attachments to other weavings not part of their Ordinance...their very existence will break down and shatter! But if successful, they would have stepped onto the state of existence known as...Ordinance Amalgamation.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3308 What Lies Ahead! II
paragraphs: Ordinance Amalgamation!
Every part of one's existence merged and fully inline with their Ordinance and nothing else.
If there was even a glimpse of hesitation.
A sliver of a doubt or attachment to other weavings.
Ordinance Amalgamation would fail as the rejection was one that would cause the collapse of every single part of one's weavings!
Noah heard these words from the Antediluvian Leviathan Arguros who seemed to be trying to help him, but the light within his eyes didn't change.
Quintessence.
Infinity.
Protagonist.
Loot.
There were too many things that defined him as he didn't want to leave any of them behind.
His resolute gaze was observed by Arguros as this Leviathan gazed at Noah calmly before he continued.

|At Ordinance Amalgamation, one can traverse the Expanse without expending one of their bodies to die ever so often. You will have a heavy weight that your existence carries as for others to deny your Ordinance of Existence and erase it...they would need an equally powerful Ordinance or one that opposes it entirely. This stage of existence lets it be known that truly, one's focus can only be a single thing. The Wheel of Existence thrives on purity. One's existence thrives on purity. But if that wasn't enough, there is what comes after Ordinance Amalgamation.|

The stage of Existential Dominium Realms and what they were broken down into became left behind as at this moment, Noah felt like he was getting knowledge on the overarching stages of power of the Omniversal Realm.
How levels of power generally went for others- one aspect of it anyways.
The aspect of States of Existence.
One With Existence, Eye of Existence, Ordinance of Existence, Ordinance Amalgamation.
What came next?
HUUM!
His body endlessly gushed out Entropy as the concentration of what was returned to him was reaching critical junctures.
Around him, another layer of the Fabled Omniverse of Entropy burned into existence as in the next few moments, more and more layers began to appear!

|Entropy has exceeded the parameters of concentration of authority within a single Fabled Omniverse. More Fabled Omniverses of Entropy are being constructed and overlapped on the original Fabled Omniverse of Entropy.|
Pure waves of wonder seethed within him as multiple layers of Fabled Omniverses began to bloom.
And at this time, the deep voice of Arguros reached him again.

|After one steps into Ordinance Amalgamation, they through a long, long period of accumulation to increase the complexity of their existence that is now amalgamated with their Ordinance. Those with Ordinances that have great weight and distinction may be fortunate enough to proceed ahead, while those with weak ordinances will forever be stuck at this stage. If you happen to have a profound enough Ordinance, you will reach a critical ceiling where you cannot proceed any further in complexity. Where existence itself seems to have arrived at a cap in terms of complexity. No matter what you do, your complexity of existence will not increase any further as at this stage...one must sever existence itself to forge ahead.|
BOOM!
|Existence Severing. This is the stage that comes after Ordinance Amalgamation, and those who die trying to sever who they are from Existence itself...are too many.|
The Severing of Existence itself!
When Arguros spoke of this, there was a tremor in his intent as if he was thinking of something truly terrifying.
Something even he feared!

|It is such a perilous process that across the Megalos of Existence, Across the Expanse, most deaths over the countless cycles can be attributed to the process of Existence Severing- Ordinance Amalgamation only coming close second.|
The intent of Arguros carried with it an extremely heavy tone.
One that seemed to express immense reverence and fear of this stage of power at the same time!
Noah internalized all of these new waves of information as he became stern.

But as he and Arguros exchanged these intents, the situation in the surroundings was changing drastically as the body of Arguros seemed to get ever closer towards the starting point of the trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
On other roots, unique entities with terrifying Banners of Ordinances above their heads were also catching up and forging forward at this moment!
Noah was triggered for Arguros.
Arguros acted as the trigger for others.
All around this root and the roots nearby...
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Shocking banners unfolded.
Multiple Ordinances were laid out!
Fantastical beams of light shot forward!
There were too many existences who had lived for an extremely long period of time over the past eons.
Some had forged the complexity of their existence to an unfathomable level as they had fully attained their Ordinance of Existence.
Now, they put it all to use in order to grasp this shocking opportunity laid out before them!
In the distance, the visage of the Shield of the Commonwealth sighed as his look of an old man faded.
Golden light began to gather around him as moments later...
BOOM!
A glorious golden banner erupted.
The Ordinance of Kuklos.
The Ordinance of the Wheel!
He was the one who was telling others to preserve their authority as they proceeded forward, but even he couldn't stop himself from joining all other truly powerful entities at this moment.
His figure shot out like a speeding bullet across the surface of the root he was on as his gaze was far, far ahead!
And somehow, in a field of entities who had already declared the Ordinances of their Existence, Noah was ahead of most of them.
At this moment, he received the intent of Arguros for the last time.

|Think of it very carefully, Engineer Osmont. Do not be among those who fail to even Amalgamate their Ordinance and perish. For the future that the Omnifather had envisioned is far too grand...and we should all be able to enjoy it.|
A dazzling intent.

The moment it was finished, all observing wills saw the visage of Arguros reached the multicolored trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence as he didn't slow down at all, becoming even faster as he smashed into the surface of the trunk!
And...
PAH!
His figure disappeared entirely.
As if he was drawn into the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence itself!

|It is such a perilous process that across the Megalos of Existence, Across the Expanse, most deaths over the countless cycles can be attributed to the process of Existence Severing- Ordinance Amalgamation only coming close second.|
The intent of Arguros carried with it an extremely heavy tone.
One that seemed to express immense reverence and fear of this stage of power at the same time!
Noah internalized all of these new waves of information as he became stern.

But as he and Arguros exchanged these intents, the situation in the surroundings was changing drastically as the body of Arguros seemed to get ever closer towards the starting point of the trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
On other roots, unique entities with terrifying Banners of Ordinances above their heads were also catching up and forging forward at this moment!
Noah was triggered for Arguros.
Arguros acted as the trigger for others.
All around this root and the roots nearby...
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
Shocking banners unfolded.
Multiple Ordinances were laid out!
Fantastical beams of light shot forward!
There were too many existences who had lived for an extremely long period of time over the past eons.
Some had forged the complexity of their existence to an unfathomable level as they had fully attained their Ordinance of Existence.
Now, they put it all to use in order to grasp this shocking opportunity laid out before them!
In the distance, the visage of the Shield of the Commonwealth sighed as his look of an old man faded.
Golden light began to gather around him as moments later...
BOOM!
A glorious golden banner erupted.
The Ordinance of Kuklos.
The Ordinance of the Wheel!
He was the one who was telling others to preserve their authority as they proceeded forward, but even he couldn't stop himself from joining all other truly powerful entities at this moment.
His figure shot out like a speeding bullet across the surface of the root he was on as his gaze was far, far ahead!
And somehow, in a field of entities who had already declared the Ordinances of their Existence, Noah was ahead of most of them.
At this moment, he received the intent of Arguros for the last time.
|Think of it very carefully, Engineer Osmont.
Do not be among those who fail to even Amalgamate their Ordinance and perish.
For the future that the Omnifather had envisioned is far too grand...and we should all be able to enjoy it.|
A dazzling intent.

The moment it was finished, all observing wills saw the visage of Arguros reached the multicolored trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence as he didn't slow down at all, becoming even faster as he smashed into the surface of the trunk!
And...
PAH!
His figure disappeared entirely.
As if he was drawn into the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 3309 The Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence! I
paragraphs: The moment that Arguros smashed into the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, a few other observable entities on other roots did the same.
But...the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence was vast as those in this space couldn't even observe the other side of this massive tree.
And even if they could...would they have been able to even observe entities who had exceeded the stage of Ordinance of Existence and were already in the stage of Ordinance Amalgamation?
It could not be said with surety that Arguros was the first to enter the trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
A distance away, Noah also closed in as he broke down bundles of information that this Antediluvian Leviathan released.
Ordinance Amalgamation. Existence Severing.
Once complexity arrived at a critical enough juncture, one had to cut themselves away from Existence entirely- they had to Sever!
Yet the fatalities for this and the stage before it were high as the most critical thing was a single, pure source for one to rely on.
Noah...was taking a different route entirely as he had his Atlas of Existence.
Nine different Sources of Existence could fill it as within his first System of Existence, he had the overarching umbrella of concepts as within it- hundreds of concepts mixed in!
Purity of sources was not under his banner. But even after hearing all the things that Arguros stated, his heart never faltered regarding the path he was taking!
Not a single thing would be left behind.
Not Infinity.
Not Tyranny.
Not Quintessence.
He didn't just want a single source, he wanted them all!
HUUM!

His very existence vibrated as if it were agreeing with these thoughts, his figure becoming a pure blur of light as within moments, the trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence was before his eyes as well.
PAH!

His figure felt like it smashed into a comfortable body of plasma and not the solid exterior of a tree, disappearing into it entirely as he...was among the first set of Entities to step into the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence!
Alongside those who had formed their Ordinances- and theoretically, some who had even Amalgamated it.
It was unknown just what level of power was the highest among those who had entered the square white portals that appeared within the vast stretches of the Megalos Ynnere.
The moment that Noah stepped into the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, his figure found itself transported across...a string.

A string reminiscent of the countless golden strings within the Expanse- but this string was verdant in color as he crossed uncountable distances to finally arrive...in a small domain that was surrounded by 9 circular layers of verdant rings of light.
The rings were spinning calmly around each other, the largest one occupying the most space on the outside as there were smaller rings towards the center.
And Noah appeared in the very center as not too far from him was a flickering golden star.
This star was radiating an intent that bloomed into understandable words soon after.

[You have stepped onto the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence and accessed the Tresorverse Sacred Domain that was sculpted by the Omnifather from a segment of the Expanse and the Megalos Ynnere.]

[The Tresorverse Sacred Domain has its own Existential Continuum, with no entry allowed for any Entity unless it is through the possession and assimilation of the existence of those already living within it.]

[The lifeforms within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain are unique entities that only existed for a few cycles many eons ago within the Expanse, their Weavings of Existence being so potent that they could smoothly traverse across the States of Existence in an extremely short period of time. Known as the Sacred Primal Megalonians, the potency of their weavings of existence also made them targets as when devoured by others, tremendous levels of complexity of existence can be gained that make it easy to attain the more intricate latter states of Existence and even greater weavings of complexity.]

[These Sacred Primal Megalonians were hunted, eradicated, and devoured entirely the moment that the potency of their existence was discovered by others, never gaining the chance to illuminate across the Expanse. The Omnifather has pulled onto unfathomable weavings to reconstruct the existence of these lifeforms within this Tresorverse Sacred Domain, and you can possess and assimilate a random Sacred Primal Megalonian depending on your level of complexity of existence.]

[In the time it takes for this dying star to fade, release as much of your complexity of existence into this isolated domain, and depending on the quantity and quality of complexity, you will be granted the possession and assimilation of an Average Sacred Primal Megalonian, a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian, a Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian, or even an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. Depending on which Megalonian you assimilate while entering the Tresorverse Sacred Domain, the level of talent and true source of the reconstructed Megalonian will vary tremendously.]

[The timeline of the Tresorverse Sacred Domain is set, the events to play out within are set, and the eventual destruction of the Sacred Primal Megalonians is set. The gains made in complexity and states of Existence will be retained once the set events have come to pass, and the pathway up the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence will open up once more.]
A flood of waves of information surged out from the dazzling star, Noah processing it extremely quickly as great surprise reverberated through him!
A domain with a set timeline, set events, and set entities.
Accessible only by possession and assimilation, but the gains to be made within were tremendous as they were based on...what type of entity you could possess.
An Average Sacred Primal Megalonian, a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian, a Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian, or even an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
And the selection of such an entity was based on the complexity and amount of existence one could release within this space filled with 9 rings of verdant light!

chapters.title: Chapter 3310 The Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence! II
paragraphs: For the entrants who had just arrived at the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, the reserves of their weavings of existence should already be greatly used up, especially if they rapidly released everything to climb up the roots even faster.

In the amount of time it took for the light of the dying star ahead to fade, they may not be able to fill up much of this space with their remaining weavings as their possible chance of attaining an extremely rare possession of a Megalonian...would be very low!
How quickly one went from the Root to the Trunk mattered.
Quantity mattered.
But so did quality.

For extremely powerful beings like Arguros, even if they had spent a significant percentage of their authority to quickly arrive at the Trunk, they would likely still get a rare Megalonian to possess as their complexity and power were much greater!

And there may also be entities who would be entirely spent if they hurried here without any reservation for their authority, and they wouldn't be able to release much before the dying star faded- and they would only possess an average Megalonian.
Then...there was Noah.

His eyes were luminously bright as the moment that the words of the dying star stated one had to release the weavings of their existence; his body had already begun to maddeningly radiate Mana all around!
The mana...flourished into many different forms.
Entropy.
Quintessence.
Infinity.
Manadynamics.
Cheats!
Quantity.
Quality.
Complexity!
Out of all beings, he decimated them all when it came to quantity.
And even though his existence was not as complex as entities like Arguros...he had multiple different weavings of existence!
So he let it all out.
And even though his existence was not as complex as entities like Arguros...he had multiple different weavings of existence!
So he let it all out.
His very existence vibrated as pure blue Mana leaked out of him in endless tides, and a few inches from his body, it would simultaneously transform into different weavings of existence.
It was taxing.
It required his existence to ensure everything was going smoothly with these constant transformations!
But he did it all regardless as infinite waves of mana tumbled out.
In front of him, a star was dimming rapidly, but before even 80% of its radiance was lost- 6 of the Nine verdant rings in this space were already filled with multicolored weavings of Existence!
It was a reality that foretold shocking things to come.
In another isolated space.
The massive body of The Antediluvian Leviathan, Arguros, sat with blazing Entropy which leaked out all around him with complexity.
In front of him, the light of a dying star was only left with a shred of itself remaining.

In his surroundings, 5 rings that were circling this isolated domain were filled with violet purple flames of Entropy, only four exterior rings not being filled as the tongues of flames now reached out towards the sixth ring.
As he experienced this phenomenon and even recalled the legends of the Sacred Primal Megalonians, he shook his head while thinking of Engineer Osmont.
To arrive here so quickly, he would likely only have a shred of his reserves of existence available.
|With only a sliver remaining after you used so much...an Average Megalonian possession is the furthest you will be granted...ah! Missed opportunity. Missed opportunity!|

Arguros shook his head as even he had only heard a little of the legends of a lineage within the Expanse that did not live for long before they were extinguished entirely due to the composition of their existence.
Had they been given even another Cycle or two to thrive, they may have become the most powerful Entities across the Megalos and the Expanse.
That was how intricately built their existences were.
They were anomalies of nature that were devoured absolutely, with their destruction giving rise to some of the most powerful Entities across the Expanse and Megalos!
This was one of the chances that the Omnifather provided within this Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
But who could tremendously benefit from it?

Arguros shook his head again as he gave one last thought of pity towards Engineer Osmont, and he then focused on himself entirely as his complex weavings of existence burned brightly, the light of the dying star entirely fading as everything became frozen thereafter.
HUUM!
As if everything was being measured.
And within moments...the dead star let out one last intent.
[According to the quantity, complexity, and speed of arrival, you have been granted the possession and assimilation of a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian- Hayashi.]
|What!|
Arguros' gaze changed.
His complexity of existence. The amount of weavings he was able to release...all of it only granted a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian?!
In his shock, a blinding green light flashed as he disappeared.
In another isolated space.

A massive Omniversal Dragoserpent radiated tendrils of golden Dignity all around him that managed to fill four rings of the nine contained in this space, an Ordinance of Dignity blazing above him as the light of a dying star disappeared before him!
[According to the quantity, complexity, and speed of arrival, you have been granted the possession and assimilation of an Average Sacred Primal Megalonian- Todo.]
The eyes of the Omniversal Dragoserpent that had already declared its Ordinance nearly popped out in dismay.
In another area.

Weavings of golden wheel spun gloriously as they filled up six rings of the isolated space, the Shield of the Commonwealth, Old Man Eudemus- gazing ahead with shining eyes as the light of a dying star flickered out of existence!
And...
[According to the quantity, complexity, and speed of arrival, you have been granted the possession and assimilation of a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian- Ceseius.]
The pupils of this old man opened wide as he disappeared in the next moment.
One by one, entities arrived.
One by one, they were transported to a fantastical place.
But without a doubt, every one of them was shocked at the results they obtained for their possession!
But in one isolated space.
Nine verdant rings were filled to the brim with countless multicolored lights, with their edges actually creaking as if they couldn't contain too much more of the expressed authority!
A dying star still had 20% of its light remaining, but it seemed nervous and distraught at this moment as it urged its light to die out even faster!
