chapters.title: Chapter 3311 Dominance!
paragraphs: Others arrived into the isolated domain with a fraction of their authority remaining within them as half of the nine rings of glorious verdant light were filled as a dying star flickered out of existence and disappeared forever.
But for Noah, waves of complexity flooded out from him as all nine verdant rings were filled to the brim, with these rings shaking as if they were about to break at any moment!

The dying star trembled with anxiety when it saw this scene as it no longer waited for its light to die out naturally, its complexity actively moving to snuff itself out as within an instant, the remaining glow of 20% disappeared.
A star snuffed itself out of existence since it looked like things were about to break!
HUUUM!
Everything trembled with majesty thereafter as...
A clear demarcation seemingly could not be made.

Soon after, a blinding verdant light of immense power flashed in as if it was required to make the determination, and a message flashed by Noah's eyes briefly before he felt his existence sucked towards an unknown place!
[According to the quantity, complexity, and speed of arrival, you have been granted the possession and assimilation of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- Pyrrhus.]
Words that caused Noah's brilliance to shine ever more, and then everything went dark.
In another part of the Tresorverse of the Omnifather.
Within the Tresorverse Primalwater that was used to nurture the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
All of those who had not transcended their existence were sent to these waters, with those most perceptive noticing radiant globes of light across the depths of the blue waters all around them.
One's very weavings of Existence felt a tug towards any of these globes as multiple deaths had occurred to obtain them.
At this moment.

Henry and the few hundred entities from the Infinite Omniverse moved as a single unit as they were truly far too weak in this landscape, but they came across a dazzling golden globe of light that had nobody else near, with Henry going forward and getting his hands on it right away!

Henry and the few hundred entities from the Infinite Omniverse moved as a single unit as they were truly far too weak in this landscape, but they came across a dazzling golden globe of light that had nobody else near, with Henry going forward and getting his hands on it right away!
But at that moment...
BZZT!

A golden wheel flashed above them as a Simian floated over with a sharp gaze, a Fabled Omniverse swirling around him as he radiated an oppressive pressure while voicing out commandingly- his eyes on the golden globe of brilliance.
|Give it.|
Two words.
Ones that emanated profound tyranny as if they didn't get what they asked for in the next moment, they let it be known what would happen as a terrifying pressure cascaded down.
Someone who had enacted a Fabled Omniverse!
Henry's gaze was cold towards this being that none of them could stand against, and yet...he gazed up fearlessly.
|There are many more out there, and we obtained this first. Do not force us!|
...! His gaze was calm and filled with regality as if he were a young prince from ancient times!
He spoke domineeringly towards an Omniversal Realm entity who didn't bother to speak another word to them, scoffing with coldness as he made a move.
But...Henry truly did not fear this enemy.
After all, who was he?
|Nepotism radiates a gaze of arrogance and majesty.|
One of the core concepts within him bubbled forth.
Who was he? He was the son of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer.

He waved his hands as instantly, two golden statues of a Fat Monkey bloomed and shot out like speeding bullets- their complexity weavings actually making them faster than any Autarch as they pulsed unstable with Matter and Dark Matter!
New and improved Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.

Weapons holdings within them artificially unstable weavings of Matter and Dark Matter that would act to unravel and disrupt all weavings of existence- their potency being a tremendous level above what was used previously by Noah.
Their speed was a testament to this as Noah modified them to be usable with anyone he trusted enough, with their burst speed going from the owner to the target in an extremely short period of time!
By the time that the Omniversal Stage Simian changed his gaze as his existence felt unprecedented danger and the Golden wheels bloomed around him, the Fat Monkeys were only meters away.
They were truly fat- their bellies being made wide as their faces were devilish ones that were smiling.
The moment they detonated, their bellies turned crimson hot as their expressions deteriorated from a smile and into a rageful glare.
And...
BOOM! BOOM!

Murky obsidian radiance followed by waves of scorching crimson light radiated outwards, the wills of many existences gazing over this direction in shock as even those who were far away felt their existences tremble with instability!
Almost as if their very makeup was shaken and wanted to break down just from the residual waves of disruption they could feel from afar.
As for the entity that was dead center?
In the blue waters, churning and chaotic waves roared as when the scene cleared, torn and deteriorated weavings of existence were the only things left behind.
The Omniversal Realm Entity...less than 10% of his body remained as a wailing remnant will within a deteriorating Fabled Omniverse was all that was left behind!
It was a shocking scene.
Henry gazed all around him coldly as he held the golden globe in his hands freely- but this time, not a single person showed a greedy light as everyone scattered towards other directions!
Silence reigned.
But not too long as...
"Well damn, what was that?" Erikson had his slippers already in his hands for a fight as he looked between Henry and the deadly explosion ahead of them.
Henry only grasped the golden aurora in his hands tightly as his Bloodline churned while he replied.
"Just something father gave in case of emergencies."

sentences.text: Others arrived into the isolated domain with a fraction of their authority remaining within them as half of the nine rings of glorious verdant light were filled as a dying star flickered out of existence and disappeared forever.
But for Noah, waves of complexity flooded out from him as all nine verdant rings were filled to the brim, with these rings shaking as if they were about to break at any moment!

The dying star trembled with anxiety when it saw this scene as it no longer waited for its light to die out naturally, its complexity actively moving to snuff itself out as within an instant, the remaining glow of 20% disappeared.
A star snuffed itself out of existence since it looked like things were about to break!
HUUUM!
Everything trembled with majesty thereafter as...
A clear demarcation seemingly could not be made.

Soon after, a blinding verdant light of immense power flashed in as if it was required to make the determination, and a message flashed by Noah's eyes briefly before he felt his existence sucked towards an unknown place!
[According to the quantity, complexity, and speed of arrival, you have been granted the possession and assimilation of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- Pyrrhus.]
Words that caused Noah's brilliance to shine ever more, and then everything went dark.
In another part of the Tresorverse of the Omnifather.
Within the Tresorverse Primalwater that was used to nurture the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
All of those who had not transcended their existence were sent to these waters, with those most perceptive noticing radiant globes of light across the depths of the blue waters all around them.
One's very weavings of Existence felt a tug towards any of these globes as multiple deaths had occurred to obtain them.
At this moment.

Henry and the few hundred entities from the Infinite Omniverse moved as a single unit as they were truly far too weak in this landscape, but they came across a dazzling golden globe of light that had nobody else near, with Henry going forward and getting his hands on it right away!

Henry and the few hundred entities from the Infinite Omniverse moved as a single unit as they were truly far too weak in this landscape, but they came across a dazzling golden globe of light that had nobody else near, with Henry going forward and getting his hands on it right away!
But at that moment...
BZZT!

A golden wheel flashed above them as a Simian floated over with a sharp gaze, a Fabled Omniverse swirling around him as he radiated an oppressive pressure while voicing out commandingly- his eyes on the golden globe of brilliance.
|Give it.|
Two words.
Ones that emanated profound tyranny as if they didn't get what they asked for in the next moment, they let it be known what would happen as a terrifying pressure cascaded down.
Someone who had enacted a Fabled Omniverse!
Henry's gaze was cold towards this being that none of them could stand against, and yet...he gazed up fearlessly.
|There are many more out there, and we obtained this first.
Do not force us!|
His gaze was calm and filled with regality as if he were a young prince from ancient times!
He spoke domineeringly towards an Omniversal Realm entity who didn't bother to speak another word to them, scoffing with coldness as he made a move.
But...Henry truly did not fear this enemy.
After all, who was he?
|Nepotism radiates a gaze of arrogance and majesty.|
One of the core concepts within him bubbled forth.
Who was he?
He was the son of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer.

He waved his hands as instantly, two golden statues of a Fat Monkey bloomed and shot out like speeding bullets- their complexity weavings actually making them faster than any Autarch as they pulsed unstable with Matter and Dark Matter!
New and improved Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.

Weapons holdings within them artificially unstable weavings of Matter and Dark Matter that would act to unravel and disrupt all weavings of existence- their potency being a tremendous level above what was used previously by Noah.
Their speed was a testament to this as Noah modified them to be usable with anyone he trusted enough, with their burst speed going from the owner to the target in an extremely short period of time!
By the time that the Omniversal Stage Simian changed his gaze as his existence felt unprecedented danger and the Golden wheels bloomed around him, the Fat Monkeys were only meters away.
They were truly fat- their bellies being made wide as their faces were devilish ones that were smiling.
The moment they detonated, their bellies turned crimson hot as their expressions deteriorated from a smile and into a rageful glare.
And...
BOOM!
BOOM!

Murky obsidian radiance followed by waves of scorching crimson light radiated outwards, the wills of many existences gazing over this direction in shock as even those who were far away felt their existences tremble with instability!
Almost as if their very makeup was shaken and wanted to break down just from the residual waves of disruption they could feel from afar.
As for the entity that was dead center?
In the blue waters, churning and chaotic waves roared as when the scene cleared, torn and deteriorated weavings of existence were the only things left behind.
The Omniversal Realm Entity...less than 10% of his body remained as a wailing remnant will within a deteriorating Fabled Omniverse was all that was left behind!
It was a shocking scene.
Henry gazed all around him coldly as he held the golden globe in his hands freely- but this time, not a single person showed a greedy light as everyone scattered towards other directions!
Silence reigned.
But not too long as...
"Well damn, what was that?" Erikson had his slippers already in his hands for a fight as he looked between Henry and the deadly explosion ahead of them.
Henry only grasped the golden aurora in his hands tightly as his Bloodline churned while he replied.
"Just something father gave in case of emergencies."
With a glimmer of brilliance, bundles of information bloomed in Henry's eyes that his father was also using to observe everything occurring within this space of the Tresorverse Primalwater.
[Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 3312 Pyrrhus! I
paragraphs: Inside the Tresorverse Primalwater that was used to nurture the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, there were actually Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitations laid out for entities to build up their complexity.

With them, they could quickly escape the Existential Dominium Realm and build enough complexity to step into the Omniversal Realm, and if they were lucky enough...even possibly attain the first State of Existence!

Without a delay, Henry threw the Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitation into his mouth and devoured it entirely, his whole body beginning to radiate a golden glow as nearby, Barbatos stepped forward and voiced out with excitement.

|Alright y'all, Little Fish has distributed those weapons over to some of you through your Lineage. Those chosen...led a team of a dozen others and spread out across this Tresorverse Primalwater- obtain as many of these golden globes as you can!|
A command was given.
Very quickly, Sona, the Sanctus Autarch, Lilith, Kazuhiko, and a few others took the lead while a dozen entities lined up behind them- and they then shot out across the blue waters with fervor.

It was the start of the dominance of a group of beings that began extremely weak, and yet in their hands...utterly terrifying tools of mass destruction that could be unleashed at any moment would come to teach a few entities irreversible lessons!
Within the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
Inside a Tresorverse Sacred Domain.
Its timeline was set in stone, and so were the events that would play out along with the eventual destruction of all Sacred Primal Megalonians.

It was so special that one couldn't even enter this terrifying Tresorverse Sacred Domain, where even with the shocking capabilities of the Omnifather who recreated all of these weavings- only possession and assimilation could be done as one attained another identity entirely!

The entities who reached the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence all came to possess different Megalonians, but only those with tremendous complexity of existence or other unique methods would be able to get a truly special identity.
At this moment, within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain, an existence opened his eyes.
And the first thing he felt...was just how bright everything was.
He seemed to be receiving information from every possible source of existence all around him, with his gaze capable of observing things to their fundamental levels!
When he blinked, he saw hazy skies above filled with golden clouds.
He saw purple and gold rivers flowing serenely with the golden clouds, with drops of Hearthraes dangling in the skies freely as they lit everything up with brightness.

On the earth where he was on, vibrant halcyon grasslands covered vast landscapes filled with vegetation and rising gold green mountains- each of these mountains connected by white stairs leading to the other.
On some of these mountains, grand celestial structures were enacted as the clamor of laughter and power spread out, millions of auras of existences stretched out across this landscape!
'Megalonians.'
The entity who opened his eyes thought this as he observed everything...far too clearly?
He could see not just this domain that was filled with mountains and grand constructs as he realized he could easily and seamlessly expand his vision even further.
He came to learn that the land he stood on was as vast as an Omniverse- and it was actually shaped like one massive gold mountain!
Its weavings caused this entity to tremble as on this whole mountain, he felt like he could see quintillions of strings coming together to form it- and it wasn't alone.
When his gaze further expanded, he came to discover that massive white chains extended from this Omniversal sized mountain to other ones.
Some were purple. Some were green. Some red.
But shockingly, he found that he could observe 81 of these mountains in total connected to each other.
81 massive Mountains that were the size of an Omniverse each!

Dazzling mountains the size of Omniverses connected by massive white chains stretched out, and this being who just opened his eyes was shocked to find that his gaze...could continue to spread out and distinctly observe all of these Mountains effortlessly!
What did this mean?

It meant that his sight alone could cover the vastness of 81 Omniverses and even focus on a single one to observe the Megalonians living within them- or even the waving golden grass on their landscapes.
This...how was this possible?
Noah- no, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- Pyrrhus, found himself questioning as he quickly realized something.
He blinked.
He wasn't viewing all of these grandiose mountains just now with his eyes.

His vision shifted as he blinked and then looked above, noticing a regal, fantastical, iridescent golden eye above him that radiated such magisterial tyranny that even the surrounding existence was shuddering!

"Haha, Young Master Pyrrhus, only a day after your body formed, and you already awakened your Sacred Primal Eye of Existence. Those old fogeys were surprised that you became One With Existence at birth, but they will be even more surprised to know you have already attained your Eye a day later! And it seems to be a special one too..."
A voice filled with pride echoed out to his right.
Above the calmly waving golden grass, Pyrrhus turned to see a humanoid entity whose body seemed to be made of pure white astral radiance.
His limbs faded into golden waves of plasma as behind his back, an Expanse of white astral wings that could blot out the skies were shining.
This was...
"Caretaker Nazal..." Pyrrhus said these foreign words with clarity as his memories flowed freely.

"Mmm, you seem to have taken in a great deal of information all at once, Young Master. Let us head to the Sacred Primal Sea for your daily baptism. Those old fogeys won't be able to deny this at all after this."
The memories fully came into place.
Yes.
He was Pyrrhus.
He was also Noah Osmont.
He was also Ozymandias!
He knew who he was and why he came here, but he was clear about one thing.
All of this...was very, very real.

It was not some Dream. It was not some illusory reconstruction. It was something irrevocably real as the moment he entered and possessed this Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, he attained the state of the Eye of Existence!
And it seemed that there were many more shocking things in store as this...was just the beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 3313 Pyrrhus! II
paragraphs: Serene golden clouds above.
Rivers of golden and purple waters swam gleefully like spirit snakes between these golden clouds that overlooked a vibrant earth that seemed like an endless paradisiacal landscape.
In a small part of this, above swaying golden grass, Pyrrhus stared at a humanoid entity whose body seemed to be made of pure white astral radiance.
An aurora of golden astral wings stretched out behind him as when Pyrrhus stared at him closely, the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence above him radiated a flash of light.
It was an Eye of Existence, but it wasn't just any Eye of Existence.
It was a unique type full of unfathomable wonder as at this moment, it caused the distinction of the Weaver of Existence and Weaver of Extremity to undergo fundamental changes!
Just by staring at this Megalonian before him, waves of weavings were presented before his eyes.
[Rare Megalonian Nazal]:: State of Existence- Ordinance Amalgamation. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- 1 Megalos Cycle/1,000 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...
Waves of information came that caused the heart of Pyrrhus to fluctuate!
Details freely and without a delay came- details so extensive that he had never come across them before.
A single gaze at an entity that was no doubt many times more powerful than him garnered a tremendous set of records regarding their existence.
Caretaker Nazal before him was an entity that had already undergone the Amalgamation of their Ordinance, and even this being was only his Caretaker.
Seeing his blank gaze, Caretaker Nazal smiled while walking closer to Pyrrhus.
"Young Master, is it okay if we go to the Sacred Primal Sea? We have to strike while the iron is still hot from your enlightenment for the best results."
His voice was a serene one as Pyrrhus nodded while rising from the golden earth below him.
Him.
He gazed at his own body as he saw...countless golden strings gathered together to form who he was.

His form was humanoid, with the golden strings making his body look like a golden astral amalgamation of light as his limbs diverted to form waves of plasma, and his head was akin to a burning golden astral flame that had two white points of light!
A head that was a golden astral flame that seemed like it would burn endlessly.
His eyes were two blazing white singularities as above him, the illusory golden Sacred Primal Eye of Existence only shone brighter with his gaze.

[Origin Megalonian Pyrrhus]:: State of Existence- A Type of Sacred Primal Eye of Existence. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- An Insignificant Fraction of a Megalos Cycle/ Undefined Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...
Under Caretaker Nazal, he was able to see his level of power, his Source of Existence, and even his lifespan.
How long an entity could live before their Existence broke down!
It was terrifying that he would even have access to such information, with Caretaker Nazal having a maximum lifespan of 1,000 Megalos Cycles.
As for how many billions of years this was equivalent to? He didn't know.
Seeing the state of his own body, Pyrrhus floated up while nodding to Caretaker Nazal beside him.
"Let's go."

His voice was magnetic and filled with a terrifying weight of command, and it seemed to come naturally as even this powerful entity at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage bent his head to acknowledge it!
A golden barrier of light erupted around Nazal that wrapped around both of them as they disappeared.

When they reappeared, they were at the very peak of a flattened mountain that shone with iridescent golden light, a golden singularity the size of a universe filled with a shocking concentration of existence spinning above this flattened mountain peak as, below it, a golden sea tens of times larger than a universe bubbled.

Wisps of golden waters would rise from the golden sea below and fuse into the spinning golden singularity as moments later, even more potent tendrils of light returned down into the golden sea as it became even more radiant.

Around this sea, rings of purple and golden light surrounded it protectively, with the auras of hundreds of thousands of Megalonians peacefully surrounding it as they interacted with each other and elevated their weavings of Existence.
Apart from them, there were 9 thrones of multicolored radiance that floated at the edges of the purple and gold rings, with the auras of powerful Megalonians seated atop these thrones!
Caretaker Nazal and Pyrrhus appeared not too far away from this region as the moment they arrived, Nazal floated across the pristine skies and spoke towards the 9 Thrones.
"Honored Sirs, I bring the one whose birth yesterday caused the auspicious signs to bloom. Today...he has attained his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence."

His voice was calm yet loud, echoing out in the surroundings as those on the nine thrones floating in the skies and even the Megalonian talking amongst themselves and cultivating around the golden sea that radiated intense waves of complexity nearby rose their heads to see.

The Honored Megalonian sitting on the nine thrones had their eyes light up as they came to stare at Pyrrhus, and he stared back at them as their bodies radiated terrifying waves of complexity of existence!
[Rare Megalonian Astrid]:: State of Existence- Ordinance Amalgamation. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- 3 Megalos Cycle/3,000 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...
[Rare Megalonian Salazar]:: State of Existence- Ordinance Amalgamation. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- 4 Megalos Cycle/3,100 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...
The vast majority of the 9 were at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage, and yet their complexity felt multiple times more potent than Caretaker Nazal.
As if a single one of them could press down and those weaker at the same stage as them would instantly be defeated.
It seemed that there was a vast discrepancy of power within the same state of Existence, with this discrepancy being even more exaggerated in these higher stages of power!
It was a terrific reality of existence to experience firsthand.

chapters.title: Chapter 3314 Pyrrhus! III
paragraphs: Just because one attained an Eye of Existence, it did not mean they could stand against another entity who had also attained an Eye of Existence.
Their complexity of existence could be many times higher!
That was the terrifying air of power the entities of the throne released, but one of them utterly encompassed all others as her body shone with the singular astral light of crimson radiance.
Her head was a flicker of a burning astral crimson flame that seemed to contain countless cosmos within it, and her weavings of existence...had far exceeded the Ordinance Amalgamation Stage!
An entity that had exceeded the Ordinance Amalgamation stage.
Pyrrhus stared at her closely as within his white pupils of singularities, a faint illusory golden eye was reflected.
[Quintessential Megalonian Nu]:: State of Existence- Existence Severing(Proto). Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- 2 Megalos Cycle/10,000 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...
She had lived much less than even the Rare Megalonians, and yet she was successful in Severing existence itself!
Her gaze was a profound one as she stared at Pyrrhus with authority and wonder.
"Oh? The little pup formed from a dying singularity turns out to be so obscene? For you to bring him here, you wish to have him undergo a baptism in the Sacred Primal Sea?"
As she spoke, her astral crimson head gazed towards the terrifyingly potent golden sea that stretched out for light years on this massive mountain that was even larger.
Caretaker Nazal smiled with his eyes and nodded as he replied.

"Yes. But not just today- every day from now. My weavings tell me that Young Master Pyrrhus may be the One That Was Promised. To be his Caretaker and watch him grow would be the honor of countless Cycles."
HUUM!
His words caused a blaze of authorities nearby as those on the Nine Thrones became unfathomably serious.
The One That Was Promised!
Over the past few cycles since the Megalonians had come to exist, a few Megalonians were put forward as such a being.
Their weavings of existence were too profound.
They crossed the states of Existence unfathomably quickly.
Their bodies held a sense of reality and royalty that others couldn't match.
But each of them, undoubtedly and without fail, ended up failing either at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage or while trying to Sever Existence itself.
Nobody knew why.

But the most illustrious of the Megalonians who progressed the quickest, the ones that others would look up to with hope...were not able to live up to this high state as their Existence eventually broke down and perished.
It got to the point that any genuine Megalonian being theorized as the One That Was Promised was akin to a death sentence!
It was heavy.
The Existence Severing entity, Nu, sat carefully on her throne as she looked between Caretaker Nazal, who had his head bowed down, and Pyrrhus.
At this moment, time seemed to come to a slowdown until ultimately, everything froze.
The only ones moving and capable of thought were Pyrrhus...and the terrifying Existence Severing entity on the central throne ahead!
Her astral eyes seemed to be flickering with cognizance and thought as a pained expression showed in her eyes- eyes that looked at Pyrrhus bitterly as she voiced out.
"You are not the One That Was Promised."
WAA!
"You are not Pyrrhus..."
The eyes of Pyrrhus flashed with surprised brilliance.
Deep within them, the will of Noah that had assimilated into this Megalonian was shocked as the being ahead of him...seemed to be cognizant of three intricacies of what was occurring?!
Seeing the immense pain within her eyes, the bitterness and endless anger within...it was as if she knew of the fate that would befall the Megalonians.
She looked at Pyrrhus' figure as if she could see the visage of Noah within clearly, as if with but a thought, she could sever Noah's existence entirely!
But a moment later, her bitter gaze flickered as she shook her head.
"I will play along. Just...do not taint the memory of Pyrrhus. Everything we have has already been destroyed, the least you all could do is let our memories rest..."
HUUM!
Her words were filled with endless agony.
But...
Existence buzzed and began to flow once more.
Noah's Will observed all of this with alarm and scrutiny as all of this...was a reconstruction of the weavings of the Megalonians by the Omnifather.
But they were truly far too real. To the extent that the truly powerful entities within this Reconstruction...seemed to wake with part of their Egos as they understood what was happening.
How terrifying were the Megalonians? What would have happened if their Lineage were actually allowed to thrive and grow?
It was a question that didn't have an answer.
Weavings of Existence flowed once more.
The bitterness and agony within Quintessential Megalonian Nu faded as she seemed to smile with astonishment.
"Caretaker Nazal...half a cycle has gone by without the declaration of the One That Was Promised. For you to bring it to our young star here..."
"Is because I am confident."
There was no hesitation in the eyes of Nazal.
On the other eight thrones, the Ordinance Amalgamation Megalonians turned towards the only Existence Severing Megalonian on this Mountain as if they were awaiting her decision.
Down below, a bustle of conversations exploded out as Megalonians looked at the scene above with awe.
It was only after a few seconds that the Quintessential Megalonian Nu sighed while pointing ahead.
"Very well. He shall follow the same weavings of Inheritance as the ones before him. The baptism of the Sacred Primal Sea is granted."
A right was given.
Once it was, there were many astonished gazes, and Noah even felt waves of jealousy down below!
Jealousy? This didn't seem like the weavings of the Megalonians!
Noah's will gazed at the masses of Megalonians down below who were increasing the complexity of their existence near the rings of the unfathomable sea.
He quickly located the intents of Jealousy as his eyes soon shone with understanding.
He found Megalonians who were undoubtedly possessed by others like him, but their statuses were much, much lower!

chapters.title: Chapter 3315 The Rich and the Poor! I
paragraphs: Around the vibrant rings of the Sacred Primal Sea.
A Megalonian had a gaze of pure joy as they felt the shocking waves of the complexity of existence around them, as well as the rapid progression of their existence!
It was a few hundred times more than their own bodies in Megalos Ynnere.
And in front of them...was a boundless golden sea that seemed to have a million times more concentration of existence than the area they were in.
Around them, other Megalonians were seated in meditative positions as their bodies seemed to be made of pure astral brilliance that increased their complexity in fantastical ways!

The senses of Megalonians were attuned tremendously, and they were able to feel glows of power that far exceeded them overseeing everything on this mountain that was many times larger than even a common universe.
These glows of power...they threateningly came from nine thrones floating in the distant skies as the Possessed Megalonian raised their gaze up and shuddered.
'The means of the Omnifather are too profound...'
The Will within the Megalonian spoke out as it was one of the Antediluvian Leviathans that had entered after Arguros.
They didn't have much complexity of existence to unleash after their reserves were cut off greatly just getting to the Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence!
Thus, they only possessed an Average Sacred Primal Megalonian.

This constricted their movements greatly as in the memories of their Possessed, they knew and understood everything occurring nearby- along with the fact that the Sacred Primal Sea ahead of them was something they could only cultivate around the periphery of.
It was reserved to be used by those who held extremely high positions within the Sacred Primal Megalonians, and even then- its usage was rare on any of the 81 Sacred Megalos Mountains!
This Possessed Megalonian shook their head with regret as when they gazed around, they felt a unique resonance in another area nearby.

When they turned to look past the fantastical golden green trees stretched out in the periphery of the Sacred Primal Sea, their gaze came to lock on to another Megalonian who seemed to have discovered them at the same time.
There was a sense of resonance as their eyes...held the same light of awakening. The same light of Possessed Megalonians!
They could recognize each other as those who weren't truly part of this unfathomable reconstruction of weavings.

The two who just discovered each other smiled wryly with self-depreciation as both of them were Average Sacred Primal Megalonians, and even though this alone was a terrifying boon with them already feeling their shocking increase in complexity...they knew that there were a hundred, or even a thousand times more boons if they had more unique identities!
Oh well.
Thru couldn't wallow in what they couldn't change as for now, they wanted to remain here for as long as possible.
They broke their gazes and turned to look at the protective rings surrounding the distant golden sea.
It was so close, and yet so far away as from their memories, they would never be able to lay their hands on it. But then.
Above them.
HUUM!
A commotion broke out!
Waves of weavings gradually reached those who were nearby as Megalonians talked amongst each other.
"Another possible One That Was Promised!"
"What?!"
One weaving after another cascaded down.
All of it culminated to...
|The baptism of the Sacred Primal Sea is granted.|
It was a voice that became an intent that spread out all around!
A Megalonian would get the rare chance to be baptized in the Sacred Primal Sea! Who?
The eyes of the Possessed Megalonian flashed with longing as their memories told them how truly fantastical a baptism on this Sea would be!
Who gained this chance?
Their searching gazes went up.
Before the dazzling nine thrones of the Honored Megalonians.
They saw a pure white astral Megalonian vibrating with immense power, and behind him, the one who would get the rare chance to undergo the baptism of the Sacred Primal Sea...
An entity made of pure golden astral light as his flaming head turned to look at them at the same time they saw him.
And...!
They saw the same light of cognizance in his eyes as theirs.
He...wasn't part of the reconstruction.
He was just like them- someone who had possessed a Megalonian!
'What?!'
How...how were they able to gain such an identity?

The bustling weavings of the One That Was Promised were ringing out in their hearts as they felt like they were sitting in desolate slumps of existence- poor and impoverished, while the one in front of the nine thrones far above them was sitting on mountains of golden waves of existence. This wasn't all.
When they gazed at him, their very existence as Megalonians felt reverence and trepidation as if they were looking at something exalted within their own Lineage!
When they looked too deeply into his eyes, they felt boundless majesty that caused their very existences to feel so much smaller!
This...
Their faces became extremely unsightly as they felt that they couldn't even hold their gazes with this being for too long.
The other Possessed Megalonians nearby who had been waking up one after questioned.
Who the hell was that up there that managed to obtain such a shocking identity?!
One Possessed Megalonian thought of the violet purple flames of Entropy that covered the Antediluvian Leviathan and wondered- was it him?
But no answer came.

[Average Megalonian Tijus(Possessed by the Existence of Batiatus, from the Antediluvian Leviathan Primal Family of Oceanetheus)]:: State of Existence- Eye of Existence. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- Half a Megalos Cycle/50 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...

[Average Megalonian Tijus(Possessed by the Existence of Kajol, from the Mythical Omniversal Serpent Turtle Lineage)]:: State of Existence- Eye of Existence. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- Half a Megalos Cycle/60 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...

[Average Megalonian Valas(Possessed by the Existence of Ceasar, from the Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Lineage)]:: State of Existence- Ordinance of Existence. Source of Existence- Megalos. Lifespan- 1 Megalos Cycle/80 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings-...
His eyes shone over multiple Possessed Megalonians nearby as their information in this fantastical reconstruction and even their identities before it were visible to him.
It was utterly terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 3316 The Rich and the Poor! II
paragraphs: A terrifying Eye of Existence.
One that others would find impossible to even imagine, and yet this unfathomable Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian held it.
Origin.

It placed itself above even Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian- of which the only one that Noah had met so far being the Existence Severing Honored Megalonian who stood over this Megalos Mountain.

Who truly understood the secrets of such an entity? The more he assimilated with them, Noah could feel his state of mind gradually being affected by a heavy sense of majesty and dignity- one that almost exceeded his old self!
It seemed to be a type of dignity deeply ingrained in the very type of existence he was.
Not all beings were equal.
Not all beings were born equal.
The day that the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian Pyrrhus was born, he already attained the state of One With Existence.

What did this mean? That his complexity was already at the level of or exceeding someone that had exceeded the Existential Dominium Realm and had a complex enough existence to form a Fabled Omniverse!
Others spent millions of years just to reach there.
Others were untalented enough as it took them an entire cycle or two.
And then, there was Pyrrhus.
One With Existence at birth, and a unique Eye of Existence a day later!
Where would he be a few days later? What would Noah be able to obtain a week later?
The answer was unknown as, at this moment, quietness settled into this expansive mountain as the throne that the Existence Severing Honored Megalonian sat on radiated a blinding wave of light.
From her, a voice filled with unfathomable complexity echoed out.

"The Sacred Primal Sea is the condensation of Cycles of Existence on every single Sacred Megalos Mountain. Rarely are any Megalonians permitted baptism on it, but when truly exceptional Megalonians do arise, they will enjoy baptism on it endlessly- all for the sake of Megalonians!"
OOOH!
Booming waves of affirmation echoed out from all Megalonians.
They were a tight-knit group of entities.
Their weavings were aligned as they were cognizant of their existence, and what qualities they represented.
They knew that to defend themselves from Outsiders, they had to have strong defenders.
So when exceptional Megalonians arose, they were given resources and supported by all Sacred Megalos Mountains fully!

The Sacred Primal Sea was kept flowing and with ever greater concentrations by Existence Severing Megalonians, and every other Megalonian who cultivated near it...contributed their complexity every single day.
This was how harmonious the Megalonians were.
How united they were!
Through this method, they were able to produce Entities who could attain Ordinance Amalgamation at high rates, and eventually, even Existence Severing entities rose among them.
Unity.
A rare quality to find in any Bloodline, and the Sacred Primal Megalonians had it.
Around the golden sea, all Megalonians cheered with unity as the only ones who didn't truly have this intent...were those currently possessing and assimilating Megalonians.

In their eyes, sharp lights of envy shone as after the introduction from the Honored Megalonian, a set of astral white staircases appeared before Pyrrhus- and they led all the way towards the center of the Sacred Primal Sea.

"The one to undergo baptism today and for the coming future is Pyrrhus. From the recommendation of Caretaker Nazal, he is put forward as the One That Was Promised! As Megalonians, we all hope for him to live up to such a distinction."
"OOOH!"
"PYRRHUS!"
Across the golden sea.
"PYRRHUS!"
Chants began to resound.
There was no disharmony as they knew.
His elevation and strength would be the elevation and strength of all Megalonians. So they would only look forward to it.
"PYRRHUS!"

The chants were resonant as under them, Pyrrhus turned towards Caretaker Nazal, who smiled with acknowledgment towards him, and he then stepped on the white set of stairs as his figure was rapidly taken towards the center of the Sacred Primal Sea.
The timeline of the Tresorverse Sacred Domain was set.
The events to play out within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain were set.
The eventual destruction of the Sacred Primal Megalonians was set!

The means of the Omnifather were unfathomable with this reconstruction, but it was stated clearly along with those edicts that...the gains made in complexity and states of Existence would be retained once the set events came to pass, and the pathway up the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence would open up once more thereafter.
This was stated.
This was inviolable.
And yet...
BOOM!
Outside of the Tresorverse designed by the Omnifather.
Within the bounds of Omniverse X-999.
Inside of the Infinite Omniverse that was finishing assimilating a Dark Matter Core and the remaining weavings of a Half Tainted Omniverse!
An explosive boom of incomprehensible weavings of existence erupted from Noah's main body seated atop his multicolored throne.
His face was facing up unnaturally as his forehead split open, a blinding golden singularity blooming from his forehead as an instant later...it began to radiate the wondrous form of an Eye!
An Eye.
It...had not even been a full day since the Omniversal Archontes Engineer attained the state of One With Existence.
Not even a full day.
And yet inexplicably, at this moment, a gloriously golden eye that was far too similar to the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence arose.
The eye that only the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- Pyrrhus, held!
The reconstruction of the Omnifather had only just begun for Noah, and yet he was already beginning to inherit the boons within it.
It was an utterly enigmatic phenomenon as his forehead rapidly healed and above him, a gloriously gold eye opened.
Intricate weavings and lines wrapped around it as the moment it flung open, waves of information flowed into Noah!
His distinction as the Weaver broke through any possible limitations.
His standing and complexity of Existence rose to even greater heights!
A body of his that was within an isolated cut-off section of the Dream Aletheian Haven gazed at the reconstructed body of Savitar.
A so called Great One.
And yet under his gaze, bountiful details of him began to spill out as if they weren't his to begin with!

"The one to undergo baptism today and for the coming future is Pyrrhus.
From the recommendation of Caretaker Nazal, he is put forward as the One That Was Promised!
As Megalonians, we all hope for him to live up to such a distinction."
"OOOH!"
"PYRRHUS!"
Across the golden sea.
"PYRRHUS!"
Chants began to resound.
There was no disharmony as they knew.
His elevation and strength would be the elevation and strength of all Megalonians.
So they would only look forward to it.
"PYRRHUS!"

The chants were resonant as under them, Pyrrhus turned towards Caretaker Nazal, who smiled with acknowledgment towards him, and he then stepped on the white set of stairs as his figure was rapidly taken towards the center of the Sacred Primal Sea.
The timeline of the Tresorverse Sacred Domain was set.
The events to play out within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain were set.
The eventual destruction of the Sacred Primal Megalonians was set!

The means of the Omnifather were unfathomable with this reconstruction, but it was stated clearly along with those edicts that...the gains made in complexity and states of Existence would be retained once the set events came to pass, and the pathway up the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence would open up once more thereafter.
This was stated.
This was inviolable.
And yet...
BOOM!
Outside of the Tresorverse designed by the Omnifather.
Within the bounds of Omniverse X-999.
Inside of the Infinite Omniverse that was finishing assimilating a Dark Matter Core and the remaining weavings of a Half Tainted Omniverse!
An explosive boom of incomprehensible weavings of existence erupted from Noah's main body seated atop his multicolored throne.
His face was facing up unnaturally as his forehead split open, a blinding golden singularity blooming from his forehead as an instant later...it began to radiate the wondrous form of an Eye!
An Eye.
It...had not even been a full day since the Omniversal Archontes Engineer attained the state of One With Existence.
Not even a full day.
And yet inexplicably, at this moment, a gloriously golden eye that was far too similar to the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence arose.
The eye that only the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- Pyrrhus, held!
The reconstruction of the Omnifather had only just begun for Noah, and yet he was already beginning to inherit the boons within it.
It was an utterly enigmatic phenomenon as his forehead rapidly healed and above him, a gloriously gold eye opened.
Intricate weavings and lines wrapped around it as the moment it flung open, waves of information flowed into Noah!
His distinction as the Weaver broke through any possible limitations.
His standing and complexity of Existence rose to even greater heights!
A body of his that was within an isolated cut-off section of the Dream Aletheian Haven gazed at the reconstructed body of Savitar.
A so called Great One.
And yet under his gaze, bountiful details of him began to spill out as if they weren't his to begin with!

chapters.title: Chapter 3317 What an Eye! I
paragraphs: [Seventh Body of Savitar]:: State of Existence- Quasi-Eye of Existence. Source of Existence- Outerversal. Lifespan- 18 Megalos Cycle/70 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- The Seventh Body of Savitar that was reconstructed through the hands of a great being. Its power exceeds any of its other bodies apart from the Main One....
An extrapolation of records of Savitar unfolded under Noah's gaze as his weavings underwent a tremendous change!
He looked at the obsidian golden skeleton visage of Savitar who currently had a dark expression as he uttered out.
|White doorways have appeared within all the Tainted Omniverses I oversee...and likely here as well. But these gateways reject anything relating to Outerversal Authority!|
His voice carried great frustration with it as he looked towards Noah inquisitively as if he was seeking for more information.
And Noah laughed lightly as he waved his hands.

"It's not an opportunity for the Outerversal Morphons. We had the weavings of the Great Beyonder stretch out and empower us; the white portals are simply an opportunity that someone of equivalent power, if not greater than the Great Beyonder, had placed for the masses of the Megalos Ynnere."
His words caused the flames within Savitar to blaze heavily as he asked in a low tone.
|Were you successful in taking a Delegatus across it? The Outerversal Authority within them was masked?|
The One Who Walks asked some critical questions that Noah did not answer.
He only waved his hands dismissively.

"Who knows. Forget about that. You've actually lived for 18 Megalos Cycles, and you've only attained this stage of power? Even the Eye of Existence, you have only stepped into it halfway? Just what exactly designated you to be a Great One?"
Word after word that caused the flames within Savitar to flicker in shock and then subsequent horror echoed out.
|You...you...!| He was too baffled by the things Noah knew!
How could he know how many cycles he had been alive? How could he know his exact state of power?!
HUUM!
"Let's see..."
Noah went even further as above him, a terrifying golden eye opened.
Along with it, prompts cascaded down.
|The Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus, has turned its gaze onto the target before it.|
|The weavings of the selected target are laid bare.|
Savitar trembled as he felt like a terrifying gaze had landed on him, and everything about him turned extremely clear as if it was all beings perused!
And he...couldn't do anything to stop it.
"Born near the Megalos Pantheon of Zeitland, you were only a little cub all those cycles ago. But look at you now..."
WAA!
His voice seemed to hold traces of interminable power.
His mere voice caused Savitar, a supposed Great One, to shudder as he felt like if he kept listening, his whole history- all of his records would be told right in front of him!
|Who...no, what are you? What do you really want?!|
Savitar asked with a sense of trepidation as he realized he truly didn't understand this entity before him.
Looking at the terrifying golden Eye of Existence that caused his very weavings to shudder with pressure, he realized that he truly knew too little about him!
At this moment, the golden eye of this being pressed its heavy pressure on him as his voice echoed out passively.
"I don't need partners. Only followers. You, O One Who Walks, get to decide at this moment whether you wish to be a follower."
The power within his voice was potent.
But it was that eye.
That terrifying golden Eye!
That was the thing that caused Savitar the most fear as he felt like everything about him would be discovered sooner or later.
|I...I don't...|
"DECIDE!"

A single word boomed out as shockingly, the illusory golden eye above Noah's head opened its pupils wider than ever before golden lightning moving many times faster than the speed of light smashing into Savitar instantly as his figure froze.
|The Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus, has imposed one of its capabilities on the target named Savitar.|
|Existence Suppression has been utilized for the first time.|

|Due to their lower complexity of existence and state of being compared to you, the target before you was not able to evade the effects of Existence Suppression. You can now choose to seal the complexity of Existence of this body of the selected target, and establish a link towards other parts of its weavings. If your gaze lands on their other Records as well, the effects of Existence Suppression can be applied freely.|
The...sealing of the complexity of existence?
Sealing.
Sealing!
It was too profound to see as Noah couldn't help but wish to give it a go!
Instantly, Savitar felt his existence...begin to forcefully shrink.
His power.
His weavings. His records.
His Outerversal Authority.
Everything about him felt like it was becoming smaller- as if it was being shut behind a door he could never open no matter how he wished to in the future!

He looked around him in sheer terror as he noticed the weight of an undeniable golden light- a light that didn't just affect this body, but could eventually go on to affect all his other bodies- even his main one.
And his existence inherently felt the end result of all this would be...his entire weavings of existence sealed to the point that he would be even more powerless than the day he was born.
He would be like the entities here considered less than nothing- the tiny humans who lived within the depths of Cosmos and Universes who didn't even know how to wield authority!
This...this filled him with such terror that couldn't even be brought by death as his golden obsidian body instantly bent itself down.
His aurora of wings that had recently sprouted behind him and his thousands of limbs all bent down in sheer terror as his voice groveled out!
|Follower! I will be a follower!|
HUUM!
With a face filled with terror, a Great One yelled out.

chapters.title: Chapter 3318 What an Eye! II
paragraphs: A Great One.
The One Who Walks.
He may have garnered a great deal of titles and power over the cycles that he lived, and yet at this moment, he bent himself towards another.
Towards a great being that looked towards him with a single cold illusory eye as after confirming the ridiculous effects of Existence Suppression, he began to slowly reverse its effects on Savitar.
If someone held less complexity than him and made themselves his enemy, their fate would be an extremely dismal one.
"Present your very Megalos Regnum forward."
An Outerversal Morphons' power stemmed from their Outerversal Physiology and their Megalos Regnum.
Their very will- across all their bodies.
At this moment, from Savitar, billowing obsidian waves of light flowed from him and coalesced into an Obsidian Crown that floated towards Noah.
A Representation of the Megalos Regnum.
The Megalos Regnum Crown of a Great One!
It was represented to Noah at this moment as he beckoned towards it, his hand coming to grasp it as his illusory golden eye flashed.
The terrifying light of the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus, wrapped around this crown as a golden string passed through it.
This golden string closed in on itself and came to wrap around Noah's neck like a necklace- a chain that had the aura of a Great One's Megalos Regnum Crown leaking from it akin to a prize!
A single obsidian crown was adorned on this golden necklace.
When Savitar saw this, he shuddered further as if he could see this being declaring that in the future, many more crowns of Great Ones would fall into that golden necklace!
Reigning in his fear, he bowed down even further and spoke out.
|Your Follower greets you, O Dreamer of the Megalos.|
He called him with the distinction he introduced himself with.
He didn't dare say his actual name.
The One Who Walks, on this day, found himself with absolutely no place to walk to but a single one.
"Rise, and let us pay a visit to your Tainted Omniverses- nay, Our Tainted Omniverses."
Savitar trembled, and yet said absolutely nothing apart from nodding vehemently.
All of this...came with the simple usage and eruption of an Eye.
An Eye of Existence.
What an Eye of Existence it was as it seemed its usage was slowly being unearthed!
At the same time that Noah's grandiose actions unfolded, his distinction as the Cartographer of Existence buzzed.
Where his gaze could reach...should be tremendously expanded.
How seamlessly he could traverse across Megalos Ynnere should be even more elevated.
So he knew as the Cartographer that it was time he paid visits to other Omniverses.
Undoubtedly, those with Complex weavings of existence would already be converging towards the Tresorverse of the Omnifather.
And the Omniverses that were Tainted and filled with Dark Matter Cores? His Infinite Omniverse was inexplicably hungry for them- starting with those Savitar had been sitting over.
A terrific power flowed into Noah from the weavings of a long extinct race.
It was before the reconstruction of events even ended as it caused questions to arise as to what surprises and anomalies lay ahead.
But for now, he needed to understand the extent of what the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus, could truly see.
He also had to grasp the intricacies of the Sacred Primal Megalonians themselves as the Reconstruction of the weavings of the most terrifying race across the Megalos continued to unfold!
Amidst chants of his name.
Pyrrhus turned into a streak of vibrant light across the steps constructed by the Quintessential Megalonian Nu as he arrived above the center of the massive Sacred Primal Sea.
He looked down within its depths as he felt the core of his being vibrating.
His Source of Existence.
The System of Existence for all Megalonians...was the Megalos.
But what did it truly stand for?
Covered by tendrils of Existential waves of light, his golden body floated down serenely as if he were performing some sort of ancient ceremony.
And the core of his being...started to pulsate with unique vibrations.
His whole body entirely was made up of countless strings of astral radiance, its composition, and complexity allowing for the terrifying methodology of cultivation that the Megalonian carried out!
It was a complex system of existence, but the bulk of it came down...to choices and possibilities.
Any possible choice one made would lead to a different outcome.
A different path, and a weaving of oneself.
Making one choice could lead one to death. Making another choice could lead to a fortuitous encounter.
Making one choice could lead to enmity forming with one group, or becoming allies with another group!
All of them...were possibilities.
Possible weavings.
The Sacred Primal Megalonians...pulled upon all possible versions of their weavings as if they were pulling upon countless parallel lives!
All paradoxical and uncertain versions of themselves that theoretically could have become an eventuality- they pulled upon their weavings.

When they increased their complexity of existence, their progression was based on the cultivation of every single one of the countless possible versions of themselves that could have walked across the Megalos.
To an extent.
With some limitations.
But this source of Existence alone was utterly terrifying!
Noah's will within Pyrrhus took a deep breath of absolute amazement as after the strings that made his existence vibrated to a unique frequency, an explosion of golden brilliance unfolded.
It was around the same time that his body touched the surface of the Sacred Primal Sea.
With the explosion of golden brilliance, illusory bodies that looked extremely similar to him began to manifest all around him.
Possible versions of him born from different choices.
Possible parallel weavings across the Megalos.
Their illusory figures all increased as their faces were cloudy, but their very being across the Megalos seemed to be looking at him as their bodies began to radiate light!
Tendrils of golden brilliance began to rise from the golden sea and into the body of Pyrrhus.
At the same time, the ever increasing illusory possible versions of himself that continued to increase all around had tendrils of light arc across their bodies.
They increased their complexity of existence.
But the gains were not for them.
All of it...surged like a billowing tide towards the singular version of himself that represented the accumulation of all choices and possibilities across the Megalos!
This...was the terrifying Source of Existence of the Sacred Primal Megalonians!

chapters.title: Chapter 3319 The Trigger of Destruction! I
paragraphs: Sacred Primal Megalonians.

Entities that only managed to live for a few cycles, and yet even within these cycles, they produced multiple entities at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage and even those who had managed to sever existence.

The reason for their rise was the shocking composition of their very being that led them to develop means of increasing their complexity that others could never follow, nor even have the chance to study and follow.
A single Megalonian elevating their complexity was akin to countless others increasing their complexity for them!
|Incredible...|
Within the reconstruction, on one of the other 81 Megalos Mountains that Noah had yet to turn his gaze towards.

Near another buzzing Sacred Primal Sea, a small house was built in extremely close proximity to the sea as such a lodging was something very few Megalonians could achieve- with most only gaining access a few light years around the periphery of the sea.
The small house looked like it was made of stellar purple blocks of light as standing next to it was Possessed Megalonian who held the will of three Antediluvian Leviathan- Arguros!
A Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian.

And yet their position was a high one as at this place, Arguros could see the tendrils of the raging gold sea right up close, the intense waves of complexity booming from them being used by him as he had long since begun cultivating.

Even though he didn't obtain a Quintessential or an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, he felt like even this Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian was something others could only dream of as this whole opportunity...would tremendously aid him and any others who even arrived here tremendously.
He could say this with surety as he turned his head to see tens of thousands of illusory copies of himself.
Possible weavings of himself across the Megalos.
All of them...were increasing their complexity as the boons all stacked and were granted to himself.
|O Entropy...|
Arguros spoke with tremendous emotions as he felt the Ordinance of Entropy he had declared for himself years ago.
He declared it.
He sought its unfathomable wonders that exceeded the most boundless possible extremes as his entire being was dedicated to it.

As his complexity of existence rapidly increased with the shocking means of the Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian, he could say with surety that by the end of this, he should be entirely amalgamated with Entropy.
He should step into the state of existence known as Ordinance Amalgamation, or at the very least be at its doors!
This, he knew in his heart.
As purple violet flames raged around him and tens of thousands of other illusory selves from possible weavings, Arguros wondered.
'Will the rest of the Antediluvian Leviathans benefit as much as me? I know the Esteemed Elder Titans above me will make the most of the boons the Omnifather has left behind for us...'
The Esteemed Elder Titans.

They all entered the Tresorverse of the Omnifather as what height did they reach? Which Megalonian did they possess? And what level of power would they reach at the end of it all? Arguros did not know!
On another Megalos Mountain.
A Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian stood up on his throne as he stared at the Sacred Primal Sea in the distance.
The eight other thrones beside him all had looks of confusion as they stared towards him, and his domineering voice filled with coldness and command leaked out.
|I shall undergo baptism in the Sacred Primal Sea for the foreseeable future...I sense a breakthrough at hand.|
He held a large amount of influence, reign, and control over the decisions of this mountain.
To use it for himself would be more than fine so long as he gave enough of a reason to!
The unity of Megalonians made it so that if it was to elevate their strength and increase the power of the lineage as a whole, it was more than sufficient.
The other thrones had no reason to deny the words of the Honored Megalonian as they watched him float serenely towards the Sacred Primal Sea.

Around his body, an Ordinance that looked to be half a step into Amalgamation began to meld with him seamlessly, making it clear that when he left this reconstruction, he would be deeply entranced in the Ordinance Amalgamation stage.
Survival was the only option.
He could not fail his full Amalgamation that he was fearing for all these past cycles!
The eyes of the Quintessential Megalonian burned with a cold light that could only belong to a single being- and it was none other than the Sword of the Commonwealth!

One by one, entities across the Megalos Ynnere delved into the Tresorverse of the Omnifather and arrived at a profound reconstruction- taking on the bodies of Megalonians as if they made advancements in this space...it was bound be to the safest in all of existence.
Those fearing a collapse of their existence during the progression from Ordinance of Existence to Ordinance Amalgamation moved forward fearlessly.
They felt like this reconstruction was profoundly perfect for this as where else would they be able to advance in the bodies of others?!
With profound fervor and haste, they moved.
Because during all of this, in the back of their minds, nobody knew when this reconstruction would come to an end.
The events to play out were set.
The destruction of the Megalonians was set.
The only thing to make sure of was for them to obtain as much as they could before the destruction came!
This was the thought ringing out and resonating within many weavings of existence.
Many.
But not all.

In one particular weaving- in the body of the only Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, the will inside it looked at the ridiculous pace of progression brought about due to the terrifying System of Existence as he had but a single thought.
He thought that there was no way he would be leaving this Reconstruction without the terrifying system of existence of the Megalonians!

sentences.text: Sacred Primal Megalonians.

Entities that only managed to live for a few cycles, and yet even within these cycles, they produced multiple entities at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage and even those who had managed to sever existence.

The reason for their rise was the shocking composition of their very being that led them to develop means of increasing their complexity that others could never follow, nor even have the chance to study and follow.
A single Megalonian elevating their complexity was akin to countless others increasing their complexity for them!
|Incredible...|
Within the reconstruction, on one of the other 81 Megalos Mountains that Noah had yet to turn his gaze towards.

Near another buzzing Sacred Primal Sea, a small house was built in extremely close proximity to the sea as such a lodging was something very few Megalonians could achieve- with most only gaining access a few light years around the periphery of the sea.
The small house looked like it was made of stellar purple blocks of light as standing next to it was Possessed Megalonian who held the will of three Antediluvian Leviathan- Arguros!
A Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian.

And yet their position was a high one as at this place, Arguros could see the tendrils of the raging gold sea right up close, the intense waves of complexity booming from them being used by him as he had long since begun cultivating.

Even though he didn't obtain a Quintessential or an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, he felt like even this Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian was something others could only dream of as this whole opportunity...would tremendously aid him and any others who even arrived here tremendously.
He could say this with surety as he turned his head to see tens of thousands of illusory copies of himself.
Possible weavings of himself across the Megalos.
All of them...were increasing their complexity as the boons all stacked and were granted to himself.
|O Entropy...|
Arguros spoke with tremendous emotions as he felt the Ordinance of Entropy he had declared for himself years ago.
He declared it.
He sought its unfathomable wonders that exceeded the most boundless possible extremes as his entire being was dedicated to it.

As his complexity of existence rapidly increased with the shocking means of the Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian, he could say with surety that by the end of this, he should be entirely amalgamated with Entropy.
He should step into the state of existence known as Ordinance Amalgamation, or at the very least be at its doors!
This, he knew in his heart.
As purple violet flames raged around him and tens of thousands of other illusory selves from possible weavings, Arguros wondered.
'Will the rest of the Antediluvian Leviathans benefit as much as me?
I know the Esteemed Elder Titans above me will make the most of the boons the Omnifather has left behind for us...'
The Esteemed Elder Titans.
They all entered the Tresorverse of the Omnifather as what height did they reach?
Which Megalonian did they possess?
And what level of power would they reach at the end of it all?
Arguros did not know!
On another Megalos Mountain.
A Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian stood up on his throne as he stared at the Sacred Primal Sea in the distance.
The eight other thrones beside him all had looks of confusion as they stared towards him, and his domineering voice filled with coldness and command leaked out.

He held a large amount of influence, reign, and control over the decisions of this mountain.
To use it for himself would be more than fine so long as he gave enough of a reason to!
The unity of Megalonians made it so that if it was to elevate their strength and increase the power of the lineage as a whole, it was more than sufficient.
The other thrones had no reason to deny the words of the Honored Megalonian as they watched him float serenely towards the Sacred Primal Sea.

Survival was the only option.
He could not fail his full Amalgamation that he was fearing for all these past cycles!

chapters.title: Chapter 3320 The Trigger of Destruction! II
paragraphs: With a radiant gold Megalos Mountain.

Inside its depths, on the peak of the mountain holding the only Sacred Primal Sea, Pyrrhus had descended onto the gold waters of the golden sea and become submerged in it as he was bombarded with endless waves of complexity.
Ones that were undoubtedly hundreds of times more potent than even those received as the feedback from traversing on the Roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.

And this was further amplified by the System of Existence of the Megalonians themselves as all around, the illusory possibilities of Pyrrhus across the Megalos all increased the complexity of Existence concurrently while it all went towards a single source!
Pyrrhus.
Himself.
Noah!
At this moment, it wasn't just Quintessence, Infinity, Manadynamics, or Entropy that had been propelled up enough to form Fabled Omniverses of their own.
Every single core of Noah- every part of his concepts within the First Mundi of Power were propelled to a terrifying enough level that they began to seamlessly form their own Fabled Omniverses.
Fabled Omniverse of Cheats.
Fabled Omniverse of the Protagonist.
Fabled Omniverses of Loot, Continuity, Relativity, Uncertainty, Tyranny, Medicine, and more!
One by one, dozens of singular concepts that could each be taken to define a single being...were all given focus and elevated simultaneously.

Mana acted as the pathway to seamlessly transform into every single one of these concepts as Infinity and Manadynamics were surging exponentially, along with a singular concept that was showing the extent of Noah's actions.
How everything he was doing right...was Quintessential!
Quintessence itself rose maddeningly as through an endless dream, weavings of its Ordinance were already whispering to Noah.
At this moment, they only became clearer.
Nothing prevented other Sources of Existence from being expressed within this Reconstruction as the weavings of Kuklos and Ingeniare were also facing a bombardment of an increase in complexity.
Everything was bound to form a Fabled Omniverse in this Reconstruction.

The only question was how many would declare their Ordinance...and exactly how Noah would navigate the declaration of his existence with a specific Ordinance, or even Amalgamate with it later on without failing and collapsing his existence.
The words of caution from Arguros rang in his mind still.
And yet he forged ahead without fail, his will feeling the brilliance of his Atlas of Existence for an answer!
In the midst of all this...
BOOM!
An explosive sound echoed out as a rift in space appeared far above the golden clouds of this Megalos Mountain.

The Quintessential Megalonian Nu gazed above with a tight gaze along with all other megalonians as from above, the figure of an astral green Megalonian could be seen- vibrant astral wings extending behind her as they cradled a weakening weaving of existence.
One that belonged to...an Antediluvian Leviathan whose body shone weakly with a multicolored light!

His very weavings of Existence were fading apart as his Amalgamation seemed to be unstable and near the point of rejection- his weavings of existence far too scattered as he seemed to be at death's door!
Yet when Quintessential Megalonian Nu gazed above and saw this scene, her eyes became utterly enraged as she bellowed out.
|Vayan! You dared to bring an outsider to our home?! This is the only Inviolable Decree we have! You...!|

She could see despair and hesitation on the face of the verdant astral Megalonian who came down regardless, her figure making a beeline towards the Sacred Primal Sea as her words echoed out defiantly amidst tears.

|He failed to Sever Existence! He will die if what is left of him is not stabilized. He will die! The Sacred Primal Sea is the only thing that could possibly hold him together. Please, Esteemed Overseer Nu- just until his existence is stabilized!|

The verdant astral Megalonian, Vayan, cried out while arriving above the waters of the Sacred Primal Sea- a distance away from Noah, as she carefully placed the body of the multicolored Antediluvian Leviathan on its surface.

The body of this massive entity emanated terrifying age and power that seemed to be rapidly fading away at this moment, Noah gazing at it with scrutiny as all of this...were part of the events set to unfold within this Reconstruction.
He and many others always wondered.
How had the Megalonians perished?
How had entities discovered their terrifying composition of existence and hunted them all to extinction?
Standing in the midst of this reconstruction, the beginnings of the answer began to unfold at this moment.
A Megalonian...had brought in an Outsider into their home.
Someone who had failed Existence Severing as everything about them was collapsing!
The mere fact that he was still alive was a terrifying oddity as failure of Existence Severing meant instantaneous death and collapse of existence.
Yet this being held on.

And even at this moment, His body began to naturally absorb the waters of the Sacred Primal Sea hungrily as the moment that the verdant Megalonian who was frantic saw this, her eyes beamed with happiness as she cradled the head of the Antediluvian Leviathan in her astral thighs and stroked his head that was wincing in extreme pain tenderly.
|It's okay...|
Seeing this scene, the Quintessential Megalonian Nu burned with rage as her terrifying power cascaded out, causing everything nearby to shudder.
|PREPOSTEROUS!|
BOOM!
|You would disobey the one cardinal rule of our Lineage for an outsider?! You would put us all at risk for...for what?!|
Her eyes burned with tremendous anger.
At this moment, her power permeated everywhere as with but a thought, she could sever the very existence of Vayan and even the Outsider she brought with her!
And yet the verdant astral Megalonian shook her head wistfully as she only cradled the head of the Antediluvian Leviathan, more and more waves of the golden sea surging into him.
Noah observed the increasing rage of the Quintessential Megalonian Nu, but his vibrant Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus, observed another shocking fact.

On the bodies of some of the Possessed Megalonians that had the wills of Antediluvian Leviathans within them, their weavings were chaotic and filled with immeasurable shock as they gazed at the bloody body in the middle of the Sacred Primal Sea.
The entity that had failed at Existence Severing.
They gazed towards him with shock and adulation as they called out under their breath...
|Omnifather...?|
|Omnifather!|
Shock.
Disbelief.
Incredulity.
It all buzzed vibrantly in the weavings of the Antediluvian Leviathans as they came to witness the first trigger of the event that would lead to the downfall of the Megalonians.
The arrival of a dying entity who had absolutely failed in Existence Severing and should have perished...the Omnifather!
