chapters.title: Chapter 3321 Set in Stone! I
paragraphs: An Antediluvian Leviathan shining with multicolored grandeur was the first outsider to arrive within the dominions of the Sacred Primal Megalonians!
Since their very early beginnings, they decreed sets of rules to be followed as one of the more inviolable ones...was no outsiders within their home.
Inviolable.
It had never before been broken, nor did anyone plan to break it.
Until that day.

The verdant astral Megalonian brought down a near-death Antediluvian Leviathan who had just failed Existence Severing- his body being bathed by the grandiose light of this sea as around it, Noah was looking at something else that was even more profound.
The looks of the Possessed Megalonians that held the wills of Antediluvian Leviathans were showing shock and disbelief as they even uttered out the word of a single being!
Someone they idolized.
The Omnifather!
'Really?'
Noah stared at the distant figure being cradled on the thighs of a verdant astral entity as he wondered.

The Omnifather actually had a hand in the destruction of the Megalonians? Either way, he seemed to have been involved as after the heavy commotion of shock where bountiful tendrils of golden brilliance surged into him, within seconds...
BOOM!
He opened his eyes!
It was akin to an ancient entity waking.
He felt the hands of his beloved on his head, and he saw her face as he smiled weakly.
With the opening of his eyes, everything began to shake tumultuously as if a terrifying existence was waking up, this entity looking around him as his expression gradually changed!
"No, Vayan...what did you do?!"
His multicolored face gradually lost color as he rose.
He felt the golden sea surging into him as he rose up, and the verdant astral Megalonian that brought him here only smiled happily as she shook her head.
"I thought I would lose you. I couldn't...I couldn't!"
The scene was utterly ridiculous.
As if they were watching some melodrama!
Quintessential Megalonian Nu found it utterly unforgivable that they had such a deep connection in the first place, and even more unforgivable that this Outsider was here.
Her weavings began to move as she raised her hand and brought it down with unfathomable brilliance.
|No Outsiders are permitted in our homes...this, I will ensure!|
An Existence Severing entity moved.
When her hand arose, it seemed like everything lost its texture as all weavings of existence nearby fell under her control.

Above the shimmering golden sea, an unforgiving illusory face formed and opened its eyes as it gazed down callously- this face seeming to bear the endless weight of existence as its eyes and mouth opened to release apocalyptic existence severing golden beams of light!
Any Entity that these existence severing golden beams of light touched would undoubtedly perish.
Vayan had her gaze changed drastically at such a reality as beside her, the existence who had failed Existence Severing sighed while his injured body raised his hand.
"Ashes to ashes."
HUUM!
"Dust to dust."
All beams of that would extinguish any existence they touched vanished before they reached them.

The face in the skies flickered before it also turned into flickers of brilliance and vanished, the figure of Quintessential Megalonian Nu showing extreme astonishment as she locked onto the existence down below.
He had failed Existence Severing.
And yet...he extinguished the inviolable power of an Existence Severing entity as if it were nothing?!
The scene was one that could induce utter horror as this being sighed again and began to rise up.
"I will leave, it may not be too late. The fewer complexities we have between us, the better. Vayan..."
He turned to stare at the woman who looked dazedly at him on the surface of the golden sea, his face showing endlessly affection as he whispered something only she could hear.
And after that...
SAA!
His figure turned into a flicker of light- at a speed that even caused the gaze of the Quintessential Megalonian Nu to change as he only left behind a voice!
|I hope...it is not too late.|
A few words.
The entity had appeared in such a short period of time in the home of the Megalonians, and yet he left rapidly as he purposefully did not look at anything within.
He left in a hurry as if him simply being here was already causing irreversible damage!
And in a glimmer...he was gone. Quintessential Megalonian Nu gazed towards Vayan with rage as she waved her hands, a wind picking her up as the both of them disappeared.
They only left behind panicked Possessed Megalonians who were gazing up where the Omnifather had been with reverence and confusion, the questions inside their hearts being too many.
Noah observed all of this playing out as his existence continued the baptism within the Sacred Primal Sea, many possible weavings surging around him as he calculated many things!
Gradually, the Megalos Mountain retained its calmness as if nothing had happened.
But in the back of everyone's minds, the words of the Omnifather continued to ring out.
He stated twice how he hoped that it wasn't too late.
But Noah and a few others knew...that it was.
Whatever had happened, whatever mechanisms were set into place- it was all too late.
The eventual destruction of the Sacred Primal Megalonians...was now set!
Noah shook his head and focused on himself as he felt something he had known in the back of his mind coming while he bathed in the Sacred Primal Sea.
At the edges of the cloud of possible weavings of himself cultivating all around him, one by one, they began to flicker and disappear.
A limitation in the System of Existence of the Megalonians.
They could carry out their terrifying methodology of cultivation, but it was not something that was so obscene and overpowered.

It had its limitations as one of the major ones...was that after a certain time, the endless possible versions of oneself called upon to stack their increasing complexity of existence onto a single self began to disappear.
As if they could not exist in this weaving of existence that was never theirs for too long!

chapters.title: Chapter 3322 Set in Stone! II
paragraphs: Within moments, every single one of them disappeared until the sea around Noah retained its calmness.
He would not be able to call upon any possible versions of himself again until after a certain amount of time passed.
'Within a day? Less?'
He ponderingly dug into the memories of Pyrrhus as he let the waves of the golden sea wash over him.

In a vision only he could see, a few thousand layers of Fabled Omniverses now rotated around him as they represented vibrant concepts within his First Mundi of Power, as well as the intricate weavings of Ingeniare and Kuklos that throbbed with vibrant light all around him!
He felt like he had stably propelled himself onto a terrifying level of power, the decree of an Ordinance not too far away as within this Tresorverse Sacred Domain...they should have a few days.
Before whatever events were set to play out unfolded, he should be able to make terrifying gains!
Around Omniverse X-999.

Indeterminate light years away, a loud of darkness was throbbing with weavings of Outerversal Authority as it sought to obtain any wisps of information regarding what was happening within, but any tendrils of information were hard to come by!
The Great Ponderor had been seeking to understand his enemy more through Savitar, but this fool had turned out to be useless as now, he wasn't any closer to understanding his enemy.
At a certain point in time though.
'Huh?'
The massive Eye of Existence within the obsidian murky veiled area vibrated and became stern as moments later...
WAP!
It disappeared rapidly.
Quickly!
It was such a rapid retreat, but it was done by the Great Ponderor regardless as he trusted in his senses more than anything else.
Senses he had honed over cycles!
Seconds after he was gone...
WU!
A terrifying wave of golden light passed over this area.
And moments later, a figure adorned in golden robes and emanating terrifying waves of majesty appeared.
It was none other than Noah, with a terrifying golden eye blazing with flames above him as he had radiated a scan all around Omniverse X-999 without abandon!

He hones in on this area with fading Outerversal Authority, his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence being so obscene that even the waves of the tendrils of Outerversal Authority nearby had little arrows and words pop over them.
[Wisps of the residual authority of an Outerversal Morphon. 99% chance of the target to be the one distinguished as the Great Ponderor.]
The enemy had run away.
They weren't even there, and yet he had been able to identify wisps of their authority!

The capabilities of the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence continued to be terrifying as Noah grasped the tendrils of remnant Outerversal Authority within thought as he also turned around to look at the seemingly endless expanse that represented Omniverse X-999.
He didn't like that his enemy knew where one of his bases was.
He remembered the weavings of a certain Dream of the Megalos where he had moved with the Commonwealth for hundreds of years as within it, Omniverse X-999 had disappeared to never be found.
It was a dream.
And yet...
'Might as well...'
His eyes radiated a terrifying level of light as he began to tug on the distinction of the Cartographer of Existence!
This distinction had stated something simple- their details rising up before Noah's eyes again.
|On Omniverses where your weavings are present, the Cartographer's Gateways can be formed, with each one laid down in an Omniverse allowing instantaneous passage to all other connected Omniverses.|

|As the Cartographer of Existence, the Existential Displacement of Omniverses of other bodies of existence at a similar level is possible for an extremely high cost that your weavings of Existence will have to bear.|
Existential Displacement.
It had become something possible for him, even though he didn't know how great the cost would be as it wasn't set!
But...
HUUUM!

His body began to vibrate with power as a few hundred layers of Fabled Omniverses were already emerging around him- the gains made in the reconstruction of the Tresorverse Sacred Domain being synchronized with his Existence out here even though the set events had yet to end!
Noah attributed this terrifying capability to nothing else but the identity of Pyrrhus- An Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian whose distinction far outstripped all others.
Of course, it could just be his own uniqueness since he did hold the distinctions of the Protagonist and Cheats that were currently burning with layers of Fabled Omniverses!
With such thoughts swirling in his mind...
|Existential Displacement.|
HUUM!
He called out.
And immense waves of authority instantly gathered around him as behind him...white brilliance flourished.
It did so with grandiosity as within moments, a terrifying white wheel emerged as it screamed out ancientness and age!
A white wheel.
So pristinely white, and yet its brilliance was directed towards a single Omniverse at this moment as prompts rose before Noah's eyes.
|An Omniverse has been made the target of Existential Displacement.|
|The map of the explored Sectors of the Megalos Ynnere is open for the Cartographer of Existence to choose the area of Displacement.|
|The farther the distance, the greater the required authority.|
Noah's vision saw multiple layers of existence.

He saw what his eyes observed ahead of him, and he also saw a fantastical map that showed where he and Omniverse X-999 currently were compared to the Sector of the Megalos Ynnere he had expanded his vision to.
He perused across this area of the Megalos Ynnere like a map as within moments, he chose exactly where he wanted Omniverse X-999 to be displaced towards!
And...
HUUM!
The white wheel behind him began to spin.
His Atlas of Existence began to spin.
Waves of utmost complexity weavings of Existence began to leak out of Noah as within moments, he couldn't help but smile.
Because he found that the level of weavings of existence he had right now...a percentage of them were more than enough to empower this action of Existential Displacement.
He had come truly far!
Within the emergence of a blinding white light, all of Omniverse X-999 became wrapped with brilliance as a terrifying action was about to take place!

chapters.title: Chapter 3323 Existential Displacement!
paragraphs: Within Omniverse X-999.

Inside a sea of golden brilliance, Imperium had a gaze of fervor as with his power, he had already attained three Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitations that he devoured- and he could feel that a Fabled Omniverse was not too far away!
It was a fantastic boon for him to enjoy, but in the back of his mind, he continued to wonder.
He entered with Osmont, and yet he never came across him again.
Were they in different places? And the power this being expressed, truly, what was his identity?
He, as the Omniversal Ankyra, actually didn't know nor could he comprehend much regarding an existence that lived in this Omniverse!
It was hard to grasp as in the midst of all this...
HUUM!
Imperium felt a tremor.

A tremor that seemed to spread out across the whole Omniverse as an utterly terrifying authority wrapped around it, Imperium connecting to the Autarchical Omniversal Authorities that governed the weavings of this Omniverse as...the answer he got was an astonishing one.
The Autarchical Omniversal Authorities told him that...the whole Omniverse was shifting!
Shifting.
Becoming displaced!
It was an unreal phenomenon that Imperium instantly sought to seek the source of, but before anything could be achieved...
WAP!
Imperium felt a flash of white light.
And thereafter, everything settled.
Rapid. Efficient. Seamless!
Whatever Displacement had just occurred, these were the words that Imperium would use to describe it!
Displacement.
Did this mean that their Omniverse was no longer in a location that the Commonwealth could locate?
As for what could be responsible for this...
Imperium closed his eyes as thought about the one entity that Autarchical Omniversal Authorities could tell him nothing about.
'Is it you?' His gaze was difficult.
He looked at the connection and authority he held over the weavings of this Omniverse as at this moment, he truly pondered.
Was he...truly the Omniversal Ankyra?
It was a question he never had to ask himself, but he found it popping up more and more whenever he compared himself to Osmont!
A successful Existential Displacement that took Omniverse X-999 to a place where the Commonwealth nor the Great Ponderor could easily find inside Sector 1.
Noah conducted such an action seamlessly.
His Sacred Primal Eye of Existence then waded across Omniverse X-999 to confirm no issues occurred, and during this sweep...
'Hmm?'
He found the Worms of Existence that had buried deep into this Omniverse due to their fear of the Protectors of the Commonwealth.
But even more accurately, he found their...shells.
WAP!
One of Noah's figures crossed untold distances to appear in front of a veil of darkness all around with wisps of auroras of purple weaving around.
He waved his hands sideways as if he was cutting something, and a rip appeared in the space before him, and from it...spilled out thousands of obsidian Worms of Existence!
But, they were lifeless.
No movement.
Nothing.
They seemed like husks that were just floating there as Noah looked at them closely- focusing on the biggest one that should have been the Source Worm!

|Remnant Dredge of Anti-Matter|:: An empty husk that used to house a Source of Existence belonging to Anti-Matter. Its source has since been burned and used up by the Great Usurper in an effort to return back to its true source-outside of Megalos Ynnere and into Megalos Nihilos...
Wisps of information flowed into his mind as his gaze became sharp, his senses sweeping out towards Cappadocia where the weavings of Eckert were, and here...
Wisps of information flowed into his mind as his gaze became sharp, his senses sweeping out towards Cappadocia where the weavings of Eckert were, and here...
Was silence!
The visage of Eckert could not be found.

Noah weaved across space to teleport in front of An Imperium Knight that should have been subjugated by Eckert, but the gaze of this entity was blank and returning to its old self as if it had lost something.
|Knight Rigo|:: A Follower of the Imperium whose Source of Existence is returning back to what it once was after the influence of the Great Usurper was lifted...
Gone.
All weavings of the Great Usurper, Noah Eckert, were gone within Omniverse X-999!
Silently, this being had found a way across the Megalos as his departure was so quiet that even Noah did not know about it!
Megalos Ynnere. Megalos Beyond. Megalos Nihilos.
Three Bodies occupied the same space.
A Problem nobody could solve as Noah felt like it was an absolute limit for him to even delve into and exert himself into two of these bodies.

Matter and Dark Matter had a sense of balance with him currently through Psioneutrino Particles, and he felt like if he tried to add something else into the mix in addition to all this, the instability brought forth would not be something he could currently overcome.
So he didn't spread himself out thin as he kept his focus on what he already had.
He glanced at what used to be the weavings of a friend one last time before he disappeared, wondering just what wonders the Great Usurper would experience in the Megalos Nihilos.
The Megalos Beyond had the Great Beyonder and the weavings he laid down.
The Megalos Ynnere had the Omnifather who had just begun to spread his weavings.
What exactly did the Megalos Nihilos have?

It was a question without answers as after ascertaining the weavings of an old friend, Noah appeared in front of the Wheel of Weavings that the Commonwealth had set up, his power sweeping towards it as he would erase any inkling of foreign influences within this Omniverse and ensure that they wouldn't be capable of easily finding it again!
At the same time as he took actions to displace and take Omniverse X-999 off the map of others, another body of his was arriving in another Omniverse within the Megalos Ynnere.
One that was tenebrous in color and filled with tendrils of Outerversal Authority- with Reapers of Existence running rampant as Noah arrived there with an obsidian gold body of a subservient Savitar.
On the periphery of this Omniverse, they were welcomed by another body of Savitar- this one burning with purple flames in its Sockets as it bowed towards Noah's visage.
|This...Follower welcomes the Dreamer of the Megalos into this Tainted Omniverse.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3324 A Sacred Eye Opens in the Megalos Beyond! I
paragraphs: As Savitar spoke, he couldn't help but glance at the necklace around the neck of the golden robed Noah, seeing the single obsidian crown on the golden necklace that represented his Megalos Regnum as his flickering eyes bent further down!
He could have no grand dreams about himself from now on.
Due to the schemes of the Great Ponderor, he had rammed into something he could not handle as now, he was paying the price for it.
It was a heavy one as he lost his freedom, and it seemed like in the foreseeable future, he was about to lose his Tainted Omniverses, too.
The hatred Savitar felt towards the Great Ponderor was not something that could be put into words!
Noah nodded towards his newest follower as his Eye already flashed above him and swept across this Tainted Omniverse, his figure quickly disappearing before it reappeared within its depths.
Within a place where all of its weavings had been forcefully converged to form...a Dark Matter Core.
HUUUM!
It pulsed with extremely concentrated waves of Dark Matter- this being a tool that Outerversal Morphons used to further refine their Outerversal Physiologies and further elevate their own power!
But for Noah, this would be a delicacy meant for a single construct.
"Eat up."
His fingers tapped out as a multicolored singularity appeared right between him and the Dark Matter Core, a terrifying gravitational force erupting from it that began sucking everything in!

Near the Dark Matter Core were High ranking Delegatus of Savitar and Reapers of Existence, all of them being aroused at this moment as they felt a terrifying force pulling towards a singularity that seemed like it was eating up everything nearby.
Their hearts leaped out in terror as they called out.
|Master!|
|Great Savitar!|
|O One Who Walks!|
Cries boomed out, but they received no answers.

The quintillions who perished within this Omniverse before they were pulled to become Reapers of Existence could take recompense in the deaths of all those residing within their altered Omniverse at the very least!
Cries boomed out, but they received no answers.

The quintillions who perished within this Omniverse before they were pulled to become Reapers of Existence could take recompense in the deaths of all those residing within their altered Omniverse at the very least!

Noah's body was unbound by the terrifying pressure of the singularity eating up everything, his figure disappearing and appearing beside the two bodies of Savitar who had stayed put where they were, ignoring the cries of his forces down there as when Noah reappeared...
|I shall take Master to another one of my Tainted Omniverses...|

Savitar swallowed any feeling in the depths of his heart as his fear of this being who held control of his very Megalos Regnum was far too deep, making him not have even an ounce of rebellion as, at this moment, the target of his hatred remained the Great Ponderor!
"Let's go."
Noah nodded towards his new follower as their figures flickered away- about to go door to door within Tainted Omniverses and have them devoured and assimilated by the Infinite Omniverse.

All Sources of his existence apart from Outerversal Authority were rising rapidly- with this power resuming its speedy advancement as well through the recent actions of the Infinite Omniverse, as well as...Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias who was moving valiantly to further cement the role of the Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of- and to make sure that he went to obtain all the possible boons from whatever the Great Beyonder left behind!
Across the weavings of Existence.
Within the Megalos Beyond.
Inside the Pantheon of Umbra!
Ozymandias rose up, the illusory screens showing his figure within the Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos beginning to flicker and fade away as within moments...
HUUM!
His glorious stellar obsidian body was taken out of the Crucible entirely to appear in the dreary skies of the Pantheon of Umbra.
The figure of Little Aspasia clasped her hands with fervor as her voice echoed out.
|As deemed by the commands of the Great Mother, I truly present to you all the Instrument of the Beyonder- returning victorious from his first entry into a Crucible of the Beyonder!|
The name of the Great Mother who kept Heretical Morphons at bay was mentioned.
The honor of the Instrument was further expressed as...the deep voice of none other than the Great Wheel boomed out.

|Haha, yes! The Pantheon of Umbra shall joyfully celebrate the emergence of the Instrument of the Beyonder. When our forces are sufficient, we can start heading to other Pantheons to challenge the other Crucibles of the Beyonder. For now...a celebration!|
The Great Wheel.

Countless intricate tentacles made this being as when Ozymandias came out, his aura was still rapidly rising in power as his Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum were also affected by the extensive rise of existence of his other self in the Megalos Ynnere.
States of Existence were unique.

They didn't discriminate between whatever Source of Existence one was cultivating- whether they were from the Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, or Megalos Nihilos- the States of Existence seemed to be the only similarity!
Ozymandias could think along this line of thought with confidence as he had closely experienced the lives of both an entity living alongside Matter and Dark Matter.
'Maybe herein lay a possible solution to the Three Body Problem...'

He had this thought in passing as he smiled, but essentially, due to the uniqueness of States of Existence- Ozymandias himself could enjoy the ridiculous boons of the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus!
But...how different would it be when expressed by an Outerversal Morphon?

With but a thought, his rising complexity that the hundreds of thousands of nearby Morphons were mistaking due to the gains made in the Crucible and the first Amarantos Dream...it all spilled out at this moment to coalesce above him.
In an instant, an obsidian singularity emerged that quickly became a stellar obsidian eye that opened its lids with fervor!
BOOM!
The weavings of the surrounding Megalos turned tumultuous at such an action, obsidian rivers of brilliance stretching down from all around as if they had to aid in the formation of this glorious Eye.
And by the time it fully formed...
Even Little Aspasia was stupefied as she looked towards Ozymandias blankly.

She was following the will of the Great Mother even though she had her own doubts, but at this moment, she couldn't help but become dumbfounded as she was effectively watching a newly born Morphon who had just attained the state of One With Existence...also attain the Eye of Existence right after.
The Eye of the Megalos!
Even the intricate Great Wheel became stern at the formation of this eye as it looked too intricate compared to many he had seen...or even his own.
And the moment it formed, Ozymandias domineering swept its gaze across the Pantheon of Umbra.
Far from here, Savitar had told him how the Great Ponderor had one of his bodies on the Pantheon of Umbra.
Could he discover and glance upon this being with his current eyes?
It was a bold action to take with his identity as Ozymandias, and he did it regardless as waves of information began to enter his weavings.
Information about the Great Wheel.
Information on the bodies of abstruse Great Ones currently present in this Pantheon of Umbra!
A stellar obsidian eye opened as it sought to understand everything around it- and the very Megalos trembled as if they were helping achieve this!

sentences.text: As Savitar spoke, he couldn't help but glance at the necklace around the neck of the golden robed Noah, seeing the single obsidian crown on the golden necklace that represented his Megalos Regnum as his flickering eyes bent further down!
He could have no grand dreams about himself from now on.
Due to the schemes of the Great Ponderor, he had rammed into something he could not handle as now, he was paying the price for it.
It was a heavy one as he lost his freedom, and it seemed like in the foreseeable future, he was about to lose his Tainted Omniverses, too.
The hatred Savitar felt towards the Great Ponderor was not something that could be put into words!
Noah nodded towards his newest follower as his Eye already flashed above him and swept across this Tainted Omniverse, his figure quickly disappearing before it reappeared within its depths.
Within a place where all of its weavings had been forcefully converged to form...a Dark Matter Core.
HUUUM!
It pulsed with extremely concentrated waves of Dark Matter- this being a tool that Outerversal Morphons used to further refine their Outerversal Physiologies and further elevate their own power!
But for Noah, this would be a delicacy meant for a single construct.
"Eat up."
His fingers tapped out as a multicolored singularity appeared right between him and the Dark Matter Core, a terrifying gravitational force erupting from it that began sucking everything in!

Near the Dark Matter Core were High ranking Delegatus of Savitar and Reapers of Existence, all of them being aroused at this moment as they felt a terrifying force pulling towards a singularity that seemed like it was eating up everything nearby.
Their hearts leaped out in terror as they called out.
|Master!|
|Great Savitar!|
|O One Who Walks!|
Cries boomed out, but they received no answers.

The quintillions who perished within this Omniverse before they were pulled to become Reapers of Existence could take recompense in the deaths of all those residing within their altered Omniverse at the very least!
Cries boomed out, but they received no answers.

The quintillions who perished within this Omniverse before they were pulled to become Reapers of Existence could take recompense in the deaths of all those residing within their altered Omniverse at the very least!

Noah's body was unbound by the terrifying pressure of the singularity eating up everything, his figure disappearing and appearing beside the two bodies of Savitar who had stayed put where they were, ignoring the cries of his forces down there as when Noah reappeared...
|I shall take Master to another one of my Tainted Omniverses...|

Savitar swallowed any feeling in the depths of his heart as his fear of this being who held control of his very Megalos Regnum was far too deep, making him not have even an ounce of rebellion as, at this moment, the target of his hatred remained the Great Ponderor!
"Let's go."
Noah nodded towards his new follower as their figures flickered away- about to go door to door within Tainted Omniverses and have them devoured and assimilated by the Infinite Omniverse.

All Sources of his existence apart from Outerversal Authority were rising rapidly- with this power resuming its speedy advancement as well through the recent actions of the Infinite Omniverse, as well as...Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias who was moving valiantly to further cement the role of the Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of- and to make sure that he went to obtain all the possible boons from whatever the Great Beyonder left behind!
Across the weavings of Existence.
Within the Megalos Beyond.
Inside the Pantheon of Umbra!
Ozymandias rose up, the illusory screens showing his figure within the Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos beginning to flicker and fade away as within moments...
HUUM!
His glorious stellar obsidian body was taken out of the Crucible entirely to appear in the dreary skies of the Pantheon of Umbra.
The figure of Little Aspasia clasped her hands with fervor as her voice echoed out.
|As deemed by the commands of the Great Mother, I truly present to you all the Instrument of the Beyonder- returning victorious from his first entry into a Crucible of the Beyonder!|
The name of the Great Mother who kept Heretical Morphons at bay was mentioned.
The honor of the Instrument was further expressed as...the deep voice of none other than the Great Wheel boomed out.
|Haha, yes!
The Pantheon of Umbra shall joyfully celebrate the emergence of the Instrument of the Beyonder.
When our forces are sufficient, we can start heading to other Pantheons to challenge the other Crucibles of the Beyonder.
For now...a celebration!|
The Great Wheel.

Countless intricate tentacles made this being as when Ozymandias came out, his aura was still rapidly rising in power as his Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum were also affected by the extensive rise of existence of his other self in the Megalos Ynnere.
States of Existence were unique.

They didn't discriminate between whatever Source of Existence one was cultivating- whether they were from the Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, or Megalos Nihilos- the States of Existence seemed to be the only similarity!
Ozymandias could think along this line of thought with confidence as he had closely experienced the lives of both an entity living alongside Matter and Dark Matter.
'Maybe herein lay a possible solution to the Three Body Problem...'

He had this thought in passing as he smiled, but essentially, due to the uniqueness of States of Existence- Ozymandias himself could enjoy the ridiculous boons of the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus!
But...how different would it be when expressed by an Outerversal Morphon?

With but a thought, his rising complexity that the hundreds of thousands of nearby Morphons were mistaking due to the gains made in the Crucible and the first Amarantos Dream...it all spilled out at this moment to coalesce above him.
In an instant, an obsidian singularity emerged that quickly became a stellar obsidian eye that opened its lids with fervor!
BOOM!
The weavings of the surrounding Megalos turned tumultuous at such an action, obsidian rivers of brilliance stretching down from all around as if they had to aid in the formation of this glorious Eye.
And by the time it fully formed...
Even Little Aspasia was stupefied as she looked towards Ozymandias blankly.

She was following the will of the Great Mother even though she had her own doubts, but at this moment, she couldn't help but become dumbfounded as she was effectively watching a newly born Morphon who had just attained the state of One With Existence...also attain the Eye of Existence right after.
The Eye of the Megalos!
Even the intricate Great Wheel became stern at the formation of this eye as it looked too intricate compared to many he had seen...or even his own.
And the moment it formed, Ozymandias domineering swept its gaze across the Pantheon of Umbra.
Far from here, Savitar had told him how the Great Ponderor had one of his bodies on the Pantheon of Umbra.
Could he discover and glance upon this being with his current eyes?
It was a bold action to take with his identity as Ozymandias, and he did it regardless as waves of information began to enter his weavings.
Information about the Great Wheel.
Information on the bodies of abstruse Great Ones currently present in this Pantheon of Umbra!
A stellar obsidian eye opened as it sought to understand everything around it- and the very Megalos trembled as if they were helping achieve this!

chapters.title: Chapter 3325 A Sacred Eye Opens in the Megalos Beyond! II
paragraphs: An eye inherited from an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
Its capabilities were already shown to be utterly disastrous when Noah utilized it within the Megalos Ynnere, but what about its usage in the Megalos Beyond?
With the eye opening, Noah felt like his vision was permeating across all the folds of the Pantheon of Umbra as nothing could escape his sight.
The stellar skies. The dark earth. The tall mountains. The horror inducing structures erected throughout it. The tentacles and fur of countless Outerversal Morphons.
Every single thing fell into his eyes as an inflow of information only kept coming in en masse, with his focus being the closest ones here!

[Aspasia]:: State of Existence- One With Existence. Source of Existence- Outerversal. Lifespan- 2 Megalos Cycle/90 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- An entity in tune with the weavings of the Great Beyonder at a higher level than most since she was born from threads of a Source of a Crucible...

[Third Body of the Great Wheel]:: State of Existence- Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation. Source of Existence- Outerversal. Lifespan- 44 Megalos Cycle/110 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- Some limitations arise in attaining the more closed off records of this entity due to the disparity inside complexity...
The eye was utterly terrifying.

It showed the weavings of Aspasia before they flowed towards The Great Wheel- with this entity actually having passed the state of declaring his Ordinance of Existence as, at this moment, he had already begun his Amalgamation.
If he failed, there was the collapse of his existence.
If he passes, he could spend the next cycles increasing his complexity and seeing whether Existence Severing would be something he could reach in his lifetime!
But there seemed to be a theme as many powerful entities...were held at the Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation as they didn't fully take that last step.
They were afraid to proceed ahead as the results of failure were truly too cataclysmic!
Ozymandias nodded as his gaze continued to pierce across the Pantheon of Umbra.

His eyes caught three other Outerversal Morphons who had brought their Outerversal Physiology and Regnum to Echelon 7- distinguishing them as other Great Ones, but they had only been able to declare their Ordinance of Existence.
But soon enough...
"Hmm?"
His eyes shone as on the other side of Umbra, within the depths of obsidian earth that showed a collection of caves.
A veiled Outerversal Morphon that seemed to be brooding fell under his gaze.

[False Body of Nietzsche, the Great Ponderor]:: State of Existence- Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation. Source of Existence- Outerversal. Lifespan- 51 Megalos Cycle/180 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- The False Body of Nietzsche is used for everyday purposes. Some limitations arise in attaining the more closed off records of this entity due to the disparity inside complexity...
The enemy that had been targeting him appeared.
Their maximum possible lifespan was grander than most he had seen as he had lived for a truly long time.
They had also declared their Ordinance of Existence and had already taken the steps towards Amalgamation similar to the Great Wheel!
Due to the complexity of existence, Noah wasn't able to utilize the feature of Existence Suppression, nor was he able to track where the other bodies of Nietzsche were.
But at the very least, he had honed in on his current enemy as all that was left after that...was to ensure their defeat!

His eyes flashed with a chilling light as in front of Ozymandias, the Tentacles of the Great Wheel throbbed with jubilancy, his followers and other Morphons clamoring with a myriad of emotions as the Great Wheel himself spoke out.

|Exquisite...I cannot see anything but grandiosity in the future as the Great Beyonder promised. Come, you shall rest in my domain while we await for the Great Mother and the Observer of Old and Young!|
The ancient voice of the Great Wheel boomed out as among the throngs of Outerversal Morphons, those who did not believe only wonder and expansion were coming for the Megalos Beyond watched coldly.

The Heretical Morphons could not yet make a move as they only watched, but many of them felt a prickling on their Megalos Regnum- as if the massive illusory obsidian eye that had opened above the Instrument was gazing at them with coldness at this moment!
In a hidden section of the Pantheon of Umbra.
Another Heretical Morphon was veiled by a cloud of dark brilliance as at this moment, his expression was even more clouded than before.
Around him, tenebrous tendrils of Outerversal Authority seethed as they faintly fused together into a terrifying decree.
The Great Ponderor.
Nietzsche!
He always planned and planned before making any moves, even more so when it came to unknown enemies!
And yet, there were very few times in the past when he was preparing for an unknown enemy that he had received a premonition of danger.
And none that was as intense as the one he felt with one of his bodies in the Megalos Ynnere!
Danger for him was defined differently from others.
Danger to him didn't represent someone who could stand on equal power- it stood for someone who was capable of finding out information about him and his records.
His records were the most important thing.
His weavings were of paramount importance as if ever they were about to get uncovered or becoming uncovered by an enemy, this was what set off his sense of danger more than anything else!
And his sense of danger had been buzzing chaotically since that time, and had only continued to ring ever louder since then.
This wasn't good.
As a schemer, being learned of and schemed against was never something he would stand for!
So, what he had to do now...was entirely change his perspective of his enemy.

This enemy would now be designated as the highest risk that Nietzsche had ever faced, and if he continued to feel this same sense of danger- he had to approach the weavings of the one known as Protector Osmont carefully...

chapters.title: Chapter 3326 Possibilities! I
paragraphs: There were many ways to defeat an enemy.
At this moment, an Outerversal Morphon of great stature was in a terrifying bind as more often than not, he never made a direct move against his enemies.
He wasn't defeated!
And yet within this cycle of his life, he may just come to find that defeat...could also be achieved even without making a move.
Such a thought was truly terrifying as in his weavings, Nietzsche wondered.
He wouldn't truly be defeated by his enemy before they even made a move, right?
Ozymandias was doing well.
Noah had such thoughts as he sat on his multicolored throne within the Infinite Omniverse, the visage of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse itself floating before him.
Ozymandias had a unique position in the Megalos Beyond as he was a central figure wrapped in a belief left behind by the Great Beyonder.
As long as he continued on this path and overcame the remaining Crucibles of the Beyonder, his power and complexity would continue to reach even grander levels!
He thought of the many possibilities that lay ahead before he focused on the visage of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse before him.

|We have only just begun the assimilation of Omniverses and Dark Matter Cores into the Infinite Omniverse, but the direction ahead...a pathway for it is becoming clearer as it requires your guidance.|
The Infinite Omniverse came to him as it found something unfathomable.
This was all occurring amidst many great changes within the Infinite Omniverse itself as those within it were becoming increasingly complex.

His son took the lead in the Primalwater of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence as he obtained multiple Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitations, and he pushed his weavings within the Existential Dominium Realm to the peak as by placing a singular focus on Destiny...he was about to form his first Fabled Omniverse!

Barbatos, Athena, and Sona were close seconds in their rise in power even though they had not obtained as many Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitations, with their power coming from a change due to Noah himself.
The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Harems.

It seemed to be scaling its capabilities in ridiculous ways as it formed its own Fabled Omniverses, with those it was connected to having the complexity of their existence passively pushed upwards at a terrifying rate.

Those within his Harem were benefitting at an even greater rate due to his own elevation, and this wasn't to mention the constant resonance of weavings that Cheats had begun to emanate since it formed its Fabled Omniverses!
Something was being prepared as Noah currently only had an inkling as to what it could be.
And in the middle of all this, his Infinite Omniverse came to him and stated such words!
"What is becoming clearer?"
What could cause the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse to look so serious?

|The continued assimilation of both Matter and Dark Matter in extremely pure form is not only changing the nature of the Infinite Omniverse itself but scaling its complexity to be far past any Omniverse within the Megalos Ynnere or Pantheon within the Megalos Beyond. This increasing complexity...is the root cause.|
The intermixing of Matter and Dark Matter seamlessly in a single Omniverse.
The product was something that didn't exist in any Megalos out there.

When Outerversal Morphons descended into the Megalos Ynnere and Tainted its Omniverses, they were entirely transformed into Tainted Omniverses with pure Dark Matter that had eaten up weavings of Matter entirely.
They did not assimilate.
And in the Megalos Beyond, there were no powerhouses from the Megalos Ynnere transforming the Pantheons within!

What Noah did was connect the weavings from both of these Megalos of Existence and have them seamlessly assimilate into a single thing, thereby bringing to fruition a product with a unique complexity.
But what did this all lead to?
This complexity...what did the Infinite Omniverse get from it?
Noah stared at the Manifestation with bright eyes as he waited for its answer.
And it was a terrifying one.
|I feel as if with this type of increasing complexity...I may be able to 'jump' from here and into the Expanse.|
BOOM!
Countless weavings erupted and roiled around Noah.
He looked at the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse, and it looked back at him!
An Omniverse...transcending its weavings due to complexities brought to fruition by two Megalos.
It was terrifying to think about as what exactly would the result be?
Noah had no idea as he asked the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse vibrantly.
"How...far off are you?"

|With the stable Terraforming and continued presence of Matter, along with another two or three Tainted Omniverses and the constant inflow of the weavings of the Megalos Beyond itself through Ozymandias...the possibility should arise. Complexity should reach a sufficient enough level, but of course, I can always continue increasing the level of complexity even further to ensure chances of success if this is attempted.|
The possibilities were grand.
The Expanse was a terrifying landscape where even now, Noah was only just finishing the consumption of Hearthraes in the white space that Bob left him in!
He had explored very little of this space where powerhouses could be encountered at any moment.
After ascertaining the words of the Infinite Omniverse, he rose up from his throne with a serious expression.
Behind him, Invictus Maximus expanded out as the countless possibilities and causalities were looked at and discerned!
All of this began in a small Beast World.
All of it began with a floating Spiritual Land- a grandiose floating island!
At this moment, after many transformations and elevations, this past floating island was telling him it could possibly transcend itself.
He had always theorized where it would end up in the future- whether it could be something as vast as the Megalos Beyond or Megalos Ynnere or Megalos Nihilos.
He had theorized many possible routes, but some things could not be theorized.
Nor could they be prepared for!
"Very well."
HUUM!
But he wouldn't cower back with whatever was to come, as he moved decisively.
Three more of his bodies left the Infinite Omniverse as they would rapidly ensure more of himself would arrive at the remaining Tainted Omniverses under the banner of Savitar.
He would prepare sufficiently.
The greater the complexity, the better!
He wanted to see with his own eyes what would happen with the small floating island all those months ago- just what precipice it could reach!

chapters.title: Chapter 3327 Possibilities! II
paragraphs: Complexity.
How could such a thing be truly and accurately measured?
For the most part, there was the reliance on Echelons to demarcate different levels of Complexity, with there being Nine Echelons for Sources of Existence.
Entities like Savitar, who barely qualified with the distinction of a Great One, had reached the Seventh Echelon of Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum.

Inside the Pantheon of Umbra alone, Ozymandias had observed multiple Entities who could hold the distinctions of Great Ones by having either Outerversal Physiology or Megalos Regnum at the Seventh Echelon already.
It gave a glimpse of how much more advanced the Outerversal Morphons had become as they had been enjoying the boons that the Great Beyonder left behind for multiple Cycles now.

The boons of the Omnifather had just begun to grace Megalos Ynnere, and they were extremely terrifying as just the glimpse of the Tresorverse of the Omnifather that Noah had observed so far already expressed its ridiculous boons.

It would no doubt allow the inhabitants of Megalos Ynnere to quickly bridge the power gap that seemed to exist against those in the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Nihilos- with the Echelons of their Sources of Existence rising rapidly.
Entities like Command Protector Valeria had reached the Fifth Echelon in their System of Kuklos, and Protector Lucretia reached the same Echelon in regards to her status as a Delegatus.

Old Man Eudemus...was likely about to exceed the Seventh Echelon of Kuklos as Noah didn't know where entities like the Sword of the Commonwealth were. He knew much less regarding the recently risen Antediluvian Leviathans who seemed to have much more power than those within the Commonwealth!
The followers of the Omnifather.
With the Omnifather being an Antediluvian Leviathan himself, his Lineage should have been untouchable over the cycles, and their strength showed this.
So why did they sit back and allow the Commonwealth to take the lead in ruling over these past cycles?
There were many mysteries as Noah thought about how many sides looked at the complexity of existence.
These were Echelons.
But they were far too broad.
They didn't fully encompass things like the States of Existence into account as well, and these played a Paramount factor in one's strength.
Noah was a prime example of this.
His base complexity had not reached the higher Echelons like Savitar and Nietzsche, and yet he could already overcome Savitar due to his unique Eye of Existence.
"The measurement of complexity has to be more comprehensive..."

Noah uttered such words as he spread out his senses, the golden eye above his head opening ever wider as it felt the countless changes of the Aletheian Havens and the Extremity Vein that acted as the center of this grandiose Construct.

It had begun to course with and radiate a terrifying light of both Matter and Dark Matter at this moment as it released low hums of resonance, terrifying levels of energy that no entity could ever contain coursing through it.
This would be one of the keys if the actions of the Infinite Omniverse were to succeed.
Noah's senses permeated across all of it as he prepared.
But no matter how much one prepared, they would always feel like it wasn't enough!
For Noah, the words of the even grander mystery that had recently appeared, Bob, reverberated in his mind.

Over the cycles, countless entities across the Megalos Beyond, Megalos Ynnere, and Megalos Nihilos had arrived in the Expanse. Over the past eons, they had sensed things. They knew that something was coming as they began gathering themselves together- thinking of strength in numbers!
But Bob stated that even this would not be enough.
That even numbers will not hold a candle for what was coming, only one's own existence being the thing to rely on the most!
This was what Bob had stated before he left, telling Noah that the white space surrounded by entity red strings he had brought him in could be used as some form of a refuge.
His words revealed many things- showing that there was some form of organization and order across the Expanse where different entities across the Megalos gathered.
But the dangers were just as vibrant.
And something that nobody was truly ready for was coming!
"Why can't it be that no grandiose or apocalyptic changes occur while I'm moving?"
Noah smiled as he sensed the continued waves of complexity around him.
"If you all just give me a few months- not even years, much less even a single cycle, with no massive major existence altering events..."
If he just had months of peace.
He didn't even need years!
He didn't need Cycles!
Just months, and he could probably attain a level of power that could surpass these creatures who had been training for whole cycles.
But no.
Whether the weavings of the Protagonist were just that powerful, or by the means of Causality, massive events continued to occur as he rose up.
But Noah innately knew.
He himself was the root cause for at least some of these things.
Causality continued to dance from one event to another.
He made a single choice here, and it led to the eruption of many more choices thereafter!
For example, what he was doing now with the Infinite Omniverse.
Just what effects would he inadvertently bring forth if the Infinite Omniverse was successful in transcending its weavings of existence and arriving within the Expanse?
He couldn't say for sure.
All he knew was that he could keep moving forward.
Regardless of what massive events occurred around him.
Regardless of what effects his actions would have.
He had to keep moving forward; otherwise, if he stalled, he would be stepped on by another and die without even understanding why!
"Let's do it boldly and without fail."
|Yes, Master.|
He spoke, and the Infinite Omniverse affirmed.
Its complexity was reaching a critical juncture.
It seemed that within the day, the event that could change many things would be carried out!

chapters.title: Chapter 3328 Refuge! I
paragraphs: Before this change came, Noah had to understand a bit more regarding the Expanse.
His eyes twinkled as the scene of another one of his bodies observed in the Expanse became clear.
Within that white space that Bob had teleported them into.

It was a perfect white circular space surrounded by the countless tendrils of golden strings, with Noah swallowing the last golden dew drops of the Hearthraes as above him, an illusory Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree gushed down waves of complexity while below him, a Primordial Mountain of the Expanse erupted with waves of brilliance that encircled his body.

He felt like his existence had gained a sense of exalted dignity far exceeding his previous self after devouring all these Hearthraes, to the extent that he even felt a sense of closeness and familiarity with this blank space around him!
Bob called it a refuge, why was this?

One of the more actualized gains was the fact that his body that felt radiated a translucent golden glow truly felt an unshakable connection with this white space- as if it were an anchor within the Expanse that he could always find.

Noah blinked and looked around him, gazing at the distant outlines of golden strings outside of this white space as his body floated towards them while remembering that with a single tug from Bob, these strings had transported them towards the Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and with another tug, into this white domain.
If Noah could also learn how to utilize them...
He was about to reach out to a nearby golden string just to study it.
About to step out from the white space he was currently in.
When...
His hands stopped inches away. His heart felt heavy waves of trepidation!
And he looked out into the golden expanse of strings as he backed away and came towards the center of the white space once more.
Trepidation.
What could give someone like him trepidation?
He stared out into the expanse of golden strings as everything looked utterly calm and serene, but his Existence continued buzzing and wouldn't lie to him as he looked out before voicing old coldly.
|Why not show yourself? Hiding in the dark doesn't suit you.| HUUM!
He spoke such words while his weavings buzzed and he looked out into the expanse of golden strings, and there was only silence!
But his gaze remained coldly staring out.
Above him, authority began to gather as his terrifying eye was about to open!
In such a deafening silence...
|Interesting.|
An ancient voice that could cause one's skin to crawl boomed out from all around.
Thereafter, in the empty direction filled with golden strings where Noah was gazing at, eyes without pupils opened.
Thousands of eyes as each one radiated a horrific obsidian brilliance that felt like it could devour everything!
Such eyes were connected to the hardened silver skin of a massive spider, its body flashing with translucent radiance as more and more of it became visible.

Over nine thousand spiked silver limbs emerged from its body as they entirely surrounded the white space Noah was in, with the closest ones being inches away from the golden string Noah was just about to touch on the periphery of the white space!
A massive, silver-furred spider with thousands of eyes and limbs, its whole existence emanating pure dread as the weavings of...
"Anti-Matter..."
Noah's heart beat just a little faster as he uttered out while gazing at this creature.
It didn't take a single step into the white space as it seemed to be waiting. As it seemed like...it couldn't take any steps into this white space!
Its eyes stared at Noah with such a vile cold light of devouring and destruction as its intent echoed out again.

|How did a weak thing like you find and bind an Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain? With your flimsy grasp of Existence, there should have been no way for you to even know how to mix your complexity in to bind it...so what happened, little thing?|
WAA!
Its words were like trillions of knives constantly cutting each other.
Inside its questions were many answers as Noah looked around the white space that Bob left him in and remembered his words!
A refuge.

But this terrifying spider that encompassed everything all around called it an Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain. That someone of Noah's power shouldn't have even been able to bind it, nor even know how to do so with his level of complexity!
So why?
The sensation of connection he felt with this white space instantly fell into place as he recalled all the Hearthraes he had devoured in this space.
He hadn't paid attention to this feeling of closeness, but he paid attention to it now fully as above him, a glorious golden eye opened.
Waves of information began to surge out from all around.

Noah felt the hazy connection of an Entanglement his existence had with and surrounding space, where weavings of his complexity had been entrenched within it entirely as he gained a form of understanding and control over it!
Alongside these findings, prompts began to cascade over his eyes.
[You have attained Existential Entanglement with a unique domain in the Expanse that will at this moment be distinguished as an Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain.]

[So far, the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain has been identified to be a space with an absolute set of decrees that cannot be violated, and one of these decrees is the entrance into this domain. Unless permitted by the one who is currently entangled with it, nobody else can enter or affect anything within this domain.]
[Any other possible functions are currently still being analyzed.]
Bob had called it a refuge.
This was the reason why!
It was a refuge within the Expanse for terrifying entities like the one that Noah was staring at right now.
Entities who could meld with the surrounding weavings without others knowing they were even there.

Entities that at this moment, even the one that Noah was staring at alone...held shocking power not at the level of an Eye of Existence or Ordinance of Existence, but they were at Ordinance Amalgamation!
Such an entity was actually camping for Noah while remaining invisible as a single wrong move meant destruction!

chapters.title: Chapter 3329 Refuge! II
paragraphs: Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Refuge!
As Noah began to learn more about it, his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence- Pyrrhus, had opened with shocking grandeur as it gazed at everything.
The pupil within this golden eye couldn't be clearly discerned as, at this moment, in addition to the vibrant white space around it- its power also landed on the silver spider creature outside of it.

[Ancient Phrike, Vujun]:: State of Existence- Ordinance Amalgamation. Source of Existence- Annihilare. Lifespan- 130 Megalos Cycle/210 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- A creature that has lived for an extremely long period of time and perfected its arts. It's its perfection, it has also not been able to move forward as even after 130 Cycles of the Megalos, its existence remains in the Ordinance Amalgamation stage. Steeped in the weavings of Anti-Matter, this Ancient Phrike, Vujun, had waded across the Megalos Nihilos for dozens of Cycles and gained many distinctions for itself. Due to the disparity in power, a limited amount of records can be observed about this being...
Noah continued to be utterly dumbfounded by how far the power of the Weaver of Existence and Weaver of Extremity had become under the banner of the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence.
Because at this moment, he was able to gain details of shocking proportions on enemies who were much more powerful than him, and even all these details...were still limited in nature!
Nobody should be able to seamlessly observe the details of an Ordinance of Existence or Ordinance Amalgamation entities if they weren't even in these stages already.
And yet...Noah stared at the details of this terrifying creature ahead of him that had an extremely long life span as he spoke out.
"How long have you been staying out there waiting, exactly?"

Its thousands of obsidian eyes and silvery fur could cause one's trepidation, the spiked legs of the spider being even more terrifying as this creature focused on Noah before its intent calmly weaved out again.

|I sensed the reverberations of a fearsome explosion of existence, so I sent a trace of myself here to see. But for me to come across a Blancverse Domain that has just been occupied by a weak chick...that is truly a cruel twist of fate that I cannot accept.|
HUUM!
Existence began to tremble after its intent.

The surrounding golden string shockingly bent towards its body, it's rotund lower half pulsing as from an obsidian singularity at the end of its body- dense silver webs instantly shot out to paint everything!
Webs!
Millions of them!
And yet they held a penetrative light that could skewer any Entity even at the Ordinance of Existence stage as they came to wrap around the Blancverse Domain like a cacoon.

|Some Blancverse Domains are weak and average in their authority as they can eventually be broken. Some are spaces that even Existence Severing entities cannot touch. I refuse to believe any weakling like you could bind the latter...no, it must be a weak domain. Come on out for me. Come on out!|
Its ancient voice was grating and held calmness initially, but it turned more and more vile while pulsing with crazed madness thereafter as, by the end, it was shouting!
It came out with more details about this place of refuge that Bob had taken Noah to that he was also studying and understanding its weavings at this very moment.

This Ancient Phrike, Vujun, was likely attracted here by the ridiculously vibrant absorption of Hearthraes that Noah was doing- an action that caused the illusory appearance of the Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree that gushed down waves of complexity above, while below him, a Primordial Mountain of the Expanse did the same.
This drew the creature in.
And now, its terrifying webs wrapped around the exterior of the Blancverse Domain like an egg as the webs squeezed down, but absolutely nothing occurred!
Either a weak Blancverse Domain that could eventually be broken into, or a strong one that even Existence Severing entities could not enter.
Seeing the urgency and madness within the voice of the Ancient Phrike, Vujun, it seemed that any Blancverse Domain was a shocking rarity.
At this moment, as his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence studied the closeness and connection Noah's weavings held with this space, more details unfolded.

[The level of Existential Entanglement is currently at the very basic level, your complexity of existence only supporting it to a level that will be distinguished as the Basal Control of the Blancverse Domain. With the Basal Control of the Blancverse Domain, a few weavings are possible for you to tap into.]
This refuge.
This space.
As Noah became more in tune with it to understand it, weavings of information finally returned back to him as they were grandiose!
[The space within the Blancverse Domain can be increased or decreased in a limited fashion.]
[The location of the Blancverse Domain can be changed randomly within the Expanse.]

[Within the Blancverse Domain, weavings are extremely conducive to the growth of Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree or other unique plants like it, allowing for an alteration of their maturity in a short period of time.]

[Within the Blancverse Domain, structures and topography can be built by utilizing the Pillars of Existence within the Expanse or other forms of pure authority for those with sufficient enough complexity to do such a thing.]

One weaving after another came to Noah as his eyes began to shine more and more, his singular Sacred Primal Eye of Existence focusing on one particular weaving while looking at the maddening power of the Ordinance Amalgamation entity outside of this space!
[The location of the Blancverse Domain can be changed randomly within the Expanse.]
Location.
Noah couldn't touch this being at his current stage of Ordinance Amalgamation, and he did not want to continue waiting for it to test its theory on exactly what type of a Blancverse Domain this was.
So Noah temporarily tuned out everything else as he focused on the weavings of location.
The location of the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain.
HUUM!
Within the white space, Noah's weavings spread out madly as he sought for the Existential Entanglement.
What he had inherently become entangled with not too long ago!
He sought for it, locking onto a unique sensation as thereafter hundreds of illusory layers of Fabled Omniverses began rotating around him!
And waves of energy in such high volume and concentration began to leak out of him.
More volume and concentration than anything he had to spend his weavings activating in the past!
